Das Tagesgeschehen mit den aktuellsten und brisantesten Themen aus der Schweiz wird vorgestellt. In Reportagen, Porträts und Live-Gesprächen werden die Hintergründe von Schlagzeilen sowie das Geschehen aus dem In- und Ausland erläutert.

Ironische Beiträge und Reportagen beleuchten die Skurrilitäten der politischen Woche. Aber auch andere gesellschaftlich relevante und aktuelle Themen werden auf ihr Humorpotenzial hin überprüft und gegebenenfalls gewürdigt.

Provokante Themen und schwarzer Humor, fernab von Political Correctness und präsentiert mit dem sprühenden Charme der Abgeklärtheit. Gäste im Studio sind dieses Mal Reinhold Bilgeri, Erik Schinegger und Lizz Görgl.

pr.d: Zu Gast sind diesmal Teresa Reichl, Wolfgang Krebs und Tobias Mann. Während Teresa groben Unfug mit Feinsinn serviert, nimmt Wolfgang die Auftritte der Politiker unter die Lupe. Zudem findet Tobias selbst in schwierigen Zeiten ein Fünkchen Hoffnung.
pr.sub: Gäste: Teresa Reichl, Wolfgang Krebs und Tobias Mann

pr.d: Die ganze Klasse übernachtet in der Schule, um eine uralte Geisterlegende aufzuklären. Der Lehrer Stimpel will beweisen, dass es Spuk nicht gibt, aber Physik liefert nicht immer die beste Erklärung. Vor allem, wenn Gefühle und Sahra im Spiel sind.

Frank gibt einen gefühlvollen Liebesbrief von Robert als seinen aus und manövriert damit die kriselnde Beziehung mit Lisa-Britt wieder auf Wolke sieben. Trip geht bei Hausklaus in die Nachhilfe, um zu lernen, was einen echten Mann ausmacht.

Die Klasse ist so schlecht auf die Abschlussprüfung vorbereitet, dass es laut Osman nur noch eine Chance gibt, sie zu bestehen: Sie müssen die Prüfungsergebnisse klauen. Leider hat er die Rechnung ohne seinen Lehrer Stimpel gemacht.

Der große Abschlussball steht an und auch Lehrer Stimpel hat Großes vor: Er möchte Lisa-Britt einen Heiratsantrag machen - natürlich auf dem Schulball. Aber ist Lisa-Britt wirklich die Richtige oder soll er Ja zu seiner neuen Schule sagen?

pr.d: Das Bundesländermagazin Bilder aus Südtirol stellt in seinen Dokumentationen Südtirol vor. Dabei stehen die aktuellen gesellschaftspolitischen Geschehen, die Geschichte, der Tourismus, die Wirtschaft und die Kultur der Region im Fokus.

Es ist das Wasser aus den Alpen, das Österreich geprägt hat. Schnee und Gletscher versorgen unzählige Bäche, Flüsse und Bäche, die seit jeher fruchtbare Täler geformt und reichhaltige Lebensräume für Pflanzen und Tiere geschaffen haben.

Eine Reise in unbekannte, wilde Welten: Wasser ist nicht nur die Grundlage alles Lebens, es hat Österreich auch einige der spektakulärsten Naturwunder Europas geschenkt. Der Film begibt sich auf deren Spuren.

pr.t: Wilde Wasser, schroffe Grate - Unterwegs in der Reißeckgruppe
pr.d: Die Reißeckgruppe in Kärnten zählt zu den schönsten hochalpinen Bergmassiven Österreichs. Außerdem ist die Region als weitläufige Wandergegend sehr beliebt. Die Dokumentation porträtiert Menschen, die mit dieser Bergwelt verbunden sind.

Es wird das Leben der Menschen in den Gemeinden Kreuth in Bayern und Mauthen in Kärnten beleuchtet. Beide Dörfer sind Teil der Bergsteigerdörfer-Initiative des Alpenvereins und haben sich dazu verpflichtet, deren strenge Kriterien einzuhalten.
pr.sub: Bergsteigerdörfer in Bayern und Kärnten: Vom Leben in Kreuth und Mauthen

pr.d: Die scheinbar glücklich verheiratete Frau eines untreuen Immobilienmaklers will nach dem überraschenden Tod ihrer Schwester deren verwaister Tochter dabei helfen, einen verschuldeten Gasthof zu sanieren. Dabei kommt sie ihrem eigenen Mann in die Quere, der das Objekt hinter ihrem Rücken gemeinsam mit seiner jungen Geliebten an eine Investorengruppe verschachern will. Als der hinterhältige Plan zu scheitern droht, greift Kurt zu einem gemeinen Trick.

Nachdem Lena ihren zukünftigen Ehemann beim Seitensprung mit ihrer Brautjungfer erwischt hat, flüchtet sie nach Berlin, um dort die Backstube ihrer Tante Käthe zu übernehmen. Unter Lenas Leitung floriert der Laden wie nie zuvor. Und als sie in dem attraktiven Laurens Schneider zudem noch einen charmanten Verehrer findet, scheint die Welt wieder in Ordnung. Doch ihr Liebhaber entpuppt sich als der Großunternehmer, der ihre Konditorei übernehmen will, um eine Espressobar zu eröffnen.

Der Siegeszug des Zebus, auch Buckelrind genannt, ist eine Reise durch heiße, oftmals trockene, nur selten üppige Regionen. Das langgliedrige Rind hat sich an warme Klimazonen angepasst und zeichnet sich vor allem durch seinen Fettbuckel aus.

It's the final day of the competition in Gloucestershire, and the turn of exuberant hair salon owner Chris to host. Chris is hosting a high-octane evening with some special homemade treats on the menu.

Presenters Tim Lovejoy and Simon Rimmer mix a cookery show with a chat show, and the result is `Sunday Brunch.' Each installment finds Simon and Tim cooking in the kitchen, accompanied by that week's celebrity guests. Other segments include interviews and highlights from television and film, an expert who assists with drink tasting, a round-up of what is trendy, and the ever-popular `Sunday Brunch Playlist,' which consists of music videos chosen by the presenters and their guests. Guests have included Stacey Solomon, Lisa Faulkner, Tara Reid, Rufus Wainwright and Marina Diamandis.

Sam and Rebecca are dressed-up for the USS Constitution tour, but their respective dates cancel. Rebecca is reluctant to go with Sam, who brings Admiral William J Crowe from the tour and introduces him at the bar.
Lilith and Frasier bring a friend to Cheers. Since she is extremely attractive, Sam is immediately interested. He'll do everything to seduce her. Little does he know that he will soon be the victim.

Rebecca decides to smarten up her image and goes to Lilith for advice on power-dressing. Woody can't compete when it comes to expensive presents for Kelly and offers her a lacklustre song that he wrote as her gift.
When Rebecca's sister Susan visits, Sam discovers that the sisters have been enemies for years, and he schemes to exploit the jealousy they have for each other to get dates with them both.
The brothers fight when Ray has to face up to failure for once while Robert is promoted to lieutenant.
Ray runs into a girl who he disrespected when they dated in high school and ends up regretting an apology.
Frasier loses his cool when he finds out a rival radio host is stealing both his ratings and his agent.
Frasier intervenes when his father is belittled by his supervisor while working nights as a security guard, and a love-sick Roz regales Niles and Daphne with stories about her new boyfriend.

Homer and Grampa take to the road to sell Grampa's miracle passion potion, but old resentments resurface between father and son when they pass by their old house, and Bart and Milhouse wonder where all the grown-ups have gone.

When Homer is barred from Moe's he visits an airport bar where he is mistaken for a pilot. The airline offers him free tickets if he promises not to tell anyone that they almost let him fly a plane, but Marge freaks out on the plane, and it's up to psychoanalyst Dr Zweig to explain why.
Homer becomes a member of the Stonecutters secret society. He has to start at the bottom as Number 908, but then Number 1 sees something on Homer's bottom.
A kid discovers the secret headquarters of a powerful superhero hidden beneath his home and must defend it with his group of friends when villains attack.

This week's competition kicks off at Redmire Village Pub in North Yorkshire, where hosts Kerrie and Vickie hope the cosy vibes and stunning countryside setting will be a hit. But some bland decor ends up taking centre stage at feedback time.
People-pleaser Hollie and people-distruster Ben reckon their plush self-catering flats in the heart of the town centre will go down a storm. But the lack of free parking proves problematic.

Tabitha and Steve host the third visit of the competition at Copper Beech Glamping in Staffordshire. They've got a 'relax and recharge' ethos at their glampsite, with a tranquil rural setting and luxurious outdoor hot tubs.

The week's final visit is to Berkshire, where Ana and Dominic hope their homely pub, The Bull Inn, will charm the B&Bers with its quintessential character. First impressions are fantastic. But talk of the looming payment day raises tensions.
Payment day's sure to be a spicy affair this time around, with high emotions, awkward exchanges and plenty of pernickety comments to unpick. When the dust settles, who'll win the week?
The finalists make citrus celebration cakes, crème brûlée doughnuts and a tribute to iconic British landscapes. Who'll be the zest and be crowned the series winner?

Working for a highly funded yet unofficial government agency, Kay and Jay are the Men in Black, providers of immigration services and regulators of all things alien on Earth. While investigating a series of unregistered close encounters, the MIB agents uncover the deadly plot of an intergalactic terrorist who is on a mission to assassinate two ambassadors from opposing galaxies currently in residence in New York City.
Channel 4's flagship news programme. With sport and weather.

A festive ride on the 'Bernina Express', one of the most picturesque trains in the world, beginning in Chur, the oldest town in Switzerland, and travelling through the Alpine landscape to the town of Tirano in Italy.
Griff Rhys Jones takes on one of the world's most celebrated mountain ranges, travelling from France to Slovenia.
Lee McKenzie and Billy Monger present [QUALY] under the lights at Lusail. The titles may have been decided, but pole will be vital as Verstappen, Russell and Hamilton fight for second.

Prince Amleth is on the verge of becoming a man when his father is brutally murdered by his uncle, who kidnaps the boy's mother. Two decades later, Amleth is now a Viking who's on a mission to save his mother, kill his uncle and avenge his father.
Offering their unmatched satirical insight into current world events, Adam Hills, Josh Widdicombe and Alex Brooker are joined by Bella Hull to help dissect the biggest news stories of the week.

In his 1996 debut live stand-up show, Bill Bailey demonstrates the influence that Cockney music has had on the great classical composers, and warns of the perils of a world ruled by insects, while playing the second-biggest gong in Britain.
Based on the true story of a vicious killer who became a celebrity and best-selling author in Australia.

Homer becomes a member of the Stonecutters secret society. He has to start at the bottom as Number 908, but then Number 1 sees something on Homer's bottom.
A kid discovers the secret headquarters of a powerful superhero hidden beneath his home and must defend it with his group of friends when villains attack.

This week's competition kicks off at Redmire Village Pub in North Yorkshire, where hosts Kerrie and Vickie hope the cosy vibes and stunning countryside setting will be a hit. But some bland decor ends up taking centre stage at feedback time.
People-pleaser Hollie and people-distruster Ben reckon their plush self-catering flats in the heart of the town centre will go down a storm. But the lack of free parking proves problematic.

Tabitha and Steve host the third visit of the competition at Copper Beech Glamping in Staffordshire. They've got a 'relax and recharge' ethos at their glampsite, with a tranquil rural setting and luxurious outdoor hot tubs.

The week's final visit is to Berkshire, where Ana and Dominic hope their homely pub, The Bull Inn, will charm the B&Bers with its quintessential character. First impressions are fantastic. But talk of the looming payment day raises tensions.
Payment day's sure to be a spicy affair this time around, with high emotions, awkward exchanges and plenty of pernickety comments to unpick. When the dust settles, who'll win the week?
The finalists make citrus celebration cakes, crème brûlée doughnuts and a tribute to iconic British landscapes. Who'll be the zest and be crowned the series winner?

Working for a highly funded yet unofficial government agency, Kay and Jay are the Men in Black, providers of immigration services and regulators of all things alien on Earth. While investigating a series of unregistered close encounters, the MIB agents uncover the deadly plot of an intergalactic terrorist who is on a mission to assassinate two ambassadors from opposing galaxies currently in residence in New York City.
Channel 4's flagship news programme. With sport and weather.

A festive ride on the 'Bernina Express', one of the most picturesque trains in the world, beginning in Chur, the oldest town in Switzerland, and travelling through the Alpine landscape to the town of Tirano in Italy.
Griff Rhys Jones takes on one of the world's most celebrated mountain ranges, travelling from France to Slovenia.
Lee McKenzie and Billy Monger present [QUALY] under the lights at Lusail. The titles may have been decided, but pole will be vital as Verstappen, Russell and Hamilton fight for second.

Meanwhile, Phoebe regrets bringing Monica to a karaoke night when she takes the microphone and delights in the applause, unaware that the men in the audience are cheering because they can see through her dress, and Joey submits to painful eyebrow waxing.

Joey and Phoebe conspire to arrange awful dates for both Rachel and Ross, hoping that appreciation of their former relationship will push them back together. Meanwhile, the ovulating Monica wants to get intimate with Chandler.
pr.sub: The One With the Blind Dates

pr.d: Joey stumbles upon a way to impress a famous actor during an audition, Ross learns the identity of a long-ago mugger, and Chandler accepts an internship at a shoe company.
Monica secretly asks Joey for a loan because she and Chandler are strapped for cash, Phoebe invites her boyfriend to move in with her, and Rachel's apartment baby-proofing drives Joey crazy.
pr.sub: The One With the Boob Job

pr.d: When Chandler jokingly posts an outrageous biography about Ross on Ross' college alumni website, Ross retaliates in kind, sparking an internet war. Meanwhile, Monica gets extremely vigilant after a weak-willed Phoebe asks for help to stop her from contacting Mike after their relationship ends.
pr.sub: The One With the Memorial Service

pr.d: Hoping to win a huge jackpot, the friends pool their money and buy dozens of lottery tickets, but they argue over how to spend the fortune if they win, and Monica irritates everyone else by buying tickets just for her and Chandler. Exasperated, Phoebe takes the bowl of everyone's tickets and threatens to throw it off the balcony. The others make up, but a pigeon startles Phoebe.

Spice Girl and presenter Emma Bunton hands over her phone to play Send to All, Judge Rinder is the first celebrity to be woken up in the dead of night in Midnight Game show, breakthrough singer-songwriter Freya Ridings performs her song 'Castles'.
A visit to the set of a soap opera inspires Rachel to dream of a romantic encounter with Joey, and Chandler must take Ross on a weekend getaway after Monica is unable to take time off from work.

Ross is excited when he meets a stunning palaeontology professor, but when he takes her to Joey's rooftop party for the actor's soap-opera co-stars, she intimidates him with her impressive list of former boyfriends. Meanwhile, Rachel and an intoxicated Monica make fools of themselves at the party chasing after the hunky daytime actors.
pr.sub: The One With the Soap Opera Party

pr.d: Monica and Chandler have an embarrassing encounter with an old acquaintance at a fertility clinic, Ross plays Cyrano to help Joey woo a professor, and Rachel sneaks into a spa for a massage hoping Phoebe won't find out.
pr.sub: The One With the Fertility Test

pr.d: Disappointed to learn that they cannot conceive a baby naturally, Monica and Chandler consider their options. When Chandler invites a handsome colleague round for dinner, Monica and Chandler embarrassingly interview him as a potential sperm donor. Meanwhile, while shopping with Phoebe, Rachel admits that she still has a thing for Joey.
The gang heads to Barbados for a palaeontology convention where Ross is the keynote speaker. Rachel harbours steamy thoughts about Joey while David prepares to propose to Phoebe.

While the friends are still in Barbados, Joey tries to tell Ross about his feelings for Rachel and Ross wants to confess to kissing Joey's girlfriend Charlie, but it is easier said than done. Meanwhile, Monica, Chandler and Phoebe can hear their amorous conversations through the hotel's paper-thin walls. Also, Monica's hair problems go from bad to worse, and Phoebe has some bad news for Mike's girlfriend on her birthday.
pr.sub: The One After Joey & Rachel Kiss

pr.d: Ross drinks too much wine while dining with Rachel, Joey and Charlie. Elsewhere, Frank Jr cannot cope with his precocious triplets and pays Phoebe a visit.
pr.sub: The One Where Ross Is Fine

pr.d: Rachel and Joey nervously anticipate their first real date, Monica and Phoebe try to avoid an obnoxious friend with a fake British accent, and Ross emerges from a tanning booth with a two-toned appearance.
Rachel gets Monica and Chandler to delay their long-awaited trip to Vermont for Emma's first birthday bash, but problems ensue when Emma falls asleep and a racy cake turns up.

Rachel regrets trusting her self-indulgent little sister Amy with Emma, Monica regrets asking Joey to write a recommendation letter to the child adoption agency for her, and Phoebe accidentally thwarts the anniversary surprise Mike has in store for her.
pr.sub: The One Where Rachel's Sister Baby-Sits

Ladybug kommt nie zur Ruhe. Sie sieht sich gezwungen, ihre Kräfte mit Cat Noir zu vereinen, dem maskierten Rächer, der kein Blatt vor den Mund nimmt. Gemeinsam stellen sie sich Hawk Moth und seinem Team von Superschurken entgegen, die das Ziel haben, Paris zu zerstören. Was die Heldin Marinette nicht weiß, ist, dass sich hinter der Maske von Cat Noir eine Person verbirgt, die sie sehr gut kennt.

Stitch ist das grauenhafte Ergebnis eines Experiments. Noch dazu ist das Tier aggressiv, weshalb sein Schöpfer es vom Planeten Turo verbannen will. Stitch gelingt jedoch die Flucht, und er landet auf der Insel Hawaii. Dort trifft er auf ein kleines Mädchen namens Lilo, die ebenfalls eine Außenseiterin ist. Sie ist besessen davon, sich um hilfsbedürftige Tiere zu kümmern. Ohne zu wissen, welche Kraft das putzige Wesen besitzt, wünscht sie sich Stitch als Haustier.

pr.t: Santa Clause 2: Eine noch schönere Bescherung
pr.d: Der Nordpol versinkt im Chaos, während Santa Clause auf der Erde die perfekte Frau sucht. Außerdem muss er sich vor Ort auch um seinen Sohn kümmern, was leichter gesagt ist als getan. Währenddessen führt am Nordpol jemand anderes die Geschäfte. Ein böses Duplikat hat seine Stelle eingenommen und regiert nun ganz und gar nicht mehr im Sinne von Weihnachten. Santa Clause muss sich entscheiden, ob er seine Pflicht wahrnehmen und zum Nordpol zurückkehren will, um Weihnachten zu retten.

Gordon Ramsay revisits Café Hon in Hampden, Maryland, Chiarella's in Philadelphia, and Leone's in Montclair, New Jersey, to see whether the restaurant owners have taken his advice on board.

Gordon heads to the historic Olde Hitching Post in Hanson, Massachusetts, where he meets an owner so stubborn and set in his ways that he doesn't realise he's the reason his restaurant is losing money. Owner Tom bought the business for his daughter Andrea, but six years later he is still refusing to let her run it. Gordon must fight a controlling boss who doesn't react well to his criticism.

In Beaver, Pennsylvania, where he finds a brother-and-sister team who are unable to work together positively at an Italian restaurant called Levanti's. Their relationship is so fractured that they are failing to save their father's business from being overwhelmed by competition from other local eateries. The situation has become desperate, and dad Tony is now in danger of losing his life savings.

Gordon visits family-owned restaurant Sam's Mediterranean Kabob Room in Monrovia, California. Within minutes of his arrival, Gordon is caught in the crossfire of an argument between owner Sam, his wife and their children, all of whom are feeling the pressure of working in the restaurant seven days a week.

Gordon heads to Long Beach, California, to save Nino's, an Italian family restaurant that was opened in 1958 and is now under the misguided leadership of the eldest son, Nino. Younger brother Michael and sister Carina point the finger of blame for the restaurant's failings directly at Nino, and their 78-year-old mother Inge is desperate for Nino to turn the business around.

Detective Scott Turner is an uptight, by-the-book police officer who hopes to leave his sleepy California town and work in the big city. When his friend Amos Reed, the proprietor of a junkyard, is killed, Turner reluctantly inherits the man's dog. Realising that the canine may be able to help him solve the murder case, Turner attempts to adjust to life with the big dog, resulting in much household destruction and unwelcome chaos.
After Homer gets sick from a giant sandwich he's been eating for months, Aunt Selma steps in to take the kids to a new alcohol-based theme park, with near-disastrous consequences.

When Homer is late picking up Bart from a school football game, Bart protests by hooking himself up with Tom, a surrogate dad from an agency. Stung by being jilted by his own son, Homer gets into a monster brawl with Tom that even makes the news.

Valentine's Day comes to Springfield and Lisa takes pity on Ralph and gives him a card, but when Ralph falls in love with Lisa their friendship turns bad, causing a bitter feud to break out between the two families.

After Homer fails a breathalyser test-driving home from a visit to the Duff brewery, he is forced to quit drinking for a month. Meanwhile, Lisa buys a hamster for her school science project, in order to prove that Bart is dumber than a rodent.

Homer takes on Mr Burns in a labour struggle that rapidly spirals out of control. When Homer leads the workers out on strike, Mr Burns retaliates by hiring robots to replace them and shutting off power to the city.

Host Jimmy Carr and team captains Jon Richardson and Sean Lock are joined by Mel Giedroyc, Johnny Vegas, Kym Marsh and Aisling Bea in this edition.
Host Jimmy Carr and team captains Jon Richardson and Sean Lock are joined by special guests Alex Jones, Alex Brooker, Sarah Millican, and James Acaster.
A fearless new suitor pushes Natalie's limits. David ends his day by receiving a foot massage and a back massage from two naked women, who give each other evils the whole time.
After dating a few love rats, beautician Gemma wants to find her Prince Charming. Tattoo artist Jennafer is fed up with men and is looking for the perfect woman.
Brand new series - Ringworm: When it's revealed that a student has ringworm, the faculty must band together to stop it from spreading through the entire school.
P.S. I Hate You: Marge's reputation as Springfield's nicest resident is jeopardised when her secret stash of vitriolic letters is stolen during a house party.
The Pina Colada Episode: Murray and Geoff try to pull Beverly, Barry and Erica out of their shared misery after Lainey's departure. Coach Nick returns to town.
I Coulda Been a Lawyer: Beverly campaigns for a new stop sign on the street. Barry panics about his college applications, and Murray's attempt to help makes things worse.
Major League'd: Adam is terrified when he and his friends are recruited to the school baseball team. Geoff's father interferes in his relationship with Erica.
Catch of the Day: Phil is convinced he's going to have a bad luck day after failing to complete his daily superstition. Mitch is certain that Cam is undermining him.
Sex, Lies, and Kickball: Jay's best friend, Shorty, returns from Costa Rica and stays at the house so that they can reconnect. And Alex is ready to shed her good-girl image.
It's the Great Pumpkin, Phil Dunphy: Phil and Claire want to celebrate Halloween in a big way, but no one else seems to share their enthusiasm for it.
Rachel and Adam look back on their unforgettable 1980s Aussie soap wedding. Does Rachel appreciate the effort Adam went to especially for her?
Rude Tube's wee sister has been let loose on the internet, where she's found you some very cheeky - if a bit less rude - clips, including the best golf fail ever and dancing squirrels.
Rash Decisions: Phil feels the teenage cold shoulder from Luke, and Andy - who's been hanging around a lot as Phil's apprentice - steps in as his new right-hand man.
Valentine's Day 4: Twisted Sister: On Valentine's Day, Claire is worried that Phil may be more into her alter-ego Juliana than her.
Fight or Flight: After a reunion weekend with Phil's old buddies, Claire jumps at the chance to snag the only first-class seat left on the flight home, leaving Phil in coach.
Connection Lost: Claire's computer becomes the hub of all the family's activities when she gets stuck at the airport and is desperate to reach Haley after a big fight.
The Big Ibizan Zoo One: How will party fanatic Sonny's bride Jazmin greet his plans for a zoo-themed Ibizan beach party wedding with everyone covered in animal-print body paint?
The One in the Sky: The sky's the limit for adrenaline junkie Jai who plans to have a wedding in the sky, even though his bride-to-be Leanne is terrified of heights.
Gordon revisits Café Hon in Baltimore, Chiarella's in Philadelphia, and Leone's in New Jersey, to find out whether the owners have taken his advice on board.
Olde Hitching Post: Gordon visits the historic Olde Hitching Post restaurant in Massachusetts. Tom bought the business for his daughter but refuses to let her run it.
Levanti's: Gordon visits Pennsylvania, where he meets siblings whose inability to work together is risking their father's life savings at his Italian restaurant, Levanti's.
Sam's Mediterranean Kabob Room: In California, Gordon visits Sam's Mediterranean Kabob Room, where he tries to mend relationships between the owner, his wife and their children.
Nino's: Gordon visits Long Beach in California to save Nino's, a failing Italian restaurant that opened in 1958 and is now under the misguided leadership of eldest son Nino.
(1989) Comedy-thriller starring Tom Hanks. A cop investigates a murder to which there's just one witness: Hooch, a slobbering, beer-drinking French mastiff, who now needs 24/7 protection.
Selma's Choice: After Homer gets sick from a giant sandwich he's been eating for months, Selma steps in to take the kids to a new alcohol-based theme park.
Brother from the Same Planet: When Homer is late picking up Bart from a school football game, Bart gets a surrogate dad from an agency.
I Love Lisa: On Valentine's Day, Lisa takes pity on Ralph and gives him a card. But when he falls in love with her, it leads to a bitter feud between their families.
Duffless: Homer fails a breathalyser test while driving home from the Duff brewery and has to quit drinking for a month.
Last Exit to Springfield: Homer takes on Mr Burns in a labour struggle that rapidly spirals out of control after Homer leads the workers on strike.
The stars of It's A Sin join Paul Hollywood, Prue Leith, Matt Lucas and Noel Fielding to celebrate Christmas. And the London Community Gospel Choir perform All I Want for Christmas.
On the Christmas box: Michael McIntyre's Christmas Wheel, First Dates at Christmas, Strictly the Real Full Monty, Love Actually, World's Strongest Man, Elves, and No Time to Die.

It's the fight for the fish course, as three of the North East's finest chefs - Mini Patel, Michael O'Hare and Tim Allen - are out to impress. After his risky starter caused a stir yesterday Michael is planning another controversial dish in honour of the WI's support of women's rights.

It's the North East chefs' last chance to impress with the dessert course. It's been a week of highs and lows, modern audacious dishes and classic masterpieces but with only two places up for grabs cooking for the judges, at the end of today who will leave the competition empty-handed?

The two remaining North East chefs must cook all four courses again for the judges - Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. They're joined by a guest judge - WI president Kirsty Bowen from Sheffield - who will help decide which chef will go through to represent the North East in the National Finals.

Representing the North West are Eve Townson, Matt Worswick and returning contender Mark Ellis. Today's the starter course, and after failing to cook for the judges last year Mark's out to redeem himself, but he faces stiff competition in executive chef Eve and young gun Matt.

It's the fish course, as three of the North West's finest chefs - Eve Townson, Matt Worswick and Mark Ellis - go head-to-head. Eve and Matt are hoping their classic approach to cooking fish will win the day whilst Mark is going all out with a fishy take on a traditional dessert recipe.

It's the battle for the main course for the three North West chefs - Eve Townson, Matt Worswick and Mark Ellis. Mark remains determined and focused on his battle to get to judges chamber this year, but as the pressure to plate up perfection reaches fever pitch, will all three chefs get a dish to the pass?
It's the North West chefs' last chance to impress, with the dessert course. Only two can cook for the judges tomorrow. It's the end of the road for one chef, but who will it be?

The two remaining North West chefs cook their entire menus again for the judges Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. They're joined by award-winning food writer Sabrina Ghayour, and together they'll decide which chef will go on to represent the North West in the National Finals.

It's the starter course for three of London and the South East's hottest chefs - Matt Gillan, Lee Westcott and Marcus Wareing's protégé Mark Froydenlund. Returning contender Matt Gillan is determined to make it to this year's banquet, but he faces fierce competition in the two newcomers.

The London and South East chefs - Matt Gillan, Lee Westcott and Marcus Wareing's protégé Mark Froydenlund - go head-to-head with their fish courses. Lee is hoping his modern plate of mackerel and passion fruit will outclass Matt and Mark's more traditionally inspired salmon dishes.

It's a battle for the main course for three of London and the South East's finest chefs - Matt Gillan, Lee Westcott and Mark Froydenlund. Returning contender Matt is determined to bring home a 10 with his ambitious celebration of the billy goat but has he bitten off more than he can chew?

It's dessert day and the London and South East chefs are striving to secure one of the two spots in tomorrow's Regional Final. The scores are close, so it's all to play for, as today marks the end of the competition for one man.

The two remaining London and South East chefs are cooking all four courses again for the judges - Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. They're joined by Mary Gwynn, author of the official WI centenary cookbook. Together they'll decide which chef goes through to represent the region in the National Finals.

Three of the Central Region's finest chefs - Pip Lacey, Richard Bainbridge and Jason Hodnett - attempt to impress this week's veteran judge with their starters. With big boots to fill, Angela Hartnett's protégé Pip is the only newcomer in the kitchen. Will she beat the boys to claim victory?

The three Central Region chefs - newcomer Pip Lacey, 4th time competitor Richard Bainbridge and returning chef Jason Hodnett - fight it out in the fish course. Pip is hoping to outclass her rivals with a smoked haddock dish inspired by her Grandma.
It's a battle for the main course with three Central Region chefs - Pip Lacey, Richard Bainbridge and Jason Hodnett. Once again Jason is taking risks with his unusual collection of ingredients.

It's the last chance for the Central Region chefs to impress, with the dessert course. Only two chefs can go through to cook for the judges so with everything to play for, who will plate up perfection and who will be sent packing?

The two remaining Central Region chefs cook their entire menus again for the judges - Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. They'll be joined by former chair of the Women's Institute Helen Carey, who will help decide who will have the glory of representing the region in the National Finals.

It's the starter course, and eight of the finest chefs in the country are battling it out to plate up impeccable dishes worthy of the Women's Institute. The judges are joined by WI Calendar Girl Angela Baker, but after Oliver reveals that this year it will be much tougher to make it onto the judge's shortlist, who will keep their cool and secure a place?

It's the battle for the fish course. Those who failed to make it to the shortlist with their starters are hoping to do better. The judges are joined by Kristy Bowen, who knows the impeccable standards the WI will expect.

It's main course day, the half-way point in Finals Week, and those chefs who have yet to get a dish on the shortlist are feeling the heat. With only dishes judged to be perfect in with a chance at reaching the WI banquet, the standards are higher than ever before.

It's the last chance for the eight regional champions to get a dish in contention for the final banquet. Those who failed to make it to the shortlist are going all out. The judges are joined by Mary Gwynn, the author of the WI centenary cookbook.
The banquet is finally here. It's the culmination of months of hard work as the winning chefs strive to plate up perfect dishes for the Women's Institute ladies at London's historic Draper's Hall.

Three top chefs from Scotland are out to impress this week's veteran judge and be crowned Scottish champion. Adam Handling has already won a number of industry awards and is full of confidence. His starter sets out to take the diner on a tour of the UK's best producers. He's up against Michael Bremner, who is hoping to impress with contemporary ingredients including Birch sap and Douglas fir oil. Ally McGrath is celebrating his nation's finest produce and making his very own version of haggis.
Three newcomers to the competition create their fish dishes in a bid to be crowned Scottish champion. The standard is so high the veteran judge is moved to tears.

Ally McGrath has been keeping the veteran judge entertained with his very individual approach. Also, the highly competitive Adam Handling has been showcasing the finest produce grown and caught in and around the UK in his menu. Once again Michael Bremner is out to show how inventive he can be.

One chef will go home, and today the veteran judge finds himself with a difficult decision to make. Inventive chef Michael Bremner is recreating the Scottish desserts of his childhood, Adam Handling is sticking with his trademark Asian flavours and Ally McGrath is tempering chocolate for the very first time.

Scotland's two highest scoring chefs are cooking for the judges for the very first time. Both chefs have decided to make changes to some of their dishes, taking on board criticisms made during the week by the veteran judge.

Chef Josh Eggleton is back for a third time. Last year he made the national finals when his starter was shortlisted for the banquet, this year he intends to go one step further and cook at the banquet. One of his rivals last time, Jude Kereama is also back and out to do better than he did previously. The third competitor is newcomer Chris Wheeler who is originally from Swanage in Dorset.

There are some exciting dishes on the menu as the three chefs from the South West tackle the fish course. Chef Josh Eggleton is hoping to impress with an original take on Bolognese, just one of six elements on his complex fish dish.

It is the main course and chef Chris Wheeler is out to show just how theatrical he can be, and his ideas are surprising everyone in the kitchen. No one knows quite what to expect, and the veteran chef is hoping it tastes as good as it looks.

It is the dessert course, and it is Josh Eggleton who has come up with the most ambitious dessert. He is creating his own self-serve ice cream made from vegetables, and making everything from scratch including toppings and syrups.

It is the head to head and the South West region's two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort. They are joined by guest judge, journalist and restaurant critic, Grace Dent.

Two newcomers to the competition are challenging reigning North West champion Matt Worswick. Adam Reid is head chef at Manchester's Midland hotel and Kim Woodward, who made history when she was appointed Head Chef at the Savoy Grill.

It is the fish course and reigning North West champion Matt Worswick has reason to be confident. However, Kim's confident she has got one up on Matt by baking her own black bread unlike Matt who's taking a shortcut.

It is the main course of the North West regional heat and the scores mean this is a crucial round. Matt Worswick may be the reigning champion, but he is not yet assured of a place cooking for the judges, and he is feeling the strain.

It's the dessert course and the three North West competitors are getting creative, producing some of the most original and stunning desserts. All three chefs are working in a hot kitchen, the tension is palpable, and this time one chef will go home.

The two chefs are cooking for judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton, and guest judge Lady Claire MacDonald OBE. There are standout dishes from both chefs making it a difficult contest to judge.

The APRA collaborate with the mayor of West Point, Kentucky to investigate of the riverside town. The team assesses paranormal activity in two purportedly haunted locations: the Lynch House and Hardy Hotel.

APRA ambitiously conducts its most ambitious investigation to date, a full-scale paranormal experiment during a once-in-a-lifetime eclipse in two West Point, KY paranormal hotspots rife with claims, Fort Duffield and the Ditto House.
Study a strange physical scratch that could be linked to a haunting love story.
Visit Morrison Lodge, a Masonic hall where spectres often roam the corridors.
A guide for a ghost tour is surprised to learn there is more truth to the stories he tells than he originally believed; a man turns a childhood tormented by ghosts into an interesting career.
Step inside spooky Ashmore Estates and uncover a haunting with a purpose.
Find a shocking connection in a theatre plagued by paranormal activity.

In Union Springs, Alabama, the team investigates the infamous Pauly Jail. Chilling voices echo through the cells as spirits desperate to be heard make their presence known, hinting that something has been waiting all along.
Savannah's Sorrel-Weed House is tied to the legend of Matilda Sorrel. But when Shane, Dave, and Cindy investigate, what they uncover suggests that the story runs much deeper.

At a shrine where all faiths converge, the team uncovers a tear in its spiritual shield. As energies collide and secrets surface, a powerful ritual leaves Dave forever changed and reveals the haunting cost of opening every door.
In Williamson, West Virginia, the team steps inside the Old Hospital on College Hill, a place where reports of childlike laughter and shadows in the halls have left the owners searching for answers.
Paramedic Stacey encounters an oppressive presence at the scene of a suicide, Chris hears a ghost in an empty school building, and Patrick comes across a grim reaper at an old hospital.
pr.sub: Taken Over; School Ghouls; Fear the Reaper

pr.d: A police officer chases a ghostly intruder, a father's spirit watches out for a baby after a car crash, and a first responder receives an icy slap in the face from an unseen entity.
pr.sub: Phantom Footsteps; Over The Edge; Ghost Smack

pr.d: An emergency technician finds a collection of scary mannequins at a home, a first responder hears the voice of a dead woman, and a police officer investigates strange goings-on in an attic.
pr.sub: Mannequin Mayhem; The Voice; Someone To Watch Over Me

pr.d: Alex Heidbreder, a prison officer at 200-year-old prison, gets an emergency call for a prisoner in severe distress and finds a prisoner frantically screaming for help; EMT Cory Carmichael rushes to help a man reportedly suffering from a seizure.

A prison guard hears unnerving noises and sees ominous shadows while on patrol, an unseen force repels first responders at the scene of a suspicious suicide and an EMT encounters the anguished spirit of man at a roadside hotel.
pr.sub: Death Row Ghost, Dead for Days and Motel Suicide Spirit

pr.d: A rookie EMT sees flickering lights and hears strange noises after an elderly patient dies, and a man's spirit watches over paramedics as they attempt to save him on Christmas Eve.
pr.sub: Fire Station Spirit and Don't Die at Christmas

pr.d: Paranormal investigator Erin Goodpipe heads to Harrisville, Rhode Island to get the bottom of the rumours surrounding the witch, Bathsheba Sherman.
Paranormal investigator Erin Goodpipe tries to see who haunts Old Arnold Estate.
pr.sub: Who is Haunting the Old Arnold Estate?

pr.d: Spirits seek to feed off of the energy and emotions of unsuspecting patients and medical workers.
Exploring the unsettling phenomenon of child ghosts and the chilling consequences when medical facilities become their playgrounds.

Dark energy can turn long-term care facilities into hubs of elevated paranormal activity, where the souls of some residents hang around immediately after death and a foreboding presence makes a nurse's aide uneasy.
Discovering why trauma binds the dead to the living, a nurse believes cold spots and odd noises are coming from a patient's stuck spirit, and a ghost cannot exit a hospital café.
Two people who have been to the other side tell of the supernatural experiences surrounding their own deaths.
Barbara and Elsie both get ghostly messages from their long-dead fathers, and those messages save their mothers' lives.
pr.sub: My Dad's Ghost Saved My Mom's Life

pr.d: The open highway becomes a journey into the unexplained when Paul and Diana encounter angelic beings that change their lives.
Victor and Katrina fight back against the malignant spirits threatening their homes, and even their lives.
After having supernatural experiences as children, Charlotte and Tamara both continue to see ghosts for the rest of their lives.
Three friends experience the supernatural in different ways, with different responses to the strange things they've seen.
Follow Paul and Diana along the highway, where they encounter angelic beings.
Deborah and Jay both come from families that see spirits, and both have had ghostly encounters of their own.
A friendly ghost influences Stephen to end his marriage, while a malicious ghost makes Chris decide to move.
Lesley is traumatised when her father doesn't believe she's seen a ghost, while young Lance's family takes it in their stride when he sees a phantom in an old dormitory.

Ghosts linger in small-town America, and the locations of former battlegrounds are ripe for paranormal experiences. The American Civil War, the deadliest conflict in US history, has given rise to many haunted battlegrounds.

Professor Alice Roberts tells the story of Edwardian Britain by visiting Cardiff, which grew rich selling the coal that powered the Empire. Alice hears the stories of the Edwardian miners and their backbreaking and often dangerous work.

Professor Alice Roberts explores the English Civil War through the history of Oxford, the city at the heart of a battle between an autocratic king and his rebellious parliament. Oxford became the power base for Charles I and his royalist supporters.
Alice enjoys a Roman feast in Britain's most Roman city, Chester. She examines a radical theory on the Romans' plans for the city and explores an incredible archaeological find deep underground.

No matter when or where the conflict, truth often becomes the first casualty of war. John A Kantara looks at how war propaganda has used a variety of tools to spread particular narratives, including paintings, television, and social media.
A look at how religion has served as a reliable tool to brandish political power over thousands of years and been the catalyst for war, conflict, and persecution, from the Crusades to witch hunts.

In the battle between truth and lies, money has often played a decisive role, from Julius Caesar to the Koch brothers, and nothing seems to be safe from its power and the influence of those who possess wealth.

Scandals have accompanied human history since ancient times, and every lie comes with the risk of being exposed and creating a scandal big enough to send shock waves through a society and trigger social upheaval.

Conspiracy theories feed on basic human impulses like fear and insecurity. From Mozart to JFK and QAnon to COVID-19, conspiracies emerge from anywhere at any time and spread by all means available, with the potential for danger and destruction.
History has produced a steady stream of influencers, from apostles to ad men and doctors to despots. Each in their own way, is proof of just how fluid and fragile the truth can be.

Jack reist nach Nevada, wo sich hinter der Fassade eines unscheinbaren Hauses ein Piratenschatz verbirgt. Danach besucht er ein außergewöhnliches Wohnhaus auf einer Brücke und entdeckt zum Abschluss in New Orleans ein Haus mit bewegter Vergangenheit.

Jack beginnt seine Reise in Nebraska mit einem aufwendig renovierten Raketensilo. Anschließend besichtigt er ein märchenhaftes Cottage mit Hollywood-Bezug und besucht zum Abschluss in Las Vegas ein außergewöhnliches Paradies für Autofans.

In Santa Barbara steht ein Haus, dessen Gestaltung von der Unterwasserwelt inspiriert ist. Danach geht es nach Nebraska zu einem außergewöhnlichen Gebäude aus Metall und Glas. In Las Vegas gibt es ein Wohnhaus ganz im Stil von Comic-Helden.

Die Reise beginnt in Lake Las Vegas mit einem Anwesen im europäischen Stil. Danach führt sie ihn nach Nebraska zu einem architektonischen „Googie"-Klassiker und endet an den Stränden von Destin in Florida, wo ein echtes Wohnhighlight wartet.

Nachdem sie das Schlimmste vom Schlimmsten ausgewählt hat, gibt Retta bekannt, welches hässliche Haus von der Designerin Alison Victoria für 150.000 Dollar renoviert wird. Die Hausbesitzer werden die erstaunliche Verwandlung sehen.
Inmitten der Berge Amerikas findet Retta drei hässliche Häuser, die einer Renovierung bedürfen.
pr.sub: Realer Irrsinn in den Rocky Mountains

pr.d: Retta macht sich auf den Weg in den Sunshine State, um sich ein Anwesen anzusehen.

Der Motorradverkäufer Josh gewinnt mit einem Rubbellos fünf Millionen Dollar. Damit will er sich einen Wunsch erfüllen und sich ein Haus mit großem Grundstück in Kalifornien kaufen, wo es Platz für seine Familie, für Tiere und Motorräder gibt.

Angela und Rey aus Richmond, Virginia, wollen von einem Teil ihres Gewinns von einer Million Dollar ein Ferienhaus am Meer mit viel Platz kaufen. Dort wollen sie dann mit ihren Töchtern und Enkeln ihren Ruhestand genießen.

Keith und Kate wünschen sich ein Tiny House am Wasser und haben 200.000 US-Dollar zur Verfügung. Neben dieser Voraussetzung sind die beiden sich allerdings eher uneinig. Die Hochzeitsfotografen wollen sich von ihren ehemaligen Pflichten befreien.

Der Hochzeitsfotograf Jadon und die Grafikdesignerin Katie sind viel mobil unterwegs und suchen ein Tiny House zum Pendeln. Während sich Jadon ein rustikales Haus wünscht, hat Katie ein modernes und weißes Eigenheim vor Augen.

Die Lebensmittelwissenschaftlerin Ashley wünscht sich ein minimalistisches Haus mit wenig Platz. Sie reist viel, weshalb sie ihr eigentliches Haus untervermietet. In ihrem Tiny House wünscht sie sich ausreichen Platz zum Kochen und Gäste empfangen.

Shawn und Kari helfen der 18-jährigen Jaden, ein Tiny House in Fort Collins zu finden. Sie ist zwar angehende Studentin, möchte aber eher ungern in einem Studentenwohnheim wohnen. Sie wünscht sich ein modernes Landhaus, das wie eine Hütte wirkt.

Lucy braucht aufgrund ihrer Berufsreisen kein Mietshaus mehr und will ein Minihaus kaufen. Ihre Freundin Eileen hilft ihr dabei, ein Haus im Industrie-Chic-Style zu finden für maximal 60.000 US-Dollar. Lucy hat allerdings Platzangst.

Ein Ehepaar folgt einem Jobangebot nach Johor Bahru, Malaysia. Sie wollen zeigen, dass man sich mit einem Baby nicht an einem Ort niederlassen muss. Einig sind sie sich, dass das üppige Grün im Ort besser für ihren Sohn ist als schmutzige Stadtluft.
pr.sub: Mit Kind und Kegel nach Malaysia

pr.d: Nach einem Urlaub in Costa Rica fasst ein Paar einen Beschluss. Sie wollen dort leben, wo das Klima mild, der Strand traumhaft und der Lebensstil entspannt ist. Doch erst müssen sie sich entscheiden, welche Art von Zuhause sie sich wünschen.

Familie Armour steht wegen des Militär-Jobs des Vaters mal wieder vor einem großen Umzug. Dieses Mal soll es von Kalifornien nach Kaiserslautern gehen. Der Makler sucht nach einem riesigen Miethaus mit Garten, aber das ist gar nicht so einfach.

Bill und Elena, zwei Werbe-Unternehmer aus Dallas, zieht es nach Marokko. Sie möchten näher bei Elenas Mutter in Spanien sein. Elena möchte dabei in der geschäftigen Medina leben, während Bill eine Dachterrasse mit Meerblick wünscht.

Kelly drückt die Reset-Taste. Nach ihrer Scheidung möchte sie ganz neu anfangen - in Bocas del Toro, dem Venedig der Karibik. Auf ihrer Wunschliste stehen drei Zimmer, weil sie von zu Hause aus arbeitet, sowie Meerblick und eine große Küche.
Diese Sendung wirbt für verschiedene Produkte, die man sich bequem nach Hause schicken lassen kann.

Mit dem nahenden Winter läuft auf dem Château die Zeit davon. Dick und Angel möchten möglichst viele Bauprojekte vor dem Kälteeinbruch abschließen und genießen gleichzeitig die gemütlichen Seiten der französischen Wintersaison.

Dick und Angel laden zu ihrem traditionellen Weihnachtsfest für alle Helfer ein und bereiten aufwändige Menüs sowie liebevoll gestaltete Geschenke vor. Ein überraschender winterlicher Höhepunkt rundet das Jahr stimmungsvoll ab.

pr.t: Unser Traum vom Schloss: Tipps und Tricks
pr.d: Während Angel aus alten Fotos der vorangegangenen Generationen eine Fototapete basteln möchte, ist Dick damit beschäftigt einen Teich im Obst- und Gemüsegarten anzulegen. So sollen Frösche und Kröten in den Garten gelockt werden.
pr.sub: Ein Piano für Jung und Alt

pr.t: Unser Traum vom Schloss: Tipps und Tricks
pr.d: Dick und Angel helfen einem Ehepaar dabei, ihren Garten in einen prächtigen Boho-Garten zu verwandeln. Darüber hinaus lassen sie den Traum eines anderen Ehepaares vom Campingurlaub wahr werden und helfen ihnen bei der Renovierung eines Wohnwagens.

Eva Longoria überrascht ihre beste Freundin mit einer Renovierung. Gemeinsam mit Jonathan und Drew verwandelt sie die Wohnbereiche in einen stilvollen und vielseitigen Treffpunkt für gemeinsame Abende.

Emma Roberts schließt sich mit Jonathan und Drew zusammen, um ihre ehrenamtliche Tante Mela mit einer individuell gestalteten Küchentransformation zu überraschen. Nach einem Leben voller Wohltätigkeit soll Mela einen vielseitigen Raum bekommen.

Jay Leno wendet sich an Jonathan und Drew, um seinem engen Freund ein besonderes Geschenk zu machen. Da ein Kind unterwegs ist, möchte Jay die wachsende Familie mit einem renovierten Badezimmer und einem gemütlichen Kinderzimmer überraschen.
Drei schaurige Häuser im amerikanischen Heartland kämpfen um eine Renovierung im Wert von 150.000 Dollar durch Alison Victoria.
In den Appalachen treten drei unheimliche Häuser gegeneinander an und hoffen auf eine Renovierung im Wert von 150.000 Dollar durch Alison Victoria.
Ein verlassenes Lagerhaus mit einer rätselhaften Überraschung tritt gegen ein heimgesuchtes viktorianisches Bestattungsinstitut und ein gruseliges Haus mit tödlicher Dekoration an.
Drei der unheimlichsten Häuser der Great-Lakes-Region treten gegeneinander an und hoffen auf eine Renovierung im Wert von 150.000 Dollar durch Alison Victoria.

Die Reise zu Amerikas gruseligsten Häusern erreicht ihren Höhepunkt. Retta kürt den Gewinner der Staffel, bevor Alison Victoria das Siegerhaus mit einer Renovierung im Wert von 150.000 Dollar vollständig verwandelt.

An der Küste von North Hutchinson Island in Florida sucht ein verlobtes Paar aus Jacksonville seinen ersten gemeinsamen Rückzugsort. Nachdem sie das passende Haus gefunden haben, warten jedoch einige Herausforderungen auf sie.

Ein Paar aus San Diego zieht quer durchs Land nach Rhode Island. An der Küste der Narragansett Bay suchen sie ein Ferienhaus, in dem ihre Tochter eine unvergessliche Kindheit erleben soll. Doch werden sie auch etwas Passendes finden?

Ein Paar zieht auf die Bahamas, wo beide aufgewachsen sind. Sie suchen nach einer Immobilie, die Erinnerungen an ihre Kindheit wachruft, und die den traditionellen Charme der Insel widerspiegelt. Ein großer Garten für den Hund darf auch nicht fehlen.

Ein Paar und ihre Tochter suchen ein dauerhaftes Zuhause auf Exuma, das viel Platz im Freien bietet, damit sie die Natur genießen können. Sie träumt von einem modernen, hochwertigen Haus, doch er achtet streng aufs Budget.

Ein abenteuerlustiges Paar will dem kanadischen Winter entfliehen und auf Utila in Honduras neu beginnen. Beide wünschen sich ausreichend Platz. Während sie auf ein bezugsfertiges Haus in Stadtnähe setzt, ist er von abgelegenen Immobilien fasziniert.

Eine Familie will nach Roatan in Honduras ziehen, um näher bei der Verwandtschaft zu sein. Sie suchen ein Haus mit Blick aufs Meer. Während er eine moderne Architektur bevorzugt, fühlt sie sich von Häusern mit traditionellem Charme angezogen.

Ein Extremskifahrer und seine Frau tauschen die schneebedeckten Berge Colorados gegen die Sonne und das Meer von Roatan in Honduras. Sie hoffen, dort ein Haus am Wasser zu finden, das ihnen und auch ihrem Hund genug Platz bietet.

Eine New Yorker Immobilienmaklerin sehnt sich nach einem ruhigeren Alltag und einem Leben im Einklang mit der Natur. In Sosua in der Dominikanischen Republik will sie den hektischen Trubel der Großstadt hinter sich lassen.

Martin is impressed with the potential of two shops and three flats in Tonypandy in Wales while Dion looks round a two-bedroom maisonette in Dawley and Lucy meets a first-time developer with ambitious plans for an end terrace in London's Forest Gate.
A first-floor one-bedroom flat in London's Stepney Green, a three-bed semi in Dartford in Kent and a one-bedroom flat on the 17th floor of a block in Salford are all sold under the hammer.

For two of the properties sold under the hammer, a semi in Ilkeston in Derby and a flat in Streatham Hill in London, it's all about creating smart kitchens and bathrooms. Meanwhile, the owners of a bungalow have to deal with an unexpected issue.

A fifth-floor flat in Greater Manchester, a three-bed semi in Carlisle and three commercial buildings near Stansted are all sold under the hammer. One developer has a pressing deadline to finish his renovation work.

An old Derbyshire farmhouse in Wirksworth gets a stunning makeover, a developer builds a pair of semis in Chatham in Kent, while a mid-terraced house in Blackhall Colliery in County Durham is given a makeover ready for the rental market.

Martin, Lucy and Dion meet father-and-daughter developers. An apartment in a former mill in Mow Cop on the Staffordshire and Cheshire border, a three-bed semi in East Ham and a flat in Bournemouth are all given makeovers with the help of dad.

A flat over two floors in London's Camberwell, another flat in Telford in Shropshire and a three-bed semi in Alvaston in Derby are all sold under the hammer.
Martin, Lucy and Dion visit a grand five-bedroom period house in Folkestone in Kent, a two-bedroom flat in London's Leytonstone and a two-bedroom mid-terrace in Fenton in Stoke-on-Trent.

A studio flat in a former 1960s office block which is grade two listed in London's Elephant and Castle, a terraced house in Pontygwaith in South Wales and a flat in Cradley Heath near Birmingham are all sold under the hammer.
A house with no floor in Edgbaston in Birmingham, a detached house on several levels in Oldham and a former garage complex ripe for development in Forest Hill in London are all sold under the hammer.
A converted 16th-century chapel in Matlock in Derbyshire, a two-bedroom flat in Whetstone in London and a water-damaged house in Wishaw in Scotland are all sold under the hammer.

A two-bed semi in Meir in Stoke-on-Trent is given a country house look, a flat in London's Willesden Green also gets the wow factor, and a semi in Dudley in the West Midlands loses its 1980s look to be brought into the 21st century.
Terraced houses in Gravesend in Kent and Shipley in Derbyshire are given a new lease of life while former church premises in Harrow Weald in Middlesex are given a new use for the community.

Martin, Lucy and Dion meet property developers who have all bought at auction and hope to make a profit on their investments. Today a landscape gardener tackles a terrace in Ilkeston in Derby, two friends take on a four-storey house in Sittingbourne in Kent while another couple of friends' first venture together is a studio flat in South Norwood in London.

Dion visits a stone cottage in Tilton on the Hill in rural Leicestershire, Martin is at a property auction in Croydon on the outskirts of London, and Lucy meets two friends who have bought a bungalow in Rainham in Kent.

A mid-terrace house in Chaddesden in Derby, a two-bedroom flat in London's Maida Vale and a property in Warrington are all sold under the hammer. Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin meet the new owners to hear what they have planned for their auction buys.

Martin looks round a pretty cottage with outbuildings with huge potential in Burton upon Trent, while Lucy checks out a flat in London's ⚽ [EPL] Crystal Palace and Dion is in Mossley near Manchester in a four-bedroom bungalow.

Martin tackles the issue of solar panels on a property in Mountain Ash in Wales and wonders if it will be a sunny outcome for the new owner, while Lucy looks round a barn in Elstree in Hertfordshire and Dion visits a flat in Newport in Shropshire.

Martin Roberts meets a couple who buy a former mill workers' cottage in Derbyshire as their first home together, Lucy Alexander meets a father and daughter team who are seasoned developers buying a house in Kent, and Dion Dublin talks to a man who, along with two friends, has clubbed together to buy an investment property in Lowestoft in Suffolk.

Dion Dublin is in Walsall in the Midlands looking around a 1950s semi, Martin Roberts meets a man developing a ground-floor one-bedroom flat in Ilford in Essex, and Lucy Alexander catches up on a multimillion-pound redevelopment.

A house with a bathroom layout challenge in Ripley, Derbyshire, a huge three-storey house with its freehold on offer in Erdington, Birmingham, and a mid-terrace house in London's East Ham in need of a major makeover are all sold under the hammer.

A US navy warship is orbited by UFOs. Meanwhile, a British TV programme is interrupted by a voice claiming to be from the Ashtar Galactic Command, warning that Earth is in danger.

A UFO is caught on camera by a military helicopter on the Mexican border, an English woman is filmed disappearing from her bed at night, and NASA investigates UFOs after years of denial by the US authorities.
At a mysterious site in the Gobi Desert, experts discover a monster graveyard; the groundbreaking find contains the treasures of the alien beasts that once lived in this strange world.

pr.d: In the 80s and 90s, sightings of dark, triangular flying objects began to occur across the world - many incidents remaining unexplained.
Investigators find a new clue about the Malaysia Airlines flight that disappeared in 2014. Plus, an astronaut spots something strange in the Sahara Desert.
A forest of razor-sharp stones could be home to an undiscovered humanoid species. Satellite imagery reveals a mysterious eye-shaped island in a swamp.
Annually, Illinois gets more than 300 UFO reports, so why are the Tinley Park sightings - with over 70 witnesses each year - the only reports that happen en masse?
A fascinating look at the mounting evidence that suggests UFO waves are able to penetrate the world's most closely guarded airspace at will.
Aliens may be interested in experimenting on the human mind and body, and the human civilisation may be aliens' prized experiment.
After the Cuban revolution, Fidel Castro looked to exert his influence in Venezuela. Is Cuba still in charge of Venezuela's future?

pr.t: Ramses: The Great King Of Ancient Egypt
pr.d: After five years of reigning, Ramses the Great had already earned the distinction of being the most feared and respected among the martial pharaohs. He personally led his army with the aim of reconquering the kingdoms of the Levant.

Dan explores behind the battlements of Dover Castle and descends into an underground lair. There, he discovers how a vast network of tunnels had been used to defend both the castle and the country for centuries.

Dan is in the heart of the English countryside at Warwick Castle. While it appears idyllic today, for centuries it was a poisoned chalice to the Earls of Warwick who lived there and its walls echo with tales of betrayal, bloodshed and murder.
Andy travels to Scotland, visiting the heart-rending doggy suicide bridge and learning about a terrifying family of cannibals who used to prey upon weary travellers.
Andy embarks on a mission to unearth the Cornish sites of King Arthur, before magnet fishing for Excalibur and visiting the grave of a legendary witch.
Strange spots near the Grand Canyon may lead to the legendary treasure of a notorious bandit. Plus a massive chunk of ice disappears in Antarctica.
pr.sub: Lost Treasure of the Grand Canyon

pr.d: Satellite images reveal a series of large mounds in Romania, just a few miles from the home of Vlad the Impaler. Could these mounds be Dracula's long-lost grave?
From the lore and history of Ancient Egypt, to the myths of Native Americans, and even the art of the Renaissance period, mankind's past is riddled with the evidence of UFOs.
60 years on, Tony's close encounter has become an obsession. Meanwhile, pilot David presents photographic evidence of the UFO he almost crashed into whilst flying near area 5.

Scandals have accompanied human history since ancient times, and every lie comes with the risk of being exposed and creating a scandal big enough to send shock waves through a society and trigger social upheaval.
Victory in war doesn't just require sound military strategy, vital resources and equipment are also critical. Discover how the Axis powers failed in this regard.
Investigate an intriguing 3,5000-year-old box, a steam-powered gun and a monument that may have been an Aztec throne.
pr.sub: The Lost Standard, The Steam Gun And The Sacrificial Throne

pr.d: An Oregon woman doing some work on a remote cabin is spied on by a dark figure. Next, a man in Arkansas encounters something terrifying in the woods.
In Florida, an investigator captures dark shadow figures while walking through a cemetery, and a young girl in Ohio sees the ghost of her late grandfather.
This ornate, gold-plated chest housed the 10 commandments given to Moses by God and is said to have been built some 3,000 years ago.

pr.t: Der Vatikan - Geheimnisse der Heiligen Stadt
pr.d: Der Vatikan ist der kleinste anerkannte Staat der Welt. Doch dort ist eine ganze Menge los. Unzählige Gläubige pilgern jährlich dorthin. Außerdem finden sich dort große Teile des Welterbes - von Petrus' Grab bis hin zum Petersdom.

Jerusalem steckt voller Mythen, Geheimnisse. Dazu steckt es auch voller architektonischer Schätze. Diese Dokumentation stellt Jerusalems beeindruckendste heilige Bauwerke vor, vom Tempelkomplex der Römer bis zur christlichen Kirche.
Die Pyramiden von Gizeh gehören zu den beeindruckendsten Bauwerken der Geschichte. Seit Jahrtausenden ragen sie am Rand der Wüste empor und geben Forschern bis heute Rätsel auf.

Das Kolosseum zählt zu den bekanntesten Bauwerken der Antike und ist bis heute ein Symbol für die Macht des Römischen Reiches. Die riesige Arena war Schauplatz spektakulärer Veranstaltungen und zog Tausende Besucher an.

Ein Besuch im Vergnügungspark kann für manche Menschen zu einem Albtraum werden. Obwohl die meisten Besucher einen Tag voller Spaß und Abenteuer erleben, gibt es immer wieder Unfälle, die das Leben der Betroffenen für immer verändern. Von brennenden Piers über defekte Fahrgeschäfte bis hin zu gefährlichen Achterbahnen - die Risiken im Freizeitpark sind real und können schwerwiegende Folgen haben.

Seilbahnen und Standseilbahnen faszinieren durch ihre Ingenieurskunst und bieten spektakuläre Ausblicke, doch seltene Unfälle sind oft tödlich. Mechanische Probleme oder Konstruktionsfehler können eine idyllische Fahrt in eine Tragödie verwandeln. Diese Vorfälle erinnern daran, dass selbst die sichersten Fahrten versteckte Gefahren bergen können.

Schon in früheren Zeiten wurden Satellitenbilder zur Spionage eingesetzt. Bis heute existieren Bunker und andere geheime Verstecke dieser Kriegszeit. Die Dokumentation begleitet den Archäologen Grzegorz Kiarszys bei dessen Spurensuche. Außerdem stehen seltsame Kreise im Sudan im Fokus und kuriose Scheiben in Kalifornien, die als letzte Überreste einer Ölkatastrophe auf Satellitenaufnahmen zu erkennen sind.

Der Anthropologe Kirk French entdeckt auf Satellitenaufnahmen ein zerstörtes Fort, das im 19. Jahrhundert als fürchterliches Gefängnis gedient hat. French begibt sich auf die Spurensuche und stößt bald auf faszinierende Erkenntnisse.

Eine Kreuzung wird von einem Lastwagen gecrasht und verwandelt sich innerhalb von Sekunden in ein Trümmerfeld. Mehr Glück hat ein junges Mädchen, welches unbeaufsichtigt eine Straße überquert und dank eines aufmerksamen Fahrers gerettet wird.

Viele Sportler nutzen kleine Kameras, um ihre Leistung beim Wettkampf zu dokumentieren. Dabei werden die Dashcams ausgewertet. Unter anderem ist ein Geisterfahrer zu sehen sowie zwei Lieferwagen, die wie von Zauberhand zu schweben beginnen.
Eine Frau aus Hongkong wird verdächtigt, da sie zur Besichtigung eines zerstörten Hauses anreist.
Die Beamten ertappen einen Drogenschmuggler aus Brasilien und ein Mann flieht vor Kredithaien.
Der Zoll findet eine große Menge Zigaretten und ein liebeskranker Litauer bittet um Nachsicht.

Ein nigerianischer Staatsbürger wird mit Grenzschutzbeamten konfrontiert. Der Zoll findet ein äußerst verdächtiges Paket aus Afrika. Währenddessen spricht die Einwanderungsbehörde mit einem DJ, der versucht, ohne Visum zu arbeiten.

In dieser Folge versucht ein britischer Staatsbürger, sein Land zu verlassen. Außerdem trifft im Postzentrum ein mysteriöses Paket ein und Beamte vom Zoll und Polizei sind auf der Suche nach einem Boot in der Bay of Islands.

In dieser Folge entdecken die Beamten eine lebende Katze im Handgepäck einer Touristin. Außerdem wird ein unscheinbares Plüschtier als Drogenversteck entlarvt und die Einsatzkräfte müssen zwei Einheimische auf dem Wasser wieder zur Vernunft bringen.

Die Einwanderungsbehörde hat es mit einem Mann aus Singapur zu tun, der behauptet, ein Rendezvous mit einem geheimnisvollen Mann zu haben. Außerdem verursacht eine Überschwemmung in der Biosicherheitszone vom Flughafen von Auckland einen Ausfall.

Der Koffer eines brasilianischen Mannes wird hochgenommen, da sich Kokain in ihm befindet. Außerdem kann sich eine Frau bei der Biosicherheit nicht gut benehmen und die Frau eines Mannes versucht, seine Misstaten zu vertuschen.

In der ehemaligen Tschechoslowakei rettet Oskar Schindler 1.200 jüdische Frauen und Männer auf einem Fabrikgelände vor dem Holocaust – die Geschichte und der Ort hinter "Schindlers Liste". Ein Ökohotel im Amazonas scheitert am Reality-TV, in Brandenburg bringt ein Kalkwerk Aufschwung mit fatalen Folgen für Arbeiter.

Diese Folge wirft einen Blick auf einige unheimliche Ruinen, die in den bewaldeten Hügeln von Arkansas versteckt sind. Außerdem gibt es einen Blick auf ein heruntergekommenes Arbeitslager in Albanien, in dem Staatsfeinde untergebracht waren.

Ein mechanischer Schachspieler erobert im 18. Jahrhundert die Salons Europas: Der Schachtürke ist die gleichermaßen faszinierende wie unheimliche Erfindung des Wiener Hofbeamten Wolfgang von Kempelen. Die Maschine scheint unschlagbar - bis sich zeigt, dass Genialität manchmal gut versteckt sitzt. Außerdem: Wie Charles Lindbergh mit einer gläsernen Pumpe das Leben verlängern wollte - und warum eine ägyptische Mumienbinde das älteste Buch der Etrusker birgt. Drei Geschichten, die Staunen lehren.

Es geht um einen steinzeitlichen Monolith aus der Türkei. Ein bizarres Helmdesign der 1920er Jahre soll kreative Köpfe vor Lärm schützen - wird aber fast zur Kammer des Wahnsinns. Außerdem geht es um ein Skelett in einer Schweizer Kirche.

Die MSC Bellissima ist eines der größten Kreuzfahrtschiffe der Welt, es bietet bis zu 7.000 Passagieren Platz. Eine Konstruktion aus Stahlboxen, die das Schiff hoch im Wasser halten und beim Anlegen absinken, ermöglicht das problemlose Einlaufen in Häfen. Crew und Gäste werden bei einer 8-tägigen Fahrt auf dem Mittelmeer begleitet und die technischen Besonderheiten des Luxus-Liners werden gezeigt.

Der Italo AGV gilt als Ferrari unter den Hochgeschwindigkeitszügen in Europa gehört er zu den schnellsten seiner Art. Mit bis zu 300 Kilometern pro Stunde kann er 450 Personen zwischen 21 italienischen Städten befördern.

Auch in Zeiten von Massenproduktion gibt es noch private Betriebe, die in aufwendiger Handarbeit einmalige Qualitätsprodukte herstellen. Denn eines ist gewiss - Fingerspitzengefühl und Leidenschaft können Roboter nicht ersetzen.

pr.t: Meisterwerke am Handgelenk - Kunst und Kult der Luxusuhren
pr.d: Wenn aus Zeit Kunst wird: Diese Reportage taucht ein in die faszinierende Welt der Luxusuhren. In der traditionsreichsten Manufaktur Patek Philippe spricht CEO Thierry Stern über den besonderen Herstellungsprozess. Bei Wempe.

Im Allgäu wird auf einer Fläche von 184 Hektar ein gigantischer Ferienpark errichtet. In tausend Ferienhäusern sollen zukünftig rund 5.000 Gäste ihren Urlaub verbringen können. Doch bis zur Eröffnung der Anlage ist es noch ein weiter Weg.
pr.sub: Urlaubsspaß de luxe - Ein Ferienpark entsteht

pr.d: Schweden gehört zu den weltweit größten Papier-Exporteuren. Rund 3.000 Tonnen Holz werden täglich durch das Land transportiert. Teddy Wilson folgt den Spuren des Hector Rails und erhält einen tiefen Einblick in diese logistische Herausforderung.

Kanadas Rocky Mountains sind mit mehr als neun Millionen Besuchern jährlich eine touristische Top-Attraktion. Seit 1990 bietet die Eisenbahngesellschaft "Rocky Mountaineer" Zugreisen durch die Gebirgsregion des Ahornstaats an.

Die neuseeländischen Grenzschutzbeamten kontrollieren drei israelische Männer, die große Mengen MDMA mit sich führen. Weiterhin stellt sich heraus, dass die Touristen sich auch anderweitig vergnügen: Sie verbringen ihre Urlaubszeit gerne in Sexklubs.

Der Versuch, Alkohol zu schmuggeln, wird von den Zollbeamten in den Häfen von Auckland vereitelt. Ein kurdischer Neuseeländer erzählt von seinen großen Abenteuern in Risikoländern und eine Französin gerät außer sich und in Rage.

Neuseelands Grenzschützer und Spürhunde überwachen Einreisende, Gepäck, Post und Fracht auf Schmuggelware und Biosicherheitsrisiken. Von Auckland bis Queenstown zeigt die Doku ihre akribische Arbeit zum Schutz der Inselnation.

Die Zollbeamten am internationalen Flughafen von Christchurch verdächtigen das Gepäck eines Kanadiers. Weiterhin bemerken sie ein ungewöhnlich farbenfrohes Päckchen aus Uganda. Schließlich belügt eine Philippinerin die Beamten.
Eine Brasilianerin verhält sich verdächtig. Ein Reisender gibt den Beamten einen hilfreichen Tipp.

Die Beamten fassen einen Chinesen, der mehr Zigaretten als erlaubt transportiert. Weiterhin verdächtigen sie eine Fracht mit Kupferdraht. Es stellt sich heraus, dass dort die Droge Crystal Meth versteckt eingeschmuggelt wird.
