Peppa is intrigued to see her parents go to work every day. Daddy Pig makes Peppa her very own office to make her feel good.
Peppa finds a small bird on the ground in the garden of her house. She takes him to Dr Hamster, who explains that it is a swift and is probably tired after a long journey.

Peppa and her family are visiting Cousin Chloe's house to play with Baby Alexander. Peppa thinks she knows all about babies because she already looks after her doll, and George is a baby too, though he disagrees.

At the playground, Pedro and Penny's glasses fall off; both think that their glasses are broken, as they cannot see very well; Madame Gazelle shows Pedro and Penny different types of objects with lenses.
Snobby King and Queen Marigold are coming to visit the Little Kingdom, and Holly and her Mummy and Daddy enlist the Elf Band to impress them.
King Leopold has announced he is paying a visit to The Little Kingdom. Everyone is very excited that they have a VIP coming to The Little Kingdom and prepare to welcome him in style.
Peppa and her family are on holiday in Australia. They are visiting the Kangaroo family, who take them to explore the outback on their first day.
The Kangaroos take Peppa and her family to the beach on their second day in Australia where they try surfing for the first time.
Mrs Kangaroo takes everyone on an amazing adventure under the sea in her submarine to see the Great Barrier Reef.
Sadly, Peppa and her family's holiday in Australia is coming to an end, but they still have time to play with a boomerang and make friends with Mr Wallaby.
Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby!
Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep in Mummy Sheep's car. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.
Peppa and her friends, accompanied by Mummy Sheep and Granny Sheep, take Vanessa to Grampy Rabbit's boatyard for inspiration. The children create various artworks using items found around the yard.
While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School where they learn about what to expect when their new sibling arrives.
Peppa eagerly awaits her new sibling, growing impatient with the lengthy wait. Suddenly, Mummy Pig announces that the baby is coming right now.
The Pig family go to the hospital, where Peppa is determined to find the perfect name for the baby.
Kana manages to get a clean and fast job, while her friends have no choice but to do a muddy and slow one.
Paddington builds a robot that he calls Paddington that requires a real friend to work, Baaz invites everyone to celebrate Diwali with him, and Paddington is his helpful assistant.
pr.sub: Paddington Meets Paddingtron; Paddington's First Diwali

pr.d: Paddington has a race against time in order to enjoy his first ever solar eclipse. Paddington accepts an inventor's award for Simi when she's too shy to step up, but it makes Simi feel jealous and sad.
pr.sub: Paddington and the Solar Eclipse; Paddington and the Mysterious Inventor

pr.d: The Browns meet Shantee the lighthouse keeper when they arrive at the beach for their holiday. Paddington, Jonathan, and Judy become trainee lifeguards and end up rescuing Mr Brown with Taylor the lifeguard's help.
pr.sub: Paddington's Summer Holiday Begins; Paddington's Life Guard Training

pr.d: Something is making the strange noises in the cave. Jonathan thinks it's a mermaid, but Paddington isn't so sure. Judy wants to find a fossil on the beach, but everyone else seems to be getting lucky except her. Paddington tries to help.
pr.sub: Paddington's Mysterious Cave Discovery; Paddington and the Fossil Hunt

pr.d: At the playgroup, Madame Gazelle is reading the children a story, but a page is missing so she makes up an ending. During playtime, the children make up their own alternative endings.
Madame Gazelle is giving the playgroup a singing lesson. When the parents arrive, the children perform their song. Madame Gazelle reveals that tomorrow there will be a singing competition.
Features the grown-up's singing competition where the kids are the judges.

Mummy Pig and Peppa are at the zoo and meet Lorenzo Lion who lives there; he is helping his daddy, Mr. Lion the zookeeper, take care of the zoo; Lorenzo shows Peppa his toy zoo, but he keeps misplacing his wooden animals in his two bedrooms!
The playgroup is visiting the zoo today. Mr Lion then shows them a giant lizard. The children all believe it's a dinosaur. Mr Lion says if he did have a dinosaur, he would keep that a secret.
Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit pretend to be babies to get Mummy Rabbit's attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along until they admit they are not really babies!
Peppa is on a play date with Candy Cat at Mr Cat's Café. Candy shows Mr Cat the drawings they've done of everyone, and he hangs them up for everyone to see.
On a cold day, Daddy Pig suggests they build a den until Mummy Pig has finished work. After a hard day's work, the cushion den is a perfect place to watch TV together!
A freak snowstorm hits while Alex and Mr Porter are camping on a tropical island.
Mr Porter is delivering his famous fizzy pickles to people around town when a bumpy road shakes up the deliveries and causes the pickle jars to pop.

It's World Book Day, and Paddington helps Mateo discover his favourite character. Paddington, Simi, and Jonathan are on a dinosaur hunt on the island in the park, but they are unsure if dinosaurs still exist.
pr.sub: Paddington and the Three Musketeers; Paddington and the Dinosaur Hunt

pr.d: When things go missing in Windsor Gardens, Jonathan believes a black hole is to blame, so Paddington goes on a space mission. Simi and Paddington try to find the gold at the end of the rainbow after they break Baaz's kaleidoscope.
pr.sub: Paddington's Journey Into a Black Hole; Paddington's Rainbow Race!

pr.d: After Judy literally loses a tooth, she tries to find it before bedtime and the tooth fairy comes. Paddington becomes a work bear and helps Mr Brown in the home office.
pr.sub: Paddington & The Tooth Fairy / Paddington Goes to Work

pr.d: Tim and Kai try to give Parky the best day ever.
Tim, Tommy, Tia and Grandma go on the search for treasure.
When the Rumblefest tree for Rumblefest Eve is nowhere to be seen, Tim must find a way to save the day!
The elf and fairy children learn all about how the rubbish from a picnic can be recycled into beautiful new toys.
Nanny Plum takes the Fairy children for a nature class in the woods and bumps into the Wise Old Elf who is teaching a nature class to the Elf children.
Grumblestunk is sure she saw an enormous banana when she walked Stink on the beach early that morning. Stan and Gran spy a mystery - but no banana!
A giant albatross is seen near Porthole and Stan has to spot it! But the bird's footprints are bigger than any real albatross. What's going on?
PAW Patrol is a CG action-adventure preschool series starring a pack of six heroic puppies led by a tech-savvy 10-year-old boy named Ryder.
pr.sub: Pups and the Ace of the Skies; Pups Save the Babysitter

pr.d: The Pups are on the case when mechanical issues occur at the new water park, Splashy Bottom / The Pups have to save ancient relics when high jinks ensue at Danny's new job at the Museum.
pr.sub: Pups Save a Splashy Bottom; Pups Save a Daring Tour Guide

pr.d: Chitter upgrades the Forest Flyer with flight mode! But the Forest Squad go missing mid-flight. Trickalien shows Lola how to be funny, but she takes it too far and brings a scary tree to life.
pr.sub: The Forest Flyer Flies / Scary Prankster

pr.d: In this special episode, Speed Meister sabotages a speeding train, accidentally sending it towards a huge mountain! Rubble and Crew introduce their new demolition vehicles to smash through the mountain and build a tunnel to save the day!
pr.sub: The Crew Demolishes A Rock Mountain

pr.d: At the Farm Fair, a mysterious critter chews up everything in sight, and the pups must save the day! Later, Rocky dreams a sudsy accident turns Adventure Bay into a giant bubble bath, putting everyone at risk!
pr.sub: Pups Save the Farm Festival; Pups and the Bubble Bath Bay!

pr.d: Farmer Al's new machine, the Garboni, goes haywire, and it's up to Ryder and the Paw Patrol to stop it before it gives them the slip. The Paw Patrol have to catch a trouble-making sleepy porcupine and bring it back to the woods.
pr.sub: Pups Stop the Garboni; Pups Save the Porcupine

pr.d: Monster cakes go on a city rampage. Bobbi has to stop an asteroid crisis.
Tim and Kai attempt to take a photograph of the elusive SpaceBug.
Tim Rex tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tim explores Rumbleton to find somewhere he can have fun alone.
Tim and Kai compete to get Terri's spare Space-Land ticket.
Gabby, Pandy and their curious crew set out on an animal safari to find a mysterious creature.
Gabby and Pandy follow clues and solve riddles to find treasures on a dollhouse treasure hunt.

Smurfette accidentally loses the Smurf Village in a bet and must carefully try to win it back; when the Smurf Girls invite all the Smurfs to their Grand Equinox Ball, Gargamel and Azrael crash the party.
pr.sub: Wanna Bet?; Gargamel, Queen of the Prom

pr.d: Rubble moves with his family of construction pups to the nearby town of Builder Cove where they live, play and build whatever the community needs.
pr.sub: The Crew Builds a Houseboat; The Crew Builds a Spa

pr.d: Ryder and his team of pups must take on 10-year-old genius Codi Gizmodi, who has her sights set on building her own high-tech city to replace Adventure Bay; joining the team are Everest, Tracker, Sweetie, Tuck and Ella, Rex, Liberty and more.
Adventure Bay is getting a Fire Station! When disaster strikes during a barbecue, it's up to the PAW Patrol to put it out.
pr.sub: Fire Rescue: Pups Save the Big BBQ

pr.d: Skye, Liberty and Everest take off on a road trip to Yellowstone National Park and need to use their mini-rescue rides to save a bunch of baby animals.
Peppa and family go on a walk through the forest where they meet all of their favourite fairytale characters. They visit the home of bears who like porridge and meet a hungry Mr Wolf.
Madame Gazelle takes the class to London for the day, where they are given a tour of the city by none other than the Queen of England.
The doctor teaches children what to do if there is ever an accident. A patient soon appears, and they put into practise the new techniques they have learned.

Mummy Sheep gets the news that she has got a new job far away, leaving Suzy and Peppa to wonder how they're going to carry on being best friends; Peppa gives Suzy some presents to remember her by, before a surprising change for Mummy Sheep changes everything.

Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the skate park with their bicycles, scooters and skateboards. While Peppa has fun playing around on Daddy's skateboard, she soon learns that he is more of an expert than she realised.
Peppa finds a small bird on the ground in the garden of her house. She takes him to Dr Hamster, who explains that it is a swift and is probably tired after a long journey.
Peppa celebrates Goldie's birthday by holding an undersea party - by turning the house into an underwater environment.
Mummy and Daddy Pig show Peppa and George how to play flying discs in the park. Soon their friends appear with their parents.
The naughty toddlers cause chaos during a trip to the big museum.
pr.sub: Daisy and Poppy's Trip to the Museum

pr.d: When Captain Squid leaves his treasure map in the Little Kingdom, Redbeard the Elf Pirate leads Ben, Holly and Nanny Plum on a treasure hunt.
Wandy gets a cold and is taken ill; Holly is given a replacement wand. This new wand can do lots of things that Wandy can't, and soon becomes the favourite.
Naughty Gaston is sent to pet school, where Miss Jolly soon gets him into shape.

Francois' pants catch on fire, sending both the Lighthouse and Cap'n Turbot's Flounder up in flames; a news crew is in town when Chickaletta accidentally causes a fire in Adventure Bay's new parkette.
pr.sub: Fire Rescue: Pups Save the Flaming Flounder; Fire Rescue: Pups Make the News

pr.d: Ryan Reynolds reads stories to help the world fall asleep. Tonight Ryan shares some stories filled with wonder.
Madame Gazelle decides to teach the children how to play bat and ball, but when it is her turn, she hits the ball too far, and they must catch it before it hits the ground.
Teddy needs mending and cleaning after rolling down hills and jumping in muddy puddles, so Peppa takes her to Miss Rabbit's Doll Hospital.

Peppa takes Goldie the Goldfish for a visit to the vets and is surprised when she finds that there's a new road to be built over the building! With the help of Mr. Bull and his brother they find that instead of demolishing the vets they can build a tunnel underneath it.
When Peppa's bike gets a flat tyre that needs mending, Daddy Pig suggests they ride imaginary bikes. Peppa and her friends have fun riding their imaginary bikes and jumping in pretend muddy puddles.
Peppa, her friends, and their parents, learn woodworking from Mister Wolf. He asks Daddy Pig to make a hut out of twigs, but it isn't very strong, and Mister Wolf manages to blow it down.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of jumping in a muddy puddle!
Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the flat. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.
It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn that it is not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the Earth.
Nanny Plum takes the Fairy children for a nature class in the woods and bumps into the Wise Old Elf who is teaching a nature class to the Elf children.
Holly goes with Ben and Mr Elf to the elf farm to collect an egg for the King's breakfast. While there a huge chicken escapes from the farm and Holly and the elves have to chase it.
Thomas accidentally agrees to haul gardening supplies and watch pretty butterflies with Kana, all at the same time.
Sandy's friends try to convince her that it is time to clean up, and helpful Whiff knows the perfect place for her old junk.
Dora and Boots help their friend Catalina the condor become an amazing gaucha and save the Gaucho Games. Dora and Boots meet Pilar the Princess Unicorn and help her get back to Unicorn Land.
When Tommy enters his first Rocket Race, Tim does everything possible to support his brother.
Tim tries to help Tia face the new Rocket track ride.
Tim attempts to distract Tia whilst Tusky is being washed in the machine.

Paddington attempts to deliver a hot lunch after learning that seagulls love chips and will do anything to get them. On a foggy night, the lighthouse light breaks and Paddington must help save a boat at sea.
pr.sub: Paddington vs. the Seagulls; Paddington and the Light House

pr.d: It's a snowy day and Peppa's family build an igloo for their snowman. They hide in it during a snowstorm, but Penny Polar Bear and her parents love snowstorms and also Peppa's igloo.

Peppa and her friends are at playgroup when they learn that Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow are getting married the next day; everyone goes into a panic when they confess how they have done nothing to prepare for the big day.

Everyone prepares for Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow's wedding; Peppa and the soon-to-be-weds go to the jewellers to get rings, to the dressmakers, to get a wedding dress and finally to Peppa's house to sort the wedding cake.
The day of Mrs. Cow and Mr. Bull wedding arrives, but not everything goes to plan; nothing stops it being the best wedding ever and there is a lot of happy crying.
Peppa receives an invitation to Candy Cat's birthday party, but a double-decker party bus arrives; the bus goes to the playground and even the beach, hosting the best party ever.

Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night; before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, which popcorn to eat and take a toilet break -- then they're finally ready.
Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day; after a day full of screen printing and silhouette miniatures, Granny Pig finds an art piece at Suzy's house.
Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers; the children enjoy identifying the flowers like Wild Garlic, Bluebells and even a rare orchid.

pr.d: Ryder and his team of pups must take on 10-year-old genius Codi Gizmodi, who has her sights set on building her own high-tech city to replace Adventure Bay; joining the team are Everest, Tracker, Sweetie, Tuck and Ella, Rex, Liberty and more.
Adventure Bay is getting a Fire Station! When disaster strikes during a barbecue, it's up to the PAW Patrol to put it out.
pr.sub: Fire Rescue: Pups Save the Big BBQ

pr.d: Skye, Liberty and Everest take off on a road trip to Yellowstone National Park and need to use their mini-rescue rides to save a bunch of baby animals.
Peppa and family go on a walk through the forest where they meet all of their favourite fairytale characters. They visit the home of bears who like porridge and meet a hungry Mr Wolf.
Madame Gazelle takes the class to London for the day, where they are given a tour of the city by none other than the Queen of England.
The doctor teaches children what to do if there is ever an accident. A patient soon appears, and they put into practise the new techniques they have learned.

Mummy Sheep gets the news that she has got a new job far away, leaving Suzy and Peppa to wonder how they're going to carry on being best friends; Peppa gives Suzy some presents to remember her by, before a surprising change for Mummy Sheep changes everything.

Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the skate park with their bicycles, scooters and skateboards. While Peppa has fun playing around on Daddy's skateboard, she soon learns that he is more of an expert than she realised.
Peppa finds a small bird on the ground in the garden of her house. She takes him to Dr Hamster, who explains that it is a swift and is probably tired after a long journey.
Peppa celebrates Goldie's birthday by holding an undersea party - by turning the house into an underwater environment.
Mummy and Daddy Pig show Peppa and George how to play flying discs in the park. Soon their friends appear with their parents.
The naughty toddlers cause chaos during a trip to the big museum.
pr.sub: Daisy and Poppy's Trip to the Museum

pr.d: When Captain Squid leaves his treasure map in the Little Kingdom, Redbeard the Elf Pirate leads Ben, Holly and Nanny Plum on a treasure hunt.
Wandy gets a cold and is taken ill; Holly is given a replacement wand. This new wand can do lots of things that Wandy can't, and soon becomes the favourite.
Naughty Gaston is sent to pet school, where Miss Jolly soon gets him into shape.

Francois' pants catch on fire, sending both the Lighthouse and Cap'n Turbot's Flounder up in flames; a news crew is in town when Chickaletta accidentally causes a fire in Adventure Bay's new parkette.
pr.sub: Fire Rescue: Pups Save the Flaming Flounder; Fire Rescue: Pups Make the News

pr.d: Ryan Reynolds reads stories to help the world fall asleep. Tonight Ryan shares some stories filled with wonder.
Madame Gazelle decides to teach the children how to play bat and ball, but when it is her turn, she hits the ball too far, and they must catch it before it hits the ground.
Teddy needs mending and cleaning after rolling down hills and jumping in muddy puddles, so Peppa takes her to Miss Rabbit's Doll Hospital.

Peppa takes Goldie the Goldfish for a visit to the vets and is surprised when she finds that there's a new road to be built over the building! With the help of Mr. Bull and his brother they find that instead of demolishing the vets they can build a tunnel underneath it.
When Peppa's bike gets a flat tyre that needs mending, Daddy Pig suggests they ride imaginary bikes. Peppa and her friends have fun riding their imaginary bikes and jumping in pretend muddy puddles.
Peppa, her friends, and their parents, learn woodworking from Mister Wolf. He asks Daddy Pig to make a hut out of twigs, but it isn't very strong, and Mister Wolf manages to blow it down.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of jumping in a muddy puddle!
Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the flat. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.
It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn that it is not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the Earth.
Nanny Plum takes the Fairy children for a nature class in the woods and bumps into the Wise Old Elf who is teaching a nature class to the Elf children.
Holly goes with Ben and Mr Elf to the elf farm to collect an egg for the King's breakfast. While there a huge chicken escapes from the farm and Holly and the elves have to chase it.
Thomas accidentally agrees to haul gardening supplies and watch pretty butterflies with Kana, all at the same time.
Sandy's friends try to convince her that it is time to clean up, and helpful Whiff knows the perfect place for her old junk.
Dora and Boots help their friend Catalina the condor become an amazing gaucha and save the Gaucho Games. Dora and Boots meet Pilar the Princess Unicorn and help her get back to Unicorn Land.
When Tommy enters his first Rocket Race, Tim does everything possible to support his brother.
Tim tries to help Tia face the new Rocket track ride.
Tim attempts to distract Tia whilst Tusky is being washed in the machine.

Paddington attempts to deliver a hot lunch after learning that seagulls love chips and will do anything to get them. On a foggy night, the lighthouse light breaks and Paddington must help save a boat at sea.
pr.sub: Paddington vs. the Seagulls; Paddington and the Light House

pr.d: It's a snowy day and Peppa's family build an igloo for their snowman. They hide in it during a snowstorm, but Penny Polar Bear and her parents love snowstorms and also Peppa's igloo.

Peppa and her friends are at playgroup when they learn that Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow are getting married the next day; everyone goes into a panic when they confess how they have done nothing to prepare for the big day.

Everyone prepares for Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow's wedding; Peppa and the soon-to-be-weds go to the jewellers to get rings, to the dressmakers, to get a wedding dress and finally to Peppa's house to sort the wedding cake.
The day of Mrs. Cow and Mr. Bull wedding arrives, but not everything goes to plan; nothing stops it being the best wedding ever and there is a lot of happy crying.
Peppa receives an invitation to Candy Cat's birthday party, but a double-decker party bus arrives; the bus goes to the playground and even the beach, hosting the best party ever.

Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night; before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, which popcorn to eat and take a toilet break -- then they're finally ready.
Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day; after a day full of screen printing and silhouette miniatures, Granny Pig finds an art piece at Suzy's house.
Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers; the children enjoy identifying the flowers like Wild Garlic, Bluebells and even a rare orchid.
Peppa and George play in their grandparents' garden on a very hot day, but they don't have a paddling pool; Granny and Grandpa Pig create their own water squeezers and even a water slide.
Mummy Elephant invites Peppa and Daddy Pig to perform magic at Emily's birthday party. Peppa shows her friends how the magic trick works.
Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick in the mail and demonstrates to Peppa and George how to use it. Peppa and her friends struggle with using it first.
Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tennis lesson, but the tennis balls get everywhere. Mr Stallion and Miss Corgi arrive with strawberries and cream.
King Thistle has a cold and needs some medicine. Nanny Plum, Holly, and Ben, have a lot of fun collecting the ingredients to make a magic potion to cure his cold and make him better.
King Thistle wants bread for his royal breakfast, but there isn't any flour in the castle. Mr Elf takes everyone to the Elf Windmill to find out why it takes so long to make flour.
Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa's house and have a fun dinosaur party.
Peppa helps out with Danny Dog refurbishing his bedroom, and imagines a pirate adventure along the way.
Grandpa Pig finds his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to be discharged. Papa and Suzy volunteer to nurse him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable as he was in hospital.
Peppa and her friends are at their clubhouse. They decide to start a detective club, and when Daddy Pig loses his car keys, they have a real mystery to solve.
While Mummy Pig is enjoying a spa day out, Daddy, George and Peppa explore the rest of the shopping centre.
Mummy Pig shows Peppa how to play pretend by teaching her how to wink. Zoe Zebra comes to play with Peppa and brings along her toy monkey. Peppa pretends Monkey has a cough.
Peppa and her family go bowling at the Peppatown Bowling Alley.
Peppa and her friends visit a roller disco organised by Madame Gazelle. After skating along to nursery rhymes, they go wild to the rhythm of the music together with Madame Gazelle.
Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers; the children enjoy identifying the flowers like Wild Garlic, Bluebells and even a rare orchid.
Peppa and her friends learn how to animate their drawings at playgroup.
Peppa and George join Grandma Piggy and her friends to play a game pretending to be Vikings. The Vikings enjoy Grandpa Piggy's boat until they realise they forgot about the picnic.
Peppa learns that Mummy Pig used to keep a diary when she was her age, so Peppa decides to give it a try.
PC Panda brings his twin daughters to playgroup Peggy and Pandora Panda. They love puzzles and to solve mysteries just like their dad.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig. Grandpa builds a special hiding hut to watch birds in so they can all go owl-spotting.
Mummy Elephant invites Peppa and Daddy Pig to perform magic at Emily's birthday party. Peppa shows her friends how the magic trick works.

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.

Doctor Hamster comes to school to talk about butterflies. Doctor Hamster shows the children some colourful caterpillars and all the children draw pictures of caterpillars. One caterpillar forms a chrysalis that opens to reveal a pretty butterfly. The children paint butterfly wings and dance the life cycle of a butterfly.

Madame Gazelle takes the class through a simple tots workout at Peppa's playground that uses spinning hoops. Though they have fun playing with the hoops, they have a hard time spinning them around their waists as directed.
Miss Rabbit persuades Mummy Pig to go to her relaxation class, but relaxing proves more difficult than expected. However, thanks to Daddy Pig's bouncy castle, they all have fun in the end.
Peppa is on a play date with Candy Cat at Mr Cat's Café. Candy shows Mr Cat the drawings they've done of everyone, and he hangs them up for everyone to see.
Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tennis lesson, but the tennis balls get everywhere. Mr Stallion and Miss Corgi arrive with strawberries and cream.
On a rainy day, Granny Sheep plays in the garden with Peppa and Suzy. They decide to play with cardboard boxes and build a hospital, a cookie factory, and a train station.
Daddy Piggy arrives in an electric car. The family go out and are surprised when the car talks.
Granny and her friends' historical re-enactment society are being cave people today. Peppa and George join in helping to catch Grandpa Pig who is dressed as a woolly mammoth.

Rebecca and Richard Rabbit are playing a marble run game at Peppa's house. But when Daddy Pig joins in and improvises tunnels and bridges, the marble rolls out of the bedroom, causing chaos and nearly knocking Goldie out of her bowl.
Peppa and family are watching TV, until it breaks! While Grampy Rabbit fixes it, the family get a new TV which can do everything, but it doesn't beat their old TV.

After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car. The bear family stops it just in time, and they finish the day jumping muddy puddles at the caravan park.
Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep in Mummy Sheep's car. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa's while Granny hosts a re-enactment of the 1960s with her friends.
While Mum makes an apple pie, Dad suggests that Peppa and George play at finding hidden things. Peppa and George then start running around the house to solve the clues and find the objects.
Madame Gazelle decides to teach the children how to play bat and ball, but when it is her turn, she hits the ball too far, and they must catch it before it hits the ground.
Peppa and George play in their pool, helping garden animals cool off. When rain arrives, both the animals and Peppa are pleased. The rainfall forms muddy puddles, which Peppa loves for jumping.
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to play in the playground. On the way it starts to get foggy, and before long it becomes so foggy that they can't see anything.

The Detective introduces his new friend, the superhero Super Potato, who teaches children the importance of eating fruit and vegetables every day, and later helps the Detective out of a complicated situation.
Peppa and the Pig family attend a school fête. Peppa's favourite things at the fête are face painting, the balloons, and the bouncy castle.

The Carnival has come to town, and it's a chance to see all sorts of exciting things! There is Mr. Bull's Jazz Band, Miss Rabbit as the Carnival Queen and even a very special appearance from Mr. Potato.
Peppa and George are at the playground with their friends. Peppa loves to play on the swings, but George is a bit afraid of heights and doesn't like to be pushed too high.
Daddy Pig and Mr Bull are digging up the playground, so Daddy Pig decides to teach the kids some simple science. The first experiment is to see how many children it takes to pick up Madame Gazelle.

It is Molly Mole's first day at school and she quickly makes best friends with Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit. Molly shows them how good she is at digging while taking them on a tour of her underground house.

Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy Pig have gone to visit Madame Gazelle. The family soon realise that her house is being pushed over by the tall tree next to it. Mr. Bull arrives and with his help they all manage to save Madame Gazelle's House and tree.
Madame Gazelle shows Peppa and her school friends how to make a time capsule, with each of them putting one of their favourite things in the capsule and burying it in the school garden.
When Peppa and George go to the dentist for a check-up, Dr Elephant says their teeth are nice and white, but George's toy dinosaur is in need of a tooth clean.
Oh dear, Miss Rabbit's train has broken down and all her passengers need to get to work. So Grandpa Pig lends Miss Rabbit his little train, Gertrude.
pr.sub: Grandpa Pig's Train to the Rescue

pr.d: What's that strange creature hovering in the sky? It's George's dinosaur balloon, but little George is finding it difficult to keep hold of his big balloon. Can anyone stop it from flying off to the moon?
Peppa's older cousin Chloe comes to visit, and Peppa must play games by somebody else's rules for a change.
Some of Daddy Pig's important work papers have gone missing because Mummy Pig, Peppa and George have accidentally made them into paper aeroplanes.
Peppa and family are at the school fair where the top prize in the raffle is a hot-air balloon ride.
Grandpa Pig needs help when his boat sinks, so Granddad Dog gives them all a lift to Grampy Rabbit's Boatyard so that the boat can be fixed.
When George loses the metal wind-up key for his toy robot in the long grass, Grandpa Pig cannot find his metal detector to help George track it down.
Peppa and her friends have fun while painting in the playgroup. Madame Gazelle then teaches them how to play games with parachutes.
It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy!
Peppa is intrigued to see her parents go to work every day. Daddy Pig makes Peppa her very own office to make her feel good.
Peppa and George check out Grandpa's new Bug Hotel as lots of insects arrive. A bumblebee cannot find a place in the hotel because the rooms are too small for him.

Madame Gazelle presents the poetry to Peppa and her friends, explaining that sounds can also be poems. When it starts raining, the inspired children create a beautiful poem about the rain and recite it to their parents.
Peppa, George, Molly Mole and Freddy Fox play in the garden. Molly digs a tunnel and hits a box of pirate treasure.
At playgroup, Madame Gazelle has invited Mr Potato to lead Peppa and her friends in a wonderfully fun musical Kiddie Workout.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new clubhouse and slide for Peppa and her friends.

Peppa and her family are visiting Cousin Chloe's house to play with Baby Alexander. Peppa thinks she knows all about babies because she already looks after her doll, and George is a baby too, though he disagrees.
Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick in the mail and demonstrates to Peppa and George how to use it. Peppa and her friends struggle with using it first.
Peppa, George, Granny and Grandpa Pig visit the sailing club where they find a juke box. They have fun dancing to all different types of music.
Peppa and her friends visit Mrs Badger's petting farm, where they enjoy feeding the chickens and meeting cute guinea pigs.
Peppa's family embarks on an adventure, but Daddy Pig's fear of heights threatens their climb to the monkey tree.
Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the flat. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.
George undergoes a medical examination to assess his hearing. The results of the test reveal moderate hearing loss in his left ear, marking an important milestone in his health and development.

While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised that there are extra rules which she does not have in her own house. On the drive home, Peppa explains to Mummy Pig that different houses have different rules.

Mummy Pig takes Peppa to the doctors for her yearly health check-up with Dr Polar Bear, who checks her height, weight, ears, mouth and heartbeat and listens to Mummy tell him all about the changes Peppa has gone through.
Peppa and her friends visit the cinema for the first time to watch the 'Super Potato' film.
Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa's house and have a fun dinosaur party.
Peppa helps out with Danny Dog refurbishing his bedroom, and imagines a pirate adventure along the way.
Grandpa Pig finds his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to be discharged. Papa and Suzy volunteer to nurse him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable as he was in hospital.
Peppa and her friends are at their clubhouse. They decide to start a detective club, and when Daddy Pig loses his car keys, they have a real mystery to solve.
While Mummy Pig is enjoying a spa day out, Daddy, George and Peppa explore the rest of the shopping centre.
It's bedtime, but Peppa is not sleepy, so Daddy Pig tells Peppa and George a story about a pretty princess and a dinosaur.
Daddy Pig has a book from the library that he has kept for too long. The family go to the library to return it and find more books to read.
Peppa and George go sailing with Grandpa Pig, but when he keeps getting stuck in the mud, they all decide to have a sleepover on the boat while they wait for the tide to come back in.
When Daddy Pig needs a new watch, Mr Fox finds three grandfather clocks in the back of his van. Three clocks are much better than one. Mr Fox has everything in his van, even a chicken.
Peppa and George want to be famous detectives like their favourite television programme 'Detective Potato', so Daddy Pig gives them a mystery to solve.

It's Richard Rabbit's birthday party and George is invited. That can only mean one thing, soft play. George and friends have great fun, swinging, bouncing and climbing, but it isn't quite as much fun for the grown-ups.
Peppa and George meet Kylie Kangaroo and her brother Joey. Peppa shows Kylie how to jump up and down in muddy puddles, and they see who can jump the highest.
The playgroup is going on an outing to the museum. Everyone is on the bus ready to go, except Pedro Pony, so where is he?
Peppa and the Pig family attend a school fête. Peppa's favourite things at the fête are face painting, the balloons, and the bouncy castle.

Peppa, George and Daddy Pig are excited about Mummy Pig's birthday and have lots of fun preparing surprises for her. When Mummy Pig sees her beautiful cake and opens her present, she is absolutely delighted.
At Peppa's playgroup, Madame Gazelle wants everyone to show the class their special talent.

Peppa and George's toy basket is full, and their beds are covered in toys, so Mummy Pig decides it is time to order a new toy cupboard. The cupboard arrives in the post, but it needs to be assembled - and Mummy and Daddy Pig are not very good at DIY. Luckily help is at hand, as Mr Zebra the Postman loves assembling flat-pack furniture.

Mummy Rabbit comes to visit with a big tummy. Everyone is excited to find out there is a baby rabbit inside, but they are in for an even bigger surprise! The children think of ideas for names beginning with 'R.'

Grandpa and Granny Pig take Peppa, George and all their friends on a boat trip to Pirate Island. On the island, Grandpa shows everyone how to use his metal detector to find treasure, and they all build a big sandcastle.

Peppa and family have all gone to the caves for a day out and Grampy Rabbit is their tour guide. Peppa and George are excited to see the pretty caves and go through the underground lakes. Daddy Pig must be at his bravest on this trip to go on the scary 'Ride of Doom'.
Miss Rabbit takes Peppa and the family to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house to drop off their shopping, but that's not the last trip of the day for her.
Teddy needs mending and cleaning after rolling down hills and jumping in muddy puddles, so Peppa takes her to Miss Rabbit's Doll Hospital.
Granny and Grandpa Pig have a beautiful little boat, and Peppa and George are spending the day on the river with them.

It is school project time for Peppa and her friends, which means they have to build castles and bring them into playgroup. Mummy and Daddy Pig have lots of fun helping Peppa make hers, if only they could find the glitter.
Peppa and her playgroup friends go with Madame Gazelle to visit Pedro Pony, who is poorly in hospital.

It is time for a day out and Peppa, George, Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and Suzy Sheep all go to visit Tiny Land. They see tiny dinosaurs, their favourite tiny landmarks and even a tiny Miss Rabbit doing even more jobs.
Peppa and George help Mummy Pig tidy up the breakfast things. Mummy Pig teaches them how to recycle the bottles and newspapers, then they take everything to Miss Rabbit at the recycling plant.
Peppa and her family visit a museum, and Peppa likes the Kings and Queens room, whereas George's favourite is the dinosaur room.
Peppa's family is staying at Cousin Chloe's house. It's been a long day and everyone is tired and sleepy, but baby Alexander keeps everyone awake with his crying.

Mummy, Daddy, Peppa and George go to the park. Peppa and George play on the hopping logs, the bouncing branch and the monkey bars.

When Peppa decides to walk up the big hill during their family hike in the countryside, Daddy Pig assures her that the hard climb will be worth it.
After seeing an advert for the London Marathon, Daddy Pig applies to take part to show the kids what grit and determination really looks like!
Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is her hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.

Peppa and George are playing in the garden when they hear a strange noise. It's thunder. Peppa and George are a little bit frightened at first but Peppa soon decides that she loves thunderstorms.
Peppa and her family spot a rainbow when they go for a drive.
Peppa and her family are trying to get to the playground, but Mr Bull's roadworks are in the way.

Peppa and George's toy basket is full, and their beds are covered in toys, so Mummy Pig decides it is time to order a new toy cupboard. The cupboard arrives in the post, but it needs to be assembled - and Mummy and Daddy Pig are not very good at DIY. Luckily help is at hand, as Mr Zebra the Postman loves assembling flat-pack furniture.
Granny and Grandpa's pet Polly Parrot comes to stay, and Peppa and George love Polly Parrot. But when she flies away, no one knows what to do.
Grandpa Pig has built a fantastic little train called Gertrude, and when they take a ride, they give all their friends a ride.
When Peppa goes for a sleepover at Zoe Zebra's house with Suzy Sheep, Rebecca Rabbit, Candy Cat and Emily Elephant, the girls are too excited to go to sleep.
It's nighttime at Grandpa and Granny Pig's house, and Peppa and George have stayed up late to help hunt for slugs and snails. But what other night animals will they find?
Peppa and George make everyone laugh when they dress up as Mummy and Daddy Pig.
When Daddy Pig loses his glasses he gets a bit grumpy, but Peppa and George have lots of fun looking for them.
Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her friends on a train ride where they must tick off what they see on their activity sheets.

Peppa and all her friends at playgroup dress up as different countries from all over the world.
Peppa and George are playing in Grandpa Pig's garden when they find a little snail.
Peppa and Suzy Sheep are best friends, but one day they have a quarrel over a game of cards and decide they are not best friends any more.
When the school roof is broken and needs fixing, Peppa volunteers Mummy Pig to do a parachute jump to raise money. Daddy Pig goes up too, and has to overcome his fear of heights.

Mummy Pig's book is finished, and it's time to show it off to Peppa and her playgroup friends. Unfortunately, Peppa and George lose some of the book when they are playing, and Mummy Pig has to think quickly to fix it.
Peppa and George love going to the beach on sunny days. They bring their water wings, a beach ball and buckets and spades. Peppa and George have fun burying Daddy Pig in the sand.
Peppa and George go on a boat trip with Grandpa Pig, but they must send Polly Parrot for help when their boat runs aground. Polly fetches Granny Pig and Grandad Dog to rescue them.

Mrs Zebra teaches Peppa, George, Zoe, Zaza and Zuzu Zebra how to make a real tea set from clay.
Madame Gazelle takes the class to London for the day, where they are given a tour of the city by none other than the Queen of England.

Mummy Pig takes Peppa to the doctors for her yearly health check-up with Dr Polar Bear, who checks her height, weight, ears, mouth and heartbeat and listens to Mummy tell him all about the changes Peppa has gone through.
Peppa and her friends visit the cinema for the first time to watch the 'Super Potato' film.
Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa's house and have a fun dinosaur party.
Peppa helps out with Danny Dog refurbishing his bedroom, and imagines a pirate adventure along the way.
Grandpa Pig finds his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to be discharged. Papa and Suzy volunteer to nurse him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable as he was in hospital.
Peppa and her friends are at their clubhouse. They decide to start a detective club, and when Daddy Pig loses his car keys, they have a real mystery to solve.
While Mummy Pig is enjoying a spa day out, Daddy, George and Peppa explore the rest of the shopping centre.
Mummy Pig shows Peppa how to play pretend by teaching her how to wink. Zoe Zebra comes to play with Peppa and brings along her toy monkey. Peppa pretends Monkey has a cough.
Peppa and her family go bowling at the Peppatown Bowling Alley.
Peppa and her friends visit a roller disco organised by Madame Gazelle. After skating along to nursery rhymes, they go wild to the rhythm of the music together with Madame Gazelle.
Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers; the children enjoy identifying the flowers like Wild Garlic, Bluebells and even a rare orchid.
Peppa and her friends learn how to animate their drawings at playgroup.
Playgroup is having a pet competition and everyone has brought their pets. Dr Hamster is the judge, but it is so hard to choose the best pet.
Peppa and her friends are playing pirates, but when they put together a treasure chest and bury it in a marked spot, Pedro soon realises that he needs to follow the trail. He's lost something.
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are going out for the evening. Granny and Grandpa Pig babysit Peppa and George. They are too excited to sleep. When Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig get home everyone is asleep.
Peppa and Luzie Locke find that adults have to work all the time. The children imitate the elders, in the shop and on the playground. They realise that playing can be really hard work.
Peppa and her friends learn how to count by playing games at Madame Gazelle's playschool.
Madame Gazelle gives the class a music lesson. There's lots of crashing and banging at first, but it's not long before the grown-ups visit and lay down some notes of their own.
George has fun making bubbles, and Peppa has fun popping them.
Suzy Sheep has come to play with Peppa, and has made up a pretend friend called 'Leo Lion'. Peppa can't see Leo, but Suzy announces that Leo likes roaring and playing dressing up.
It's Daddy Pig's birthday, but he has to go to work, so while he's away, Mummy Pig, Peppa and George prepare a special birthday surprise.
Daddy Pig is left behind when everyone takes Grampy Rabbit's little boat to the riverside picnic spot. Will someone remember him and save him some cake?
When Daddy Pig and Mummy Pig are tidying up the house, they happen to find an old box of musical instruments. George makes a loud sound with the Swiss horn.
Peppa and George love helping Mummy Pig work on her computer, but they like playing computer games more.
The youngsters visit the zoo where they are shown around by zookeepers Mr Lion, Mrs Crocodile and Mr Giraffe.
Peppa and George are helping Grandpa Pig to dig a new pond for his garden. While digging, they find hidden treasure so they go to see Mr Richard in the museum.
Dr Hamster's pet tortoise, Tiddles, once again gets stuck on top of a tree, but everyone in the rescue team finds it tough to get the tortoise down.
Peppa and her family are at the swimming pool. George is a little worried at first but is soon splashing happily with his friend Richard Rabbit.
Peppa and George are helping Granny and Grandpa Pig tidy their attic, but they have trouble deciding what to throw out because Granny and Grandpa want to keep everything.

It's a beautiful day but Peppa, George and Grandpa Pig are sitting inside watching the motor racing on the television. Granny Pig shoos them all outside to enjoy the sunshine. Inspired by the racing, Grandpa Pig builds George his own racing car.
Peppa and George visit Granny Pig, who is very excited about her new pet, a parrot called Polly.
Peppa and George have to tidy their bedroom. After a frenzy of cleaning, the room is tidy, but the room doesn't stay tidy for long though.
Daddy Pig hangs his clean football shirt out to dry, but Peppa, George and Mummy splash it with mud. They put it in the wash, but Peppa puts her red dress in too, which turns Daddy's shirt pink.
Doctor Hamster visits the school and brings some animals with her. Binky the Tortoise is very popular, but ends up needing to be rescued by Miss Rabbit.
Peppa and her family collect apples and blackberries in Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden to make a pie.
Madame Gazelle gets Peppa and her playgroup friends to dance to all different styles of music.

Gary hilft SpongeBob dabei, "Nein" zu sagen, indem er ihm eine Scheuerschwammfläche zum Überziehen bestellt. SpongeBob hat außerdem einen Ohrwurm, den er immer wieder singt und der ihn langsam in den Wahnsinn treibt.

Will and Min's date ends up in a rideshare turf war; at home, Halmoni throws a party as the kids try to prove they can watch themselves; the family gets famous after the Groom and Board Jingle hits number one, but fame is fickle and tears them apart.

Plankton verkleidet sich als Gary und gibt sich bei der Arbeit als SpongeBobs Haustier aus. Der Plan endet auf der Intensivstation. Patrick vergisst während des Versteckspiels, was er gerade macht und SpongeBob braucht viel Geduld.
Jack has a farewell party; the family rushes to take Jack to the airport.

Mr. Krabs braucht eine Attraktion für sein Restaurant und will sich in Stein meißeln lassen. Thaddäus hat als Künstler dafür genaue Vorstellungen, während Sandy versucht, Bikini Bottom vor dem Angriff der Wellhornschnecken zu bewahren.
pr.sub: Kunst und Krabbe; Verschleimt und verschlungen

pr.d: When Alvin makes fun of Simon's magic act, Simon challenges him to a magic duel. Alvin reluctantly signs up to teach the after school music class, but finds his classmates treat him differently as a teacher.

SpongeBob und Patrick machen ein Freundschaftsquiz, bei dem Patrick sehr schlecht abschneidet, SpongeBob ist natürlich schwer enttäuscht und leidet sehr. Und: SpongeBob und Perla hängen gemeinsam im Boot eines Vergnügungsparks fest.
pr.sub: Von Tuten und Schwamm keine Ahnung; Im Fingerling der Liebe

pr.d: When Alvin notices Brittany being nice to him, he's sure an alien has taken over her body. In order to earn a job on the school newspaper, Alvin helps Simon uncover the biggest story the school's ever seen.
pr.sub: Brittany the Body Snatcher; Agent Smith

pr.d: Zufällig entsteht ein Krosser Hot Dog, der bei den Kunden so gut ankommt, dass der Krabbenburger verbannt wird, weshalb SpongeBob rebelliert. SpongeBob und Patrick finden ein altes Piratenschiff, das für Mr. Krabs eine willkommene Geldquelle ist.
pr.sub: Krosse Dogs; Das Wrack der Mauna Loa

pr.d: After Phoebe chooses Billy to accompany her to their favourite cookie factory's exclusive tasting event, Max and Nora are determined to sneak in and get to the delicious treats first.

Thaddäus will einen potenziellen neuen Nachbarn, mit dem er sich anfreunden möchte, von SpongeBob und Patrick fernhalten, um ihn nicht zu verschrecken. Thaddäus verliebt sich derweil in eine Kundin und SpongeBob soll ihm helfen, sie zu verführen.
pr.sub: Quallenfischendes Seifenblasenbläserpack; Ein Tintenfisch zum Verlieben

pr.d: Tired of hearing tales of Hiddenville's legendary mayor, the kids use a time machine to travel back 60 years to disprove the myths. But when they inadvertently alter the past, the effect is disastrous for their hometown.

Patricks brutale Schwester ist zu Besuch und hinterlässt eine Spur von Chaos und Zerstörung, doch Thaddäus will sie stoppen. Sandy und Plankton arbeiten zusammen an einem Teleporter, allerdings kennt Sandy nicht Planktons Plan für die Verwendung.
pr.sub: Geschwister des Grauens; Die Chemie stimmt

pr.d: Captain Man and Kid Danger learn that an astronaut has been taken hostage aboard the Space Station, and set off on a space rescue.

Thaddäus verletzt sich beim Schlafen im Lagerraum, nun droht er Krabs mit einem Gang zur obersten Werktätigen-Sicherheitsbehörde. Derweil eröffnet eine neue Burgerbude in Bikini Bottom und Mr. Krabs und Plankton versuchen das Burgerrezept zu klauen.

On the Space Station Captain Man and Kid Danger discover a little girl is the one who has taken the astronauts hostage. After realising the astronauts are doing experiments on bunnies, Captain Man and Kid Danger decide to help her.

Mr. Krabs erweitert die Krosse Krabbe um einen Drive-In-Schalter. Schnell ist das komplette Straßennetz in Bikini Bottom deshalb verstopft. SpongeBob bekommt derweil von einem Rennfahrer-Sohn Boots-Unterricht und wird selbst zum Rennfahrer.
The twins and Marsupilamis save an egg from the Jaguar, which hatches into a baby crocodile. The Marsupilamis are helping people, and Callie wants to find out who the Amazing Coat Man hero is.

SpongeBob reicht es und er beschließt, mit den Quallen in der Natur zu leben, außerdem ist Thaddäus am Ende seiner Geduld angekommen. E will sein Haus verkaufen und von SpongeBob und Patrick wegziehen.
Thaddäus veranstaltet einen Talentwettbewerb in der Krossen Krabbe und SpongeBob wird zum Star des Abends, außerdem ist SpongeBob naiv und glaubt, dass er sich mit dem bösen Plankton anfreunden kann.

Was als Freundschaftsausflug auf den Strand beginnt, endet für SpongeBob und Patrick in einem heftigen Wettbewerb im Bauen von Sandburgen. SpongeBob zerbricht Garys Schneckenhaus und versucht für Ersatz zu sorgen, doch er ist zu tollpatschig.
pr.sub: Sandburgen im Sand; Gary allein ohne Haus

pr.d: Smurfalicious Catfood: Annoyed that Azrael doesn't like his baking, Chef makes delicious cat food for him that makes him gentle. Gargamel sees an opportunity to make his mother kinder.
Bubble goes on an adventure with Firefly. Gargamel creates a switch that can turn off all the lights so that he can find the Smurf village.

SpongeBob will dicke Muskeln haben, scheut aber hartes Training. Also bestellt er aufblasbare Arm-Attrappen und gibt damit gehörig in Bikini Bottom an. Beim Anker-Weitwurf-Wettbewerb fällt sein Schwindel schließlich auf.
Dwayne is a huge fan of Lily's waffles, but she refuses to make any more for him.

Planktons Frau Karen rät ihm, dass er mehr Werbung für den "Abfalleimer" machen soll. Aber den Durchbruch erlebt Plankton erst mit einem Werbeslogan, der ausgerechnet von Patrick stammt. Und: Plankton vergisst seinen Hochzeitstag mit Karen.

In keeping with one of the Smurfs' traditions, Chef Smurf and Blossom need to find a thirteenth dessert for Christmas dinner. Bubble and Jokey are the worst babysitters. They have turned Baby Smurf into a snail.

Mr. Krabs will mehr Geld in die Kasse spülen und feiert deshalb den Geburtstag der Krossen Krabbe, bei der viele Pasteten verkauft werden sollen. Allerdings sperren sich Thaddäus, Patrick, SpongeBob und Mr. Krabs versehentlich in der Kühltruhe ein.
Alvin and Brittany wind up in a battle over popping acorn tops and bubble wrap. When a cute girl joins the chess club, Alvin enlists Jeanette to teach him how to play so he can join as well.

Auf der Geburtstagsfeier von Krosse Krabbe schließen sich SpongeBob und seine Freunde aus Versehen in einer Kühltruhe ein und versuchen nun, wieder freizukommen. Derweil macht sich Plankton auf, um das Pasteten-Rezept zu finden.

When Eleanor discovers there are no female knights, she hides in a suit of armour and enters a knight competition; Alvin is having the best dreams of his life, until Theodore subconsciously invades them.

Thaddäus ist wegen eines Sturms mit SpongeBob und Patrick im Haus eingeschlossen. Plankton entdeckt per Zufall eine Unterwasser-Höhle. Er macht daraus ein Ausflugsziel und hört die Kassen klingeln, was Mr. Krabs nicht auf sich sitzen lassen kann.

Rock, Paper and Scissors crash into Hollywood actor Henry Winkler's house, and they all go on a wacky adventure together. While trying to woo Pencil, Paper mistakenly ends up in a relationship he doesn't want with Potato.
pr.sub: The Henry Winkler Episode; Paper Loves Potato

pr.d: König Neptuns 5000. Geburtstag steht an und seine Frau plant in der Krossen Krabbe eine Party für ihn. Doch als alle nett beisammen sind, taucht der verbannte Sohn der beiden, Triton, auf. SpongeBob will die drei wieder vereinen.

Patricks brutale Schwester ist zu Besuch und hinterlässt eine Spur von Chaos und Zerstörung, doch Thaddäus will sie stoppen. Sandy und Plankton arbeiten zusammen an einem Teleporter, allerdings kennt Sandy nicht Planktons Plan für die Verwendung.
pr.sub: Geschwister des Grauens; Die Chemie stimmt

pr.d: Rock is bad at keeping secrets, so when he learns one that will devastate Paper, he goes to great lengths to keep it from him. Sandpaper is disappointed the trio is playing video games all day, so she signs them up for her personal workout program.

Der Monster-Truck Starla hat einen Motorkolben verloren, ohne den sie nicht mehr fahren kann. Der bösartige Crusher macht sich auf die Suche nach dem Kolben, um ihn an seinen Truck zu montieren und endlich der schnellste Truck der Welt zu sein.

LAD has a sleepover and in an effort to join in, Jack ends up making a promise that turns their night upside down. When Will's parents visit Canyon Valley, news of the sale of their bee farm sends the family into a big, honeying.
Die Camper nehmen sich ihre Vorfahren als Vorbild. / SpongeBob hat Spaß mit den Campern.
pr.sub: Mordshunger; Die Hütte der komischen Käuze

pr.d: Chuck moves in with the Wylde-Paks after Lily and Jack accidentally destroy his house. They must hide his awful habits from their parents. Seeking closure on her favourite K-Drama, Lily films her own finale with her family as the cast and crew.
Als Plankton den Nordpol erobert und Weihnachten in Gefahr bringt, verbünden sich SpongeBob, Mr. Krabs und eine Gruppe ungewöhnlicher Außenseiter, um gemeinsam das Weihnachtsfest zu retten.

When Theodore mistakenly thinks he's the oldest brother, he tries to be a better role model for Alvin and Simon. Alvin tricks Theodore into believing he's great at mini golf, which backfires when Theo signs up for a tournament.
pr.sub: Big Bro Theodore; No Putts, No Glory

pr.d: Als Plankton den Nordpol erobert und Weihnachten in Gefahr bringt, verbünden sich SpongeBob, Mr. Krabs und eine Gruppe ungewöhnlicher Außenseiter, um gemeinsam das Weihnachtsfest zu retten.

Jeanette and the Chipmunks orchestrate a break-in at Bocarter's house to rescue a chimpanzee he keeps in a cage. Alvin is alarmed that Dave will be hosting an auction where he'll have to tell jokes because he's not that funny.

Um sich vorm Zahnarzt zu drücken, besteht Lily darauf, das Erntedankfest Chuseok im Sommer zu feiern. // Als Will sich aus Versehen mit einem nervigen Mann anfreundet, werden seine Versuche, ihn wieder loszuwerden, für die ganze Familie unangenehm.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: While Boss Baby is away, interim manager Staci must fend off three challenges -- from Pyg & Tam, OCB and Bug the Pug.

Min will das Chaos bei Woori World umgehen, weshalb sich die Familie für ihren Einkauf aufteilt. Doch bald verlieren sie sich. Jack sucht die seltene Fortsetzung seines Lieblingsfilms auf DVD und stößt dabei auf einen mysteriösen Sammler.
pr.sub: Wocheneinkauf in Woori World / Der Sammler

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: Boss Baby discovers an old Mega Fat initiative called Project Boom that threatens to ruin baby rights everywhere.

Papier glaubt, er sei an einer Elite-Uni angenommen worden. Dann merkt er, dass er nur in der dritten Klasse gelandet ist, die jedoch überraschend schwer ist. Schere bringt Lou dazu zu kündigen. Daraufhin übernimmt Catalina und ruiniert sein Leben.
pr.sub: Papier besucht eine Eliteschule / Die neue Vermieterin

pr.d: Als Schere einen Tannenzapfen verschluckt, nutzt Bleistift einen Origami-Roboter, um in seinen Magen zu gelangen. Schere sieht einen Film über einen Underdog, der trotz aller Widrigkeiten Football-Star wird, und versucht es ihm gleichzutun.
pr.sub: Der Origami Roboter / Schere schaut einen inspirierenden Sportfilm

pr.d: Mrs Wong visits Secret Shores, threatening to reveal the Thundermans' superhero identities to the town. Max and Phoebe's plan to have Dr Colosso keep her quiet backfires in unexpected ways.

Lily benutzt zum Entsetzen ihrer Geschwister andauernd ein Schimpfwort, das sie zufällig gehört hat. Ein Brief, adressiert an "L. Loud", erreicht die Familie. Doch keiner weiß, für wen der Liebesbrief bestimmt ist und wer der geheime Verehrer ist.
pr.sub: Lilys erstes Schimpfwort; Der geheime Verehrer

pr.d: Max convinces Cherry to pretend they are dating to get discounts at her new workplace, Splat by Sea. Meanwhile, Chloe must choose between winning a quiz or supporting Billy's wish to join her team.

Für Ronnie Anne wird der Besuch bei ihrer Verwandtschaft zu einem einschneidenden Erlebnis. Denn statt nur einige Tage zu bleiben, soll sie ganz in die Stadt umziehen. Sie bittet Lincoln und Lori, den Umzug zu verhindern.
Olympic Skateboarder Lola Tabling shows us her amazing skills at the skate park.

Lincoln und Clyde versuchen alles, um auf einem der Fotos für das Jahrbuch aufzutauchen. Lincoln schlägt seinen Schwestern vor, die Zimmer zu tauschen, weil die beiden sich die ganze Zeit streiten. Sein Plan geht jedoch nach hinten los.
Alvin volunteers to caddy a charity golf tournament and surprisingly gets paired up with Miss Smith.
When Patrick leaves his brain at home, Squidina needs to work with it to find his body. When SpongeBob goes on a trip with his parents for a day, he asks Squidina to pet-sit Gary.
pr.sub: SQUIDINA AND THE BRAIN/DAY OF THE SNAIL

pr.d: Lincolns Freunde wollen ihn nach Ronnie Annes Umzug trösten. Lucy wird von ihren Geschwistern ignoriert. Sie will ihnen eine Lektion verpassen und nutzt einen Zauberspruch.
Damit Luan am 1. April nicht verrückt macht, heckt die Familie einen hinterhältigen Plan aus.
Patrick and Squidina re-tape the family's home videos. Patrick spends a day with Cecil's brother.

SpongeBob, Patrick und Thaddäus werden vom "Fliegenden Holländer" entführt und zu Sklaven gemacht. Sie sollen für den Rest ihres Lebens auf dem Schiff arbeiten, doch die drei gehen dem legendären Seefahrer schon bald auf die Nerven.
When Plankton takes over the North Pole, SpongeBob, Mr. Krabs and a group of misfits team up to save Christmas.

SpongeBob und Patrick haben mal wieder Ärger am Hals, denn sie sollen für eine Geisterschiffscrew ein Ersatzteil für den Bootsmotor besorgen. Wenn sie das nicht tun, bekommen sie ihre Seelen, die die Geister ihnen abgenommen haben, nie wieder.

Der Fliegende Holländer gehört zu den berühmtesten Gespenstern der Welt. Er zieht bei SpongeBob ein und erschreckt ihn ständig. Doch irgendwann erschreckt SpongeBob sich nicht mehr vor ihm. Der Fliegende Holländer ist bestürzt.

Es ist Halloween, und SpongeBob hat ein Problem. Er gruselt sich vor allem und jedem, aber ihn will niemand gruselig finden. Mithilfe von Patrick macht er sich ein 'gruseliges' Kostüm zurecht, das unter anderem auch einen radikalen Haar- oder vielmehr Schwammschnitt mit sich bringt. Aber auch damit bleiben die Erfolge bescheiden. Da taucht auf der Halloween-Party in der Krossen Krabbe plötzlich der echte Fliegende Holländer auf, dem seine schlechten Kopisten auf die Nerven gehen.
Die Crew der Krossen Krabbe baut ein Boot für ihren geizigen Kapitän.

Paper and Scissors struggle to make Rock's outlandish half-birthday wish that he can fly come true. Scissors stays home when Rock and Paper go cherry-picking, but when they grow much closer to one another, he feels left out.

Mr. Krabs isst eine verschimmelte Krabben-Pizza und hat eine Lebensmittelvergiftung. SpongeBob verletzt sich beim Sand-Boarden am Hinterteil und hat jetzt Angst vor allem. Er will gar nicht mehr aus dem Haus. Sandy und Patrick versuchen alles.

Die Familie Thunderman will eine Urlaubsreise gewinnen und nimmt deshalb an einem Familienwettkampf teil. Allerdings können sich nicht für ein Reiseziel entscheiden, und nehmen deshalb in zwei Teams teil. Das Gewinner-Team entscheidet das Reiseziel.

Paper and Pencil inadvertently create a horde of Rock clones and decide to look after them together. Rock, Paper, and Scissors find a genie, but just as they're about to make their wish, his 1,000-year curse runs out, and he can no longer grant it.
pr.sub: Rock, Rock, Rock, Rock, Rock, Paper, Scissors; The Wish

pr.d: Phoebe veranstaltet ihre erste Übernachtungsparty und verhindert per Telekinese einen Reinfall. Allerdings wird sie dabei erwischt und mit einem Kettchen bestraft, das ihre Superkräfte drosselt. Sie bittet Max um Hilfe.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: An innocent trip to the library for toddler story hour sparks a turf war between babydom and Frederic Estes' Consortium of Ancients.

Das Trio will einen Pogo-Stick beschaffen, um unbedingt zu der Party von den Ratten-Bros zu gehen. Stein bewirbt sich um einen Job bei der "Fiese-Roboter-Company". Papier und Schere prüfen deshalb, ob das Unternehmen die Wahrheit sagt.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: On a dark and stormy night, Tim and Boss Baby set traps for two wildly different threats: a mythical monster and a Puppy Co. agent named Bug the Pug.

Schere hilft Papier dabei, ein spannendes Wochenende zu planen, welches Bleistift beeindruckt. Stein kauft sich einen Hut. Schere, Stein und Papier wollen unbedingt beweisen, dass sie nicht durch Plastik ersetzt werden sollten.
Max and Phoebe discover that Lazlo Chance may be the evil mastermind and enlist Chloe to help. But when Chloe is torn between her head and her heart, it threatens the entire mission.

Die Familie Star hat ein Haustier, die Toilette Tinkle, die elf Toilettenwelpen bekommt. Die Familie Star genießt ihre Lieblingspicknick-Aktivitäten, jedoch ist ihnen nicht bewusst, dass sie auf einem Friedhof sind und nicht in einem Park.
pr.sub: 10 und 1 Toiletten; Familie Star im Park

pr.d: Pinky beschließt, dass es einen König des Schulballs geben muss und stellt seinen Mitschülern folglich mehrere Herausforderungen, die von seiner Lieblingsserie 'Schlacht um die Krone' inspiriert sind. Wer wird der König des Herbstballs werden?
Lola beschwert sich über ein Haar im Essen und findet heraus, dass sie sich so Gratissachen ergaunern kann.
Olympic Skateboarder Lola Tabling shows us her amazing skills at the skate park.
The Munks help a famous runner design a pair of prosthetic legs for a race she's set to run in.

Als Luan Grouse einen Streich mit einem falschen Lottoschein spielt, muss sie die Konsequenzen ihres Einkaufverhaltens tragen. Lynn versucht verzweifelt, Basketballschuhe einer beliebten Marke zu finden, weil sie vorher kein Paar kaufen konnte.

Will and Min's date ends up in a rideshare turf war; at home, Halmoni throws a party as the kids try to prove they can watch themselves; the family gets famous after the Groom and Board Jingle hits number one, but fame is fickle and tears them apart.

Um keine Hausarbeiten machen zu müssen, benutzt Lincoln Lisas Hologrammgerät. Es sieht so aus, als würde er alles erledigen. Weil Mom bei der Arbeit ist, müssen sich die Loud-Geschwister um Dad kümmern, der wegen einer Erkältung im Bett liegt.
Jack has a farewell party; the family rushes to take Jack to the airport.
SpongeBob und Plankton müssen eine Insel voller Monster überleben; Patrick lernt das Fahrradfahren.
When Plankton takes over the North Pole, SpongeBob, Mr. Krabs and a group of misfits team up to save Christmas.

Die hausgemachten Snacks von Sandy werden zum großen Erfolg in der Krossen Krabbe. SpongeBob und Patrick haben ein Lieblings-Comedy-Duo. Doch kommt es zwischen dem Duo vor der Kamera zu einem Streit, und sie sehen dabei zu.
pr.sub: Heiß gegrillte Nüsse / Sir Seeigel und Schneck Scheiter

pr.d: SpongeBob feiert den Jahrestag der Freundschaft mit Thaddäus; Thaddäus muss zur Musikstunde.
Als SpongeBob bei einer Lieferung einen Milchshake verschüttet, verspricht er, das ganze Gebäude zu reinigen!
An online supplier ships his goods by a flying drone, which Sam and Cat find normal. However, the technology is not yet fully developed, and the flying object causes a lot of chaos.
When Sam and Cat try to help Goomer with a supposed bully at his gym, Sam ends up knocking out an 🥊 [MMA] MMA champ. Surprisingly, he quickly gets pulled into the world of professional fighting.
After Sadie loses the Christmas spirit and cancels the Holiday pageant, the Ghosts of Past, Present, and Future - embodied by Lay Lay - visit to remind her of the true meaning of Christmas.
pr.sub: All I Want for Christmas Is Lay Lay

pr.d: Lay Lay discovers a new power -- she can clone herself; Sadie and Bryce create a father-daughter video together, which makes them famous!

With the Villain League determined to halt Phoebe's superhero ascension and destroy the Thundermans altogether, Max must finally choose between fighting for good with his family, or a life of evil against them.
Captain Man, Kid Danger and Phoebe Thunderman infiltrate a villain meeting in Swellview where the villains plan to destroy Captain Man and Kid Danger.
When Dr Minyak plans to ruin Double G's worldwide charity concert, Captain Man and Kid Danger join forces with the Game Shakers to defeat Dr Minyak and keep Double G safe.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: The field team enters one of their own in the prestigious Lil' Dumpling Pageant to make sure the winner is someone Baby Corp can trust.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: A backed-up Boss Baby is forced to take a sick day when his system stalls, and he can't go boom-boom, so it's up to Tim to take over.

pr.d: Tim's alter ego, space detective Dekker Moonboots, steps in to solve a Baby Corp mystery as mounting clues suggest it is an inside job.
pr.sub: Formula for Menace: A Dekker Moonboots Mystery
