Back in 1985, Will is having doubts about his sexuality and phones teenage Jack for advice, but the results could prove upsetting for Grace.
Grace is horrified to lean her new beau has six toes on one foot, even though he accepts an ugly sore on her lip.
pr.sub: Three's a Crowd, Six Is a Freak Show

pr.d: Will is annoyed by Grace's behaviour when they are asked to read at the civil union of two friends. He feels like she is acting more like a wife than an old friend. Meanwhile, Karen tries to help a caffeine-addicted Jack recover from a failed crush.
Will and Grace pose as millionaires while visiting the town house of Sandra Bernhard, but their plans go awry when Sandra Bernhard accepts an offer they end up making on her house.
Will attempts to impress a new friend, sports journalist Matt, with his baseball skills, but ends up having to take advice from Grace.
Victoria and Patel encounter fish and game officers while on a call; dispatch radios with a report of an aggressive attack dog on the loose.
Animal Control dispatch alerts the teams to a goose that's on the loose. And the precinct hosts an animal adoption day.
The team welcomes back Patel even though he is still on suspension; Shred and Victoria are called into the principal's office on a school visit; Rick heads back into the field with Frank.
Frank battles with the idea of getting older when Templeton benches him on the basketball team; Rick asks Emily out on a date, just as Shred realises he might have a thing for her.
When the precinct's beloved mountain lion dies, Frank takes it especially hard; Shred tries to break up with Camilla before he ruins his chances with Emily.
A realtor and a former tennis star duo struggle to stay afloat in life and love as a gruesome serial killer preying on innocent people puts Los Angeles on high alert.
After Nathan's botched proposal, Ava fights to keep him on target, Matt asks to meet, and a petrified Nathan worries he is a suspect when police detectives visit the club.
Matt drops in on Nathan at the Beverly Club, Nathan struggles to keep his story straight, and Ava and Nathan attempt to maintain power as they spar with Matt for creative control.
Ava and Nathan surround themselves with thousands of true crime addicts at Crime Con in Las Vegas, a surprise panellist threatens the podcast, and Nathan has a moral crisis.

After Will and Grace's parents get married, big changes are afoot for the gang. Will gets a teaching job and a beard, Grace decides to run for office, Jack prepares to settle down with Estefan and Karen goes missing.
pr.sub: Where in the World Is Karen Walker?

pr.d: When Jack discovers what song his grandson means to perform at his church talent show, he becomes worried about his safety. Karen faces off with Beverley Leslie about a piece of border wall.
Will and Grace reminisce about old times and get into an argument. With the help of Jack and his new-found gift, Karen is visited by an old friend who convinces her not to give up on love.

While on a road trip with her father, Grace reveals a past secret that changes their relationship forever. Meanwhile, legendary drag queen Miss Coco Peru emcees a lip-sync monologue throwdown to determine who will be Jack's best man, Will or Karen.

When Will finds out that Noah has a child, he promises to shield Grace from the truth. Then, Karen and Jack's relationship is put to the test when she axes him from her play, replacing him with Jon Cryer.
Dwight must overcome his fear of public speaking when he is named Dunder-Mifflin's Salesman of the Year, and turns to Michael for help. Meanwhile, Jim plans to escape Scranton to avoid Pam's wedding.

A routine office day is upended when children descend upon Dunder Mifflin for Take Your Daughter to Work Day. Michael is surprised when he strikes up a friendship with the five-year-old daughter of his sworn enemy, Toby.
pr.sub: Take Your Daughter to Work Day

pr.d: It's a difficult time for Kevin as he awaits his test results. All the staff rally round in support, although this does put a damper on Michael's self-thrown birthday party. So he takes the gang ice skating instead, but Jim and Pam slip away to find a present for Kevin.
Dwight plays the role of volunteer sheriff after finding half a joint in the Dunder Mifflin car park. Elsewhere, Pam challenges Jim to be silent.
Chaos ensues when Michael takes responsibility for conflict resolution from the Human Relations department.

Dunder-Mifflin holds a casino night in the warehouse to benefit charity. While Michael faces the task of juggling two dates, Jim is forced to ponder the reality of transferring to the Stamford branch and what that means for his relationship with Pam.

West Virginia family man Jimmy Logan teams up with his one-armed brother Clyde and sister Mellie to steal money from the Charlotte Motor Speedway in North Carolina. Jimmy also recruits demolition expert Joe Bang to help them break into the track's underground system. Complications arise when a mix-up forces the crew to pull off the heist during a popular 🏁 [NASCAR] NASCAR race, while also trying to dodge a relentless FBI agent.
When Matty makes Ted go to school with John, Ted immediately decides to get expelled. Created and voiced by Seth MacFarlane.
After Matty kicks Blaire from his house after finding out about her drug business, she attempts to bribe the family into letting her stay.
When a Colorado grandfather vanishes, conflicting family stories lead police to uncover a dark betrayal beneath the concrete floor of his own basement.
Investigating the heinous crimes of the deeply embittered and jealous Gytis Griskevicius, who brutally attacked and drowned his estranged wife Marina Erte in her Lincolnshire flat in 2016.
After ending her relationship, 15-year-old Maleha Masud paid the ultimate price when her ex-boyfriend started a lethal blaze that also killed her sister Nabiha at the family's South London home.

When Bonnie Craig turns up dead in a creek outside Anchorage, Alaska, authorities think she had an accident while hiking, but her mother doesn't believe it and spends years pursuing the truth behind the tragedy.
A driver gets pulled over with brake lights that do not work, but that is not the end of the matter, as they have also manipulated their odometer to save on fees.
A traffic cop gets more than he bargained for when he pulls over a man for not wearing a seat belt.
A young motorcyclist executes a reckless one-wheel manoeuvre in front of Ash Bowden's unmarked police car, and he finds himself in deeper trouble when he makes excuses and denies responsibility.

Senior Constables Ash and Paul are patrolling residential streets when they witness a driver undertaking a dangerous burnout in front of them, and Senior Constable Matt saves an injured dog in danger of straying onto the road.
Canines in Chicago sniff out cash; a Canadian vehicle is seedy; officers discover a traveller's alter ego; officers sift through suspicious leaves.
In a dramatic bust an American man makes a shocking confession and authorities discover a rare and unusual item in a strange package from Russia.
Officers realise that a Chinese man is covering for a partner in crime when he won't answer questions. What he is hiding in his luggage could have a devastating effect on biosecurity.
The specially trained officers of the Road Crime Unit use three of their high performance police cars to box in a suspect motor on a busy dual carriageway.
From blockbuster smashes and explosive road rage, to crazy police chases and thieving animals, it's all caught on dashcam.
A husband and wife find themselves targeted by troublesome teenagers in their own home, and a spoilsport gang attacks a play centre for children.
The sparks fly as a gang of thieves target cash point machines with a chainsaw and a family dog is stolen from the back garden.
Police hunt a man with an axe who has robbed a small village store terrifying the shop assistant, and a carer gets her comeuppance when the family put in a hidden camera.
From animals taking over the roads, to arguments over parking, we've got it all caught on camera.

In 1983, 16-year-old Colette Aram was abducted, raped, and strangled in Nottinghamshire, but police only caught up with her killer in 2009 thanks to advances in forensic technology unearthing his DNA.

Looking at the life and horrifying crimes of Angel Maturino Reséndiz, also known as the 'Railroad Killer' due to many of his murders being committed near railways as he travelled across the United States.
The life and crimes of the convicted fraudster Stephen Seddon, a murderer driven by greed who killed his parents in cold blood when his attempt to fake a car accident ended in failure.
When elite racer Anna Wilson is shot and killed, police launch a manhunt to Costa Rica in search of Kaitlin Armstrong.
When the body of a missing 69-year-old farmer was found in the River Hiz, investigators discovered that a bitter divorce was the catalyst for his estranged wife and her new lover committing murder.
In 2012, April Jones disappeared from outside her home in Wales, never to be seen again. Her abductor and murderer was found to be Mark Bridger, who was sentenced to life imprisonment.
Bite marks in a block of cheese hold the key to catching a killer when he helps himself to a snack after a home invasion that claims the lives of three members of the Laitner family.
Two retirees disappear from their home near Rutland Water, and forensic scientists search for evidence to prove that the pair had been murdered.

Two bodies, unaccounted-for evidence and a short timeline made a single killer physically improbable. LAPD and prosecutors fixated on one killer, but never-before-seen evidence and forgotten witnesses suggest another theory: O.J. Simpson had help.

All is revealed in the explosive conclusion. Unprecedented interviews with O.J.'s inner circle expose a drug-smuggling ally who escaped prison shortly before the murders. Jaw-dropping information unveils the identity of O.J.'s alleged co-conspirator.

A look at how forensic science can help police solve serious crimes where the truth seems impossible to uncover. As the various twists and turns of each case unfold, the role of forensic science in providing answers is highlighted and examined.

Shedding light on shocking crimes that have taken place in small towns and villages across Britain, from chilling execution murders by complete strangers to crimes of passion in the most unexpected locations.

Looking at the life and horrifying crimes of Angel Maturino Reséndiz, also known as the 'Railroad Killer' due to many of his murders being committed near railways as he travelled across the United States.

All is revealed in the explosive conclusion. Unprecedented interviews with O.J.'s inner circle expose a drug-smuggling ally who escaped prison shortly before the murders. Jaw-dropping information unveils the identity of O.J.'s alleged co-conspirator.

The MMR team helps a lost sea turtle get back home. A huge sea lion is found shot with a cross bow bolt, and Dr Marty helps a fruit bat cope with old age.
Lewa Conservancy is working to return elephants to territory from Mt Kenya to Samburu National Park. They have also created an elephant exclusion zone to try to restore a damaged ecosystem.
Every day in the Luangwa Valley a carcass is sighted. Each body holds the story that led them to their death. In Safari CSI we investigate what killed three carcasses that have been uncovered.
Dive into the crystal clear waters of Cozumel, a lush Caribbean paradise just off the coast of Mexico that hides the largest subterranean underwater cave system in the world.

Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard, the penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon.

This island of the coast of Honduras stands out as a holiday resort hot spot. But it's not just the sun and sand that brings the tourists in droves. It's actually a diver's paradise with shipwrecks scattered from all corners of the island.
A former wasteland where an entire city's wastewater used to be deposited is now a paradise for birds migrating from across the continent and beyond.

A single marine species shapes life on Santa Maria, one of the smallest Azores islands. As Europe's only regular hotspot for whale sharks, the island depends on these gentle giants even as their migration patterns remain unexplained.

Flying squirrels leaping through the air is quite a sight, especially for researchers who know they are not supposed to be there. The southern flying squirrel are typically found along the shores of Lake Erie.
Sometimes animals get a second chance. Such as the majestic elk, who went extinct in Ontario thanks to habitat loss and overaggressive hunting.
Endure Earth's harshest environments, where extraordinary creatures battle the elements to survive.

pr.d: Eoin starts his island voyage on Rathlin, then heads west for Malin Head and Inishtrahull meeting Basking Sharks and Dolphins en route, before going south to Achill Island and the story of the Irish Stoat.

pr.t: David Attenborough's Natural History Museum Alive
pr.d: Naturalist David Attenborough heads to London's Natural History Museum - a place he has been visiting since he was a boy - to bring some of his favourite extinct creatures back to life in a groundbreaking special. The museum's extinct inhabitants are brought to life through a combination of state-of-the-art CGI, science, and research to help illustrate how the animals once roamed Earth. The animals brought back to life range from long-extinct dinosaurs to creatures like the dodo that have become extinct more recently.

Predators are born to kill. These specialised hunters with impressive weapons and unique attack strategies must kill to survive, but the harsh reality of life as a hunter is never knowing where your next meal is coming from.

In some of the most-remote regions on the planet, researchers dive deep and brave danger to unlock secret shark behaviours and fight for the protection of these supreme predators before it is too late.
Meet the world's most venomous snake living in Central Australia and discover the unusual stonefish, a deadly fish with a fatal sting that lurks beneath the tropical waters.
In the South American rainforest, a tiny frog protects itself by being packed with poison. On the other side of the world, near Sydney, Australia, meet the world's most venomous spider.

The Enterprise crew are caught in a culture clash between two races fighting for survival when the crew's rescue of a missing Earth colony leads to the discovery of a civilisation composed entirely of clones.
Counsellor Troi's mother beams herself aboard the Enterprise and sets her sights firmly on Captain Picard.
To prevent war being waged on the Federation, a half-Klingon emissary who is also an ex-girlfriend of Worf is taken onboard, and Worf masquerades as Captain.
While Wynonna contemplates the history of the Earp curse, her Black Badge cohorts must go all out to save Purgatory's future.

Wynonna asks Doc to bet the farm on a knife-edge conundrum. Meanwhile, despite her newfound confidence, Waverly finds herself terrorised by an old acquaintance. Could forging a new friendship sweeten the pill?

As the Widows and their paralysing poison grow in power, it is only a matter of time before Purgatory's defenders have a deadly run-in with the ladies in black. Jeremy has looked to science and beyond in the hope of synthesising an antidote, but has the well finally run dry?

Bei "Stream Baby Stream" fällt ein Online-Streamer unfreiwillig in einen Pool. Eine Katze zeigt, wie man elegant über Hindernisse springt - bis sie selbst vom Regal fällt. Und ein Fußballer will das Tor köpfen und schießt daneben.

Anne und Bastians Beziehung läuft gerade nicht so gut und das Sexualleben stagniert, seitdem ein Digital-Wecker neben dem Bett steht. Als Anne dieses Thema bei einem Abendessen mit Til Schweiger zur Sprache bringt, herrscht Chaos.
Hagen hat vor seine launische Nachbarin Svenja auf die Geburtstagsfeier von Vater Volker einzuladen. Bastian ist damit gar nicht zufrieden, doch Anne kann sich durchsetzen.
Elsa, die Putzfrau von Bastians Vater Volker, steht ganz plötzlich vor der Tür. Er will sich bei ihr gleich entschuldigen, doch sie gibt zu, dass sie Volker heiraten will.
Annes Ex-Freund Jo ist ganz plötzlich zu Besuch gekommen und hängt sich an die beiden dran. Er will neue Energy-Drinks an Fitnessstudios verkaufen, doch Bastian verhindert dies unabsichtlich.

Axel ist eifersüchtig. Yvonne hat einen neuen Job - und einen neuen Chef, der sie in seinem Porsche nach Hause fährt. Als er sie dann beim Tanzen mit ihrem Chef beobachtet, ist das Maß voll und Axel stellt Yvonne zur Rede.

Das Maß ist voll: Axel hat keine Lust mehr, bei seinen Schwiegereltern zu wohnen, er kommt einfach nicht zur Ruhe. Er macht sich mit Yvonne auf Wohnungssuche. Kaum ist die passende Wohnung gefunden, kommt ihnen Robert in die Quere.

Axel und Yvonne sind bei den Schwiegereltern ausgezogen und wohnen nun bei Bong. Zunächst finden sie es toll und feiern viele Partys. Schnell wird jedoch klar, dass zu viel Freiheit auch seine Nachteile haben kann.

Axel muss auf Yvonnes Patenkind Michelle aufpassen. Leider will die Kleine nicht zur Ruhe kommen, egal was Axel probiert. Schließlich entscheidet Axel, einen Spaziergang im Park zu machen und dabei ein paar Frauen aufzureißen.

Maren meint, dass ihr Aktzeichner die Brustwarzen nicht realistisch malt. Katja ist ein echter Telenovela-Fan. So kommt es auch, dass sie ihre Ehe umschreiben lässt. Doch das Ende kommt anders als gedacht.

Anna verliert ihren Job. Doch das lässt sie nicht so einfach auf sich sitzen! Immerhin hat ihr Chef einiges zu verheimlichen. Monika weiß, dass sie als Frau auf dem Arbeitsmarkt keine Chance hat. Deshalb bewirbt sie sich als Mann.

pr.t: How to Clean Up for Cash
pr.d: Josie Gibson and the team are in Brighton helping Dan, whose home has been taken over by his fiancee's stash of vintage treasures. Natacha used to run an online vintage shop, but since the arrival of their baby everything has been put on hold. Maja moves to Houston to undertake a difficult weight-loss journey with the support of her boyfriend, Christian; when Christian decides he's had enough and leaves Maja high and dry, she discovers that the only person she can count on is herself.

Als ein Mann Drohbriefe von einem Stalker erhält, muss er feststellen, dass die Drohungen aus der Geisterwelt kommen. Als ein Geschichtsfan Souvenirs von einem Friedhof mitnimmt, kehrt ein General von den Toten zurück, um sich zu rächen.

Für Alyssa steht alles auf dem Spiel: Gemeinsam mit ihrer kleinen Tochter lebt sie im weitläufigen Anwesen ihrer Großmutter - doch die Familie ist überzeugt, dass dort etwas Böses lauert. Während das Medium Amy bei ihrer Begehung auf rastlose Tote und eine düstere Kreatur stößt, gräbt der Ex-Ermittler Steve tief in der Geschichte des Hauses.

pr.d: Die steigenden Immobilienpreise in Großbritannien bringen viele Mieter in eine finanzielle Notlage. Dieses Mal wird eine Mutter mit zwei Kindern gezwungen, ihr Zuhause zu verlassen. Der Eigentümer hat das Haus bereits verkauft.

pr.d: Sheldon gets a dorm room all to himself; Meemaw gains an unwanted business partner.
pr.sub: An Expensive Glitch and a Goof-Off Room

pr.d: Immer mehr Menschen aus der sozialen Mittelschicht in Großbritannien geraten in finanzielle Not. Dieses Mal müssen Brian O'Shaughnessy und sein Arbeitskollege Del Anglin 2.000 Euro bei einem Unternehmer in der Grafschaft Kent eintreiben.
When Leonard buys a dining room table, Sheldon re-evaluates the changes in his life. Meanwhile, Bernadette is torn when Wolowitz gets the chance to go back to space.

Wenn die Zwangsvollstrecker klingeln, ist es für Erklärungen bereits zu spät. Dann wird nur noch geschaut, was zu Geld gemacht werden kann. Denn die Gläubiger warten auf ihr Geld. Dieses Mal müssen Delroy Anglin und Kevin Stokes zur Tat schreiten.

After arguing with Sheldon, Howard tries to make amends by taking him to NASA headquarters in Houston. Penny has second thoughts about quitting her waitressing job when her car dies. Amy gets involved in trying to find Raj a date.
When Sheldon visits his mum in Houston, he is forced to confront a new reality. Back in Pasadena, Raj's Murder Mystery party causes conflict for the rest of the gang.

Die High-Court-Sheriffs Billy und Claire fordern 11.000 Pfund für einen schadhaften Van ein. Rob und Gerald müssen in einem Herrenhaus ausstehende Löhne eintreiben und ziehen dafür am Ende noch die Polizei und den Schlüsseldienst hinzu.
Raj is wracked with guilt about dating Lucy and Emily at the same time, and Penny wrestles with her conscience over whether to accept a role in a terrible horror film.
Sheldon faces a personal crisis when he starts to wonder whether he's wasting his time with his study of String Theory, although Penny does her best to offer him advice.

In Yorkshire kämpfen Ben und Myles für eine junge Frau, die drei Jahre lang auf ihr erstes Auto gespart hat. Doch der Fiat 500, den sie bei "Motor Arena" gekauft hat, entpuppt sich als ein Altfahrzeug. Zur selben Zeit versuchen Luke und Carl in Kent, von einem Barbetreiber eine offene Rechnung einzutreiben, der sich hinter verschlossenen Türen und Ausreden versteckt. In Blackburn sorgt ein weiterer Autohändler für Ärger und Verzögerungen.
Penny tries to help Sheldon when he reconsiders his relationship with String Theory. During a dinner with Howard and Bernadette, Raj discovers Howard once embarrassed himself on a date with Emily.
As the gang celebrates Star Wars Day, Sheldon has difficulty dealing with the death of Professor Proton.

In Reading räumen Sheriffs einen illegalen Pizzaladen, dessen Betreiber keine Miete gezahlt hat. Gleichzeitig decken ihre Kollegen die fragwürdigen Tricks eines Autohändlers auf und setzen einen internationalen Bootshersteller unter Druck.
A bad day compels Penny to re-evaluate her choices, including Leonard. Meanwhile, Bernadette and Howard must care for Mrs Wolowitz and Sheldon gives Raj advice on relationships.
Faced with an uncertain future, Sheldon considers a major change. Meanwhile, Emily and Raj decide to take things to the next level.

Emma hört am liebsten Horrorcore. Die 16-Jährige trifft im Internet auf Sam, der ihre Leidenschaft für die Musik teilt. Sie verabreden sich auf einem Horrorcore-Festival. Doch als sie Sam sieht, ist Emma enttäuscht von ihrem Date.
Leonard and Amy make an unexpected trip to Arizona to fetch Sheldon; Penny interviews for a job at Bernadette's company; Stuart's relationship with Mrs. Wolowitz disturbs Howard.

When Sheldon has to teach a course at the university, Howard surprises everyone by enrolling on it. Meanwhile, Amy has an opportunity to play Penny and Bernadette off against each other when tension brews over Penny's new job.

Der arbeitslose David Pauley und der ebenfalls arbeitslose Landschaftsgärtner Scott Davis reagieren auf eine Jobanzeige im Internet: Gesucht wird ein Aufpasser für eine abgelegene Farm. Für beide Männer beginnt damit ein tödlicher Alptraum.

Howard becomes nervous after NASA asks him to throw out the first pitch at a Los Angeles Angels game. Meanwhile, Leonard and Penny try to prove Sheldon wrong when he says that he and Amy have a 'superior' relationship.

Raj's honesty about his past comes back to haunt him after his girlfriend Emily gives Penny the cold shoulder as a result. The guys consider becoming part-owners of Stuart's comic-book shop by investing in his business.

Die 18-jährige Kirgisin Anastasia lernt über das Internet den 36-jährigen Indle aus Seattle kennen. Sie willigt ein, ihn zu heiraten, und reist in die USA. Doch der neue Gatte entpuppt sich als alles andere als der Mann ihrer Träume.

Amy and Bernadette accuse Penny of spoiling their fun after she is forced to revise for a work assessment during their weekend trip to Las Vegas, and the guys get together in an attempt to invent something of scientific importance.
Sheldon and Raj set up a test to find out whether they could survive a dark-matter research expedition in a salt mine by simulating the conditions in a steam tunnel underneath the university.

Dr. James Aune, Professor an einer Universität in Texas, lässt sich in einem Internet-Chatroom auf eine geheime Internet-Affäre ein, ohne über die Konsequenzen nachzudenken. Er setzt alles aufs Spiel, bis sein Geheimnis aufzufliegen droht.

The guys try to help Penny out of an awkward professional situation when a smitten doctor turns up at her door after her flirtatious sales techniques on behalf of the pharmaceutical company work a little too well.

The girls decide they want to re-enact their high-school proms, so the gang recreate the whole event on the roof of the flat building, but Sheldon feels under pressure to participate in all the typical romantic traditions.

Ein grausamer Doppelmord, eine freigesprochene Verdächtige und ein Haus, in dem die Toten keine Ruhe finden: 1892 wurden der wohlhabende Bankier Andrew Borden und seine Frau Abby mit einer Axt erschlagen.
When Leonard gets minor surgery on his nose, Sheldon is the one in need of sympathy. Meanwhile, Raj's parents' impending divorce causes Howard and Bernadette to work on their own marriage.

Sheldon says an emotional goodbye to Fun with Flags as he and Amy record the final instalment of their internet show. Leonard, Howard and Raj clear out the office of a recently deceased professor and try to find something significant in his research.

Im Alexandra Centre in Inglewood gehen Jordyn und Johnny rätselhaften Phänomenen nach. Unterstützt von Geisterjäger Kenny stoßen sie auf die düstere Geschichte des Hausmeisters Joe sowie weiterer ruheloser Seelen. In Katakomben, Sporthalle und Heizraum hören sie unerklärliche Geräusche und verstörende Stimmen. Eine Solo-Erkundung im Kriechkeller bringt Jordyn an seine Grenzen. Die Jungs setzen Wünschelruten, Kerzen und eine Polaroidkamera ein und probieren sogar das Spielzeug des Teufels aus.
Amy hosts a traditional Victorian Christmas Eve dinner, Raj's father comes to visit, and the guys try to shoo out a bird they let into the university clean room.

Jen has substantial growths on her ears that cause her depression, pain and vertigo. Juliet is under emotional distress because of the bumps all over her neck and chest. Gerald has a mysterious, kiwi-size lump on his middle finger.
Die paranormalen Ermittler besuchen eine Familie, die von einem bösartigen Wesen aus ihrem Zuhause vertrieben wurde. Ihr Unglück begann, als sie eine Puppe aus der Wohnung eines Messies mitnahmen.
Tony has large growths on his nose that impair his breathing and hopes Dr. Lee can help. And, Marie has an unsightly lump on her forehead that makes her a hermit.

Zak und sein Team durchqueren das kalifornische Death Valley, um ein geheimnisvolles, weitläufiges Gelände zu untersuchen. Fasziniert von der dunklen, kraftvollen Energie der Wüste, erforschen sie die vom Hochwasser und Feuer zerstörte Villa.
Traci's confidence was destroyed after years of bullying about the bumps that have plagued her face for 20 years. Ravon has a unique dangling growth on his leg.
Wincanton in Somerset ist diesmal das Ziel des Ghosthunter-Trios. Hier wurde eine 4500 Jahre alte Begräbnisstätte gefunden.
Robert is back to see if Dr. Lee and Dr. Umar can remove his recurring head keloid for good. Justice has small lesions all over her body that get inflamed.

Als Tinas Lieblingspinsel zerbricht, muss sie um ihren wertvollsten Besitz trauern. Ihre drei Freunde verstehen den Trauerprozess nicht und versuchen weiterhin, sie aufzumuntern.

Oggy Oggy hat von der alten Dame eine verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe übertragen bekommen. Er soll sich um ihre Zimmerpflanze kümmern, während sie nicht da ist. Die Aufgabe nimmt er sehr ernst und sieht zu, dass der Pflanze nichts passiert.

Der Katzenchor ist sehr beliebt und Oggy Oggy darf mit ihnen gemeinsam üben, was ihn sehr freut. Allerdings stört der Wuff-Kater die Melodie, da ihm immer nur ein Wuff herausrutscht. So wird es ganz sicher kein harmonisches Lied.

Die Zauberkatze führt ihre Tricks vor und Oggy Oggy ist begeistert. Das will er auch können. Er nimmt sich vor, selbst zum Zauberer zu werden. Dafür muss er jedoch zunächst die Tricks einstudieren. Sonst kann er kein Publikum begeistern.

Milo und seine Freunde treffen sich für ein neues Abenteuer. Sie stellen eigene Marmelade her. Dabei testen sie das Obst und wollen von Tilly mehr über die Herstellung lernen. Die Freunde streiten sich, als Probleme entstehen.

Die Freunde müssen einen Helikopter fliegen, auch wenn sie im Stress sind. Der Druck ist enorm hoch. Sie wollen sich einen Tag lang im Team der Luftrettung beweisen. Dabei müssen sie auch in Notsituationen mit Stress umgehen lernen.

Milo und seine Freunde müssen schnell reagieren, als sie ihre Freunde vertreten müssen. Nun müssen sie bei der Milostadt-Leichtathletik-Olympiade antreten und dabei gegen Herrn Knork ankämpfen. Dafür müssen sie eine Menge üben.

Keiner der Erwachsenen mag Hallenspielplätze. Doch irgendwann müssen die Kleinen wieder abgeholt werden und das ist bei so viel Spaß schwieriger, als man denkt.

By pushing themselves and their bodies to the limit, mammals have found remarkable ways to survive in the hottest places on earth. In baking deserts, harsh dry spiny forests, barren desolate salt pans and even bush fires, mammals beat the heat.

Sir David Attenborough reveals why forests are the ultimate test of survival for mammals and how they have overcome the challenges of life in this multidimensional, complex and continually changing environment.

Remote islands offer sanctuary for some of the planet's strangest and rarest creatures. The rare pygmy three-toed sloth enjoys a peaceful existence on an idyllic Caribbean island, while nesting albatross thrive in predator-free isolation. However, island life always comes at a cost. On the Galápagos Islands, young marine iguanas must escape an onslaught of deadly racer snakes the moment they hatch from the sand.
Islands: Wildlife documentary series presented by David Attenborough, beginning with a look at the remote islands which offer sanctuary to some of the planet's rarest creatures.

The great mountain ranges are some of the planet's most spectacular landscapes, but they are unforgiving places to live in. Only few pioneering animals have what it takes to endure at extreme altitude. Mountain animals are also amongst the most elusive in the world, yet this film provides unique and intimate glimpses into their secretive lives. Witness the moment four snow leopards come together when a mother and cub become trapped between two rival males.

Bringing the best in television.
The work of NHS emergency response teams. Staff are scrambled to a block of flats after an explosion causes multiple casualties and a driver is trapped after his lorry hits a tree.
The team joins the search for a missing aeroplane pilot and passenger. A man digging for antique bottles in a South Yorkshire tip is buried alive, leading to a desperate fight to save him.
A student climber plunges from a cliff face in Wharfedale and the team fears he has broken his neck. The medics are also called to treat the victim of a stabbing at a meat plant.
The medics spring into action when a cyclist plunges down a cliff in a freak accident. A homeowner's booby trap, designed to deter burglars, sparks a major rescue operation.
A landslip at a construction site traps a worker under tons of earth. Reports of a riot at a school come in, and medic Alex must lead the operation to treat the injured.
A car crash victim has to be put into an induced coma at the roadside. Andy is called in to stand by as bomb disposal experts deal with a mortar dating back to the Boer War.
The response teams rush to save the life of a 21-year-old man who has been shot twice in the chest at a Doncaster pub. Another man has a seizure in the cab of his tipper truck.

Explores Serbia, the historic and decommissioned Fort Pike in Louisiana, and a mountainside refuge in the country of Georgia that was allegedly revealed to the world through an act of God.

In the Scottish capital of Edinburgh, hidden from view, a series of vaults tell a murky story of opportunity, crime and destitution. At Fort Schwatka Unalaska are the remains of an Alaskan battleground, where a foreign invader set foot on American soil for the first time since 1812.

An Appalachian dream that conjured the spirit of the old west, left to rot on a North Carolina mountainside. In the ex-Soviet republic of Georgia are the remains of an ingenious sky-high solution to a ground-based problem, Chiatura, once known as the Venice of the air.

Explores a city in Azerbaijan that was razed to the ground in a conflict decided by a new weapon of war, a workhouse in Kansas City that appears to have been built for aristocracy, and two towns in Sicily that are seemingly deserted.
Explores an industrial ruin in the Florida Everglades in the south of the United States that once competed in the greatest race humankind has ever witnessed: the mission to land on the Moon.
Explores traces of a mass deception hidden at Ponte Dirillo in Italy, a decaying theatre in Ohio that has lost its lavish shine, and an ancient city that contains a poisonous secret.
Explores a dense forest near the Czech capital of Prague that hides Houska Castle, an eerie keep that has been subject to long-standing rumours that it possesses supernatural powers.

This film celebrates the grandeur of Hampton Court Palace and visits Cragside, one of the first homes to have electric lighting. Fred Dibnah also examines restoration work on a 15th century manor house.
Explores a ground structure in Hull that was reduced to rubble by the planes of Hitler's Luftwaffe, Casa Albero in Italy, the USS Hornet in California, and the tunnels of Sofia in Bulgaria.
Explores an old landmark in Liberia with surprising American origins, the desolate town of Doel in Belgium, a Bolivian ski resort, and a pioneering scientific structure in Cleveland.

Explores the Dew Drop Inn in New Orleans, a music mecca that paid the price for taking on the authorities. Also explores Belgica Fort, a stronghold constructed to guard the most unlikely of treasures.

pr.t: My Family Xmas 2009: 2039 - A Christmas Oddity
pr.d: A glimpse into the future for the Harper family in this seasonal special. It's December 2039, and the Harpers are gathering together to celebrate Christmas.
Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.

Nurse Manisha Devi is still missing. When Sergeant Dale Smith discovers her burnt body, Peter Baxter is brought in again, but he insists on his innocence. Suspicion falls on a taxi driver - who has Ramani De Costa in his cab - has she walked straight into the clutches of a murderer?

DS Samantha Nixon and DC Zain Nadir arrive just in time to save Ramani De Costa from taxi driver David Russo, prime suspect in the murder case of Manisha Devi, but he is released on bail when his DNA fails to match that found near the body. Sergeant June Ackland and PC Roger Valentine are called to an arson incident - where June becomes the victim of rape.

The relief are out looking for the teenager who raped Sergeant June Ackland. June confides in PC Sheelagh Murphy who advises her to have HIV and pregnancy tests. Thirteen-year-old Ross Trescot is found by Gabriel Kent and arrested by Tony Stamp, but when he is interviewed by DC Susie Sim he claims that he too is the victim of sexual abuse. Phil Hunter admits to his fiancée that he is already married.

Roger Valentine and Dan Casper search for a missing girl. When they discover her in some woods, it is clear that she has just given birth. Phil makes amends with Kate - unaware that his younger brother Steve has just spent a night of passion with her. On top of it all, Phil has to bid farewell to his daughter.
pr.sub: At the End of a Long Day

pr.d: Acting Super Amanda Prosser arrives at Sun Hill, and Gina Gold might have finally met her match. Steve Hunter admits to Phil's ex-wife that he slept with his brother's girlfriend.

Concerned for Sergeant Smithy's safety, DC Zain Nadir introduces him to an informant who has had two fingers chopped off by Pete Larson. Zain warns Smithy that if Larson ever found out that he is sleeping with his wife, he'll end up with more than his fingers hacked off.

Super-keen and psyched up, it's Laura Bryant's first day as a PC. Despite PC Roger Valentine's practical jokes, Laura makes her first arrest and manages to get her own back on Roger before the day is out.
The team are called upon to come and rescue the survivors of a fatal crash, and there is a bomb alert after Afghan asylum seekers are moved into a seaside hotel.
A police pursuit ends in a crash when a car driven by teenage joyriders plunges into a deep ditch. Plus, a man falls through the floor of his local betting shop in a bizarre accident.
The team races to save a tanker driver trapped in the wreckage of his crushed cab. Paramedic Rochers tries to save a DIY mechanic crushed by his own car.
The team helps those affected by a major chemical spill that's endangering the lives of thousands; Paramedics get their climbing gear out to help a psychiatric patient.
A man is shot outside a Mosque and paramedics race to save his life. His legs are peppered with shotgun pellets, but the patient won't reveal the identity of the man who pulled the trigger.
The medics support a bomb squad as they attempt to defuse a bomb found in a house. They also treat a fugitive who held a store at knife-point and a teenager impaled on a gate.
The team tackle a dramatic operation where a patient's heart is stopped and restarted. Zoe has a stent replaced in her ureter, which was damaged by her treatment for cancer.
Trisha has an investigation of her womb to find out if she has cancer, Steve's varicose veins are stripped from his leg, and Dennis needs an operation to strengthen his eyelid.
Ben would do anything to get out of Christmas at home, Michael and Alfie make the most of an empty house, and Janey learns that it's tough being a mum.

pr.d: Ben would do anything to get out of Christmas at home, while Michael and Alfie make the most of an empty house.

Susan's scheme to lure Ben to a country house for a Christmas for two without the children and then `surprise' him with the family on Christmas Day is doomed to result in chaos, but that will not stop her from trying.

A festive edition of the family sitcom sees Ben's efforts to buy Susan's Christmas present getting him into trouble, while Susan's letter from The Palace means a change of holiday plans for everyone.

pr.t: My Family Xmas 2008: Have An Unhappy Christmas

pr.t: Rose West and Myra Hindley: The Untold Story with Trevor McDonald
pr.d: This is the extraordinary untold story of how the two most notorious women in British crime, Rose West and Myra Hindley, became lovers in jail, and how their weird life behind bars gives terrifying new insight into crimes that shocked the world. Myra Hindley was labelled the most evil woman in Britain for her part in the Moors murders of the 1960s, but with her husband Fred, Rose West became an even more prolific serial killer in the 1970s and 80s, as the pair killed 10 women and girls.

pr.t: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
pr.d: Henry and Simon explore Wiltshire and Oxfordshire, meeting animal enthusiast Susan. Simon selects an old umbrella stand to repurpose, and Henry tackles an antique chaff cutter.
Steered by his Bradshaw's guide, Michael Portillo heads for the Hertfordshire village of Perry Green, where, in 1940, a young couple fleeing the bombing of London chose to make their home.

Michael Portillo completes his railway journey through the east of England during the post-war period. At RAF Lakenheath, he discovers a slice of America dropped into the British countryside, watching the US Air Force's Strike Eagles.
Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.

Michael Portillo is in Suffolk on the last leg of his tour of East Anglia. He begins at the home of British horse racing, Newmarket, where he learns of the interwar success of a jockey turned trainer and helps to care for a famous ex-racehorse.

Michael Portillo explores the post-war Britain of his youth in a journey from the Midlands to the West Country. Beginning in Derby's railway works, Michael hears how the Victorian sheds now house some of the most modern assembly lines in Britain.

Michael Portillo's nineteenth-century Appleton's guidebook leads him to the Parker House Hotel, where in his best pinny, he whisks up a Boston cream pie. In the fine dome atop Massachusetts General Hospital, where no-one could hear the screaming, Michael discovers the scene of grisly surgery, first made bearable, in 1846, by a miraculous new substance. North of Boston, in Salem, Michael is caught up in a witch hunt.

On the North Somerset coast, the Minehead crew come close to disaster in a challenging rescue of two walkers cut off by the tide. Plus, in Dunbar a boy has fallen from some notoriously dangerous rocks and suffered a potentially life-changing injury.

Fred explores the extraordinary role of steam in the expansion of industrial Britain. Along the way, Fred learns how huge stationary steam engines continued to be used in mills, collieries and steel works until well into the 20th century.

Fred Dibnah looks at early experiments in the use of steam power for road transportation. Along the way, Fred explores the development of the traction engine and its use in both agriculture and haulage.
Fred Dibnah has a look at how steam power had a revolutionary impact on shipping. In the process, Fred explores vessels ranging from early paddle steamers to the Royal Yacht Britannia.

Fred explores how steam power lives on in the modern age through the steam turbine and its critical role in electricity generation. In addition, Fred also looks at how the history of steam is being preserved through heritage museums.
The maintenance crews test pantographs, repair faulty air conditioning units and clear debris from overhead high voltage train power lines.

pr.d: Exploring Lord Howe Island, Norfolk Island and Restoration Island; Thursday and Friday Islands, the homes of music and pearls.

Robbie gets stuck in the mud in Woodseaves Cutting and explores the charming canal-side village of Kinver in Staffordshire.
Robbie navigates the mighty River Severn and takes an unexpected bath as he tumbles at the Tardebigge lock flight in Worcestershire.

Comedian Bill Bailey ventures to Indonesia's remote Spice Islands, in the footsteps of his hero - Victorian naturalist Alfred Russel Wallace. In the second of this two-part series, Bill encounters boggle-eyed tarsiers, monkeys with mohicans and spectacular birds of paradise on his mission to understand how Wallace cracked evolution.

Deserts are hostile: temperatures soar, and water is rare. Desert plants spend decades in suspended animation waiting for rain, or they travel to find it. They survive using weapons, camouflage, and surprising alliances with animals.

We rely on plants for almost everything, including the air we breathe and the food we eat. Two in five wild plants are threatened with extinction, but people are finding new ways to help them, from projects in Africa to reseed the landscape to the rebuilding of a tropical forest in Brazil, tree by tree.

When Texas firefighter Robert Poynter was fatally shot in the head, his distraught wife Chacey blamed his shooting on a random killer; police bodycam captured the unfolding drama and Chacey's dark secret.

It's a Langham/Morgan double date, Dylan gets the full story, and Lacey leans on her sister.

Award-winning eFOLDi lightweight electric folding mobility scooters.

For her third and final cruise of the series, Susan starts her adventure in the cruising capital of Fort Lauderdale. After boarding her ship she sails south to the Caribbean, with her first stop being the private island of Half Moon Cay.

After enjoying the Caribbean islands, Susan's ship sails west to Panama and the wonder of the Panama Canal. Once the ship has anchored she visits the nearby Agua Clara Locks, built to allow the supersized Neo-Panamax ships to transit the canal.

A reverend's endeavour to run pet-friendly services in an effort to grow his congregation is being usurped by his own dog. When Peter and Debbie take their Deerhound cross Boris out, the sight of any other dog causes this fifty-kilo giant to go wild.

Warring spaniels Zach and Ollie are spoiling a couple's retirement plans. Can Graeme Hall negotiate a peace treaty? And amorous labradoodle Rupert is making life hard for a mum. Will Graeme be the cold shower Rupert needs?
The doctors deal with a woman in the midst of a panic attack, a patient that is a chronic asthmatic, a man who can only eat boiled eggs and a harrowing diagnosis of stomach cancer.

Dr Eleanor Beecraft fears her patient is in the middle of a drugs overdose. Dr William Laird must convince a depressed man that life is worth living, and Dr Sarah Glynne encounters her first case of depression brought on by cyber-bullying.

Dr Watson tries to break a vicious circle as her patient tries to self-medicate depression with alcohol. Dr Pearce issues an urgent warning to a patient whose liver is showing the strain of coping with 25 pints a week.

The subject of bereavement takes centre stage. Dr Watson offers 'talking therapy' to a young lady who recently lost her mother and Dr Bower treats a depressed gentleman who has been plagued by suicidal thoughts since his mother's death.
Dr Beecraft sends a patient to A&E with what could be a potentially life-threatening blood clot, and Dr Glynne refers a woman with crippling back pain for emergency surgery.

Guests have included Stacey Solomon, Lisa Faulkner, Tara Reid, Rufus Wainwright and Marina Diamandis.

The finalists make citrus celebration cakes, crème brûlée doughnuts and a tribute to iconic British landscapes. Who'll be the zest and be crowned the series winner?

Griff Rhys Jones takes on one of the world's most celebrated mountain ranges, travelling from France to Slovenia.

Prince Amleth is on the verge of becoming a man when his father is brutally murdered by his uncle, who kidnaps the boy's mother. Two decades later, Amleth is now a Viking who's on a mission to save his mother, kill his uncle and avenge his father.

In his 1996 debut live stand-up show, Bill Bailey demonstrates the influence that Cockney music has had on the great classical composers, and warns of the perils of a world ruled by insects, while playing the second-biggest gong in Britain.
Based on the true story of a vicious killer who became a celebrity and best-selling author in Australia.

Gordon heads to Wilkinsburg, Pennsylvania, home to Ms Jean's Southern Cuisine, which was opened 12 years ago by retired special education teacher Ms Jean Gould. Her employees say she's like Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde and that's why the local community stay away. Ms Jean insists she's only mean because her employees are lazy, but the business is falling apart.

Jan goes missing again and the FBI's hands are tied, but the Brobergs press on in their search for answers. The case takes a heavy toll on Pete as he digs deeper into B.'s past. Jan learns to blend into a strange new environment.

First to host is 69-year-old former property developer, Ian. Ian's hoping to impress his guests with his super-healthy menu, but it's possible they may be more impressed with his 12-bedroom mansion in the country.
It's the turn of 24-year-old reigning Miss Cheltenham, Sophie to host. Sophie is hoping to impress her guests with an evening of elegant food and pageantry.
It's the third day of the competition in Gloucestershire and the turn of 27-year-old rugby-loving Carmel to host; she's confident that her fun filled evening will kick the competition into touch.

It's the turn of 40-year-old school teacher Polly to host. Polly is hoping to wow her guests with a fine dining experience consisting of a seafood starter and a meaty main, undeterred by the fact that she has never cooked either dish before.

It's the final day of the competition in Gloucestershire, and the turn of exuberant hair salon owner Chris to host. Chris is hosting a high-octane evening with some special homemade treats on the menu.

Presenters Tim Lovejoy and Simon Rimmer mix a cookery show with a chat show, and the result is `Sunday Brunch.' Each installment finds Simon and Tim cooking in the kitchen, accompanied by that week's celebrity guests. Other segments include interviews and highlights from television and film, an expert who assists with drink tasting, a round-up of what is trendy, and the ever-popular `Sunday Brunch Playlist,' which consists of music videos chosen by the presenters and their guests. Guests have included Stacey Solomon, Lisa Faulkner, Tara Reid, Rufus Wainwright and Marina Diamandis.

Sam and Rebecca are dressed-up for the USS Constitution tour, but their respective dates cancel. Rebecca is reluctant to go with Sam, who brings Admiral William J Crowe from the tour and introduces him at the bar.
Lilith and Frasier bring a friend to Cheers. Since she is extremely attractive, Sam is immediately interested. He'll do everything to seduce her. Little does he know that he will soon be the victim.

Rebecca decides to smarten up her image and goes to Lilith for advice on power-dressing. Woody can't compete when it comes to expensive presents for Kelly and offers her a lacklustre song that he wrote as her gift.
When Rebecca's sister Susan visits, Sam discovers that the sisters have been enemies for years, and he schemes to exploit the jealousy they have for each other to get dates with them both.
The brothers fight when Ray has to face up to failure for once while Robert is promoted to lieutenant.
Ray runs into a girl who he disrespected when they dated in high school and ends up regretting an apology.
Frasier loses his cool when he finds out a rival radio host is stealing both his ratings and his agent.
Frasier intervenes when his father is belittled by his supervisor while working nights as a security guard, and a love-sick Roz regales Niles and Daphne with stories about her new boyfriend.

Homer and Grampa take to the road to sell Grampa's miracle passion potion, but old resentments resurface between father and son when they pass by their old house, and Bart and Milhouse wonder where all the grown-ups have gone.

When Homer is barred from Moe's he visits an airport bar where he is mistaken for a pilot. The airline offers him free tickets if he promises not to tell anyone that they almost let him fly a plane, but Marge freaks out on the plane, and it's up to psychoanalyst Dr Zweig to explain why.
Homer becomes a member of the Stonecutters secret society. He has to start at the bottom as Number 908, but then Number 1 sees something on Homer's bottom.
A kid discovers the secret headquarters of a powerful superhero hidden beneath his home and must defend it with his group of friends when villains attack.

Als die Schüler anfangen, bei einem neuen Online-Trend mitzumachen, der in der Schule für Unruhe sorgt, tut sich das Lehrerkollegium zusammen, um dem ein Ende zu bereiten. Mr. Johnson gibt Gregory tröstende Lebensratschläge.

WG Freund Karl will bei den Jungs im Garten heiraten. Er ist in Hannah verliebt. Diese geht jedoch fremd und wird am Hochzeitstag von Blake erwischt. Gesteht Blake Karl die Wahrheit und verdirbt so seinen großen Tag oder verheimlicht er das Gesehene?

Die Jungs planen einen Partyurlaub, doch beim Packen stellen sie fest, dass Blakes Reisepass abgelaufen ist. Sie müssen in den nächsten sechs Stunden einen gültigen Pass besorgen, ansonsten müssen sie den ganzen Urlaub absagen.

In dieser Folge geht es in den lustigen Darstellungen und Parodien um hartgesottene Gangster mit einer großen Leidenschaft für 'Twilight', eine Welt, in der Namen lediglich "Blähgeräusche" sind und rassistische Superhelden.

Cartman muss ins Gefängnis, weil er einen Stein nach einem schwarzen Jungen geworfen hat. Zunächst versucht Kenny noch erfolglos, ihn über die Grenze in Sicherheit zu bringen. Schließlich überlegen die Jungs, wie sie ihn befreien können.
pr.sub: Die lustige Geschichte über ein Verbrechen aus Hass

pr.d: Die Jungs sind von den rumänischen Fünflingen, die im Zirkus Kunststücke vorführen, begeistert und wollen es ihnen gleichtun - allerdings scheitern sie kläglich. Kenny hingegen macht eine überraschende Karriere als Opernstar in Europa.

Die Außerirdischen helfen Jeff bei der persönlichen Suche nach seinen Seelenverwandten, indem sie Simulationen mit Miniaturklonen durchführen, aber die Dinge geraten schnell aus dem Ruder, als einer von ihnen in die reale Welt entkommt.

Während Beavis und Butt-Head versuchen, sich in der Schule zu verstecken, werden sie im Karton gefangen. Die beiden wollen unbedingt Honig aus einem Wespennest ernten. Doch ihre Taten haben einige chaotische Konsequenzen mit sich.

Als der größte Popstar des Landes sich in einen Zombie verwandelt, folgen Millionen ihrer treuen Fans diesem Beispiel. Mark freundet sich mit einem der neuen Zombies an und Randall ist gezwungen, sich mit seinen Eifersuchtsproblemen zu befassen.

Über Jahre geht die Liebes- und Trennungsgeschichte von Mark und seiner Chefin Callie jetzt schon, und nun will er die Tochter des Teufels endlich fragen, ob sie seine Frau werden will. Diesen wilden Plan fasst er ausgerechnet am ersten April.

Stans Vater holt die Jungs vom Karate ab. Dieser ist sichtlich betrunken und will ihnen seine Fahr- und Alkoholkünste zeigen. Sie sehen, wie er während des Autofahrens trinkt und dabei auch noch in eine Flasche pinkeln kann.

Die Jungs von South Park sind sehr gute Baseballspieler und schaffen es mit ihrem Team in die Playoffs. Das bedeutet aber wenig Freizeit. Jetzt wollen sie unbedingt verlieren, um nicht die ganzen Ferien auf dem Baseball-Feld zu verbringen.

Cartman startet mal wieder eine Aktion gegen Kyle und gründet die Initiative gegen "Ginger Kids". Diese soll gegen rothaarige, sommersprossige und hellhäutige Kinder hetzen. Die Jungs färben heimlich seine Haare, um ihm eine Lektion zu erteilen.

Stan will über den Klimawandel nicht nur reden, sondern auch etwas tun. Deswegen will er seine Mitbürger umstimmen, sich Hybridfahrzeuge zu kaufen. Als alle zustimmen, braut sich plötzlich eine dunkle Masse über der Stadt zusammen.

Towelie ist Kellner in South Park. Er ist Drogen nicht ganz abgeneigt und verliert wegen seines starken Konsums auch seinen Job. Das veranlasst ihn dazu, sein Leben niederzuschreiben. Dank eines Auftritts bei Oprah, wird das Buch zum Kassenschlager.

Die Jungs folgen Al Gore in eine Höhle. Angeblich soll es da ein mutiertes Mischwesen geben und sie wollen es aufspüren. Das stellt sich als großer Fehler heraus, als ein Erdrutsch die Höhle verschüttet und sie ums Überleben kämpfen müssen.

Bob liebt Thanksgiving und will, dass es dieses Jahr besonders schön gefeiert wird. Aber Fischoeder kommt ihm dazwischen. Er will seine Ex-Flamme eifersüchtig machen, weshalb Bob seinen Koch und Linda samt Kindern seine Familie spielen muss.

Bobs Vermieter, der auch der Beisitzer des Piers ist, hält es für eine tolle Idee, einen mechanischen Hai als Attraktion zu kaufen. Allerdings gerät der Roboter-Hai außer Kontrolle und Bob und seine Familie müssen ihn stoppen.
Tina fährt das Auto zu Schrott und lockt damit einen nervigen Versicherungsagenten an, der die Familie belästigt. Tina glaubt nun, dass sie ein Unglücksrabe ist, bis sich das Blatt wieder wendet.

Gene schafft es, Courtney zu seiner festen Freundin zu machen. Was ihn begeistert, lässt den Rest der Familie eher unbeeindruckt. Allerdings kann er nicht mit ihr Schluss machen, weil er sich durch ihren Vater eine Musikkarriere verspricht.

Bob erbt einen Lagerraum, in dem sich ein Mann namens Chet befindet, der früher angeblich eine Schaufensterpuppe war. Bob macht sich den Mann zunutze und lässt ihn erfolgreich die Fenster des Restaurants dekorieren.
Greg und Terry adoptieren ein asiatisches Kind. Als Roger sieht, was für ein tolles Leben das Kind nun bei ihnen hat, wird er es los und tritt an seine Stelle.

Roger erleidet einen Herzinfarkt und sieht sich gezwungen, seine geliebte Dachboden-Bar zu verkaufen. Steve und seine Freunde bekommen unterdessen ein verlockendes Angebot: eine sexy Nachbarin bietet ihnen Sex gegen Hausarbeiten an.
Roger und Francine finden im Wald eine Außerirdische. Roger beginnt eine Affäre mit ihr, ist aber sehr schnell von ihr genervt. Um sie möglichst schnell wieder loszuwerden, ruft er die CIA an.
Hayley möchte mehr Aufmerksamkeit bekommen und färbt sich deshalb ihre Haare blond. Stan und Steve sind damit beschäftigt, ein neues Zuhause für die Familie Smith zu finden.
Hal kündigt seinen Job wegen einer Midlife-Crisis - motiviert von dem Wunsch, Künstler zu werden. Malcolm beginnt auch über seine künftige Laufbahn nachzudenken.

Lois' Eltern besuchen die Familie, doch ihre Anwesenheit ist alles andere als angenehm. Malcolm halten sie für einen Versager und auch ihrem Schwiegersohn Hal machen sie das Leben schwer. Nur Reese scheinen sie zu mögen.
pr.sub: Hilfe, Oma und Opa sind da

pr.d: Ein Polizist beschlagnahmt den Wagen von Lois wegen 16 nicht bezahlter Strafzettel. Lois behauptet, sie sei falsch angeschuldigt.
Malcolm muss mit Blinddarmentzündung ins Krankenhaus. Er versucht mit allen Mitteln der Operation zu entgehen.
Hal und Reese nehmen an einem Kochkurs teil. Malcolm versucht einen Mitschüler zu überzeugen, keine Party zu feiern.
Phil fühlt sich nicht geschätzt, während Claire damit beschäftigt ist, das Geschäft zu führen.
Aufgrund von Stromausfällen während eines Gewitters geht die Familie zu Jay und Gloria.
Da niemand von Claires Assistenten weiß, kann Phil nicht nachvollziehen, wie sie alles erledigt.
Phil versucht mit allen Mitteln, seinen attraktiven neuen Kunden vor Claire geheim zu halten.
Phil beschließt, mit Claire spontan nach Paris zu fahren, aber beide sind erschöpft.
Amy macht sich auf die Suche nach den niedlichsten Spielzeugen im ganzen Universum.
Die Ärzte schaffen es nicht, an Bender heranzukommen und ordnen deshalb eine Robotomie an. Unterdessen sind Fry, Leela und Farnsworth damit beschäftigt, in die Dunkel-Materie von Mom einzudringen.
Die Ärzte führen bei Bender die zuvor geplante Robotomie durch, während der er Farnsworth, Leela und Fry mit in seine imaginäre Welt von "Dungeons & Dragons" zieht.

Farnsworth und der Rest der Gruppe erreicht schließlich Momons Höhle. Der Kampf um den Antikristall beginnt. Als es schlecht für Fry und seine Freunde aussieht, entdeckt er plötzlich eine geheime Waffe, die alle retten könnte.

Fry erlangt die Fähigkeit, Gedanken zu lesen, und nimmt prompt an einem Pokerturnier teil. Bender lässt sich unterdessen auf eine Affäre mit einem Showgirl ein, bei dem es sich um Donbots Frau handelt.
Fry erfährt mehr über seine Fähigkeiten und bekommt den Auftrag, das Universum zu retten. Leela will unterdessen mit den Öko-Feministinnen Leo Wong vom Bau einer Minigolfanlage abhalten.

Fry gibt vor, für Wong zu arbeiten, wobei er eigentlich auf Leelas Seite ist. Das kann er ihr allerdings nicht sagen. Allerdings erfährt er von den Dunklen und den Enzyklopädien. Zapp, Kiff und Bender wollen unterdessen die Feministinnen fassen.
Leela, Amy und die Feministinnen stehen vor Gericht, weil sie primitive Lebensformen verteidigen.

Professor Farnsworth "klont" nach einem Absturz die tote Crew wieder zum Leben. Nur Leela liegt weiterhin im Koma, weshalb Fry sich einen Leela-Bot baut, der genauso aussieht wie sie. Als sie tatsächlich aufwacht, ist die Verwirrung perfekt.

Eine Todeskugel droht die Erde zu zerstören. Zapp und Leela sollen die Erde retten, doch die beiden stürzen ab. Leela glaubt, die Erde sei zerstört und sie wären die letzten beiden Überlebenden. Farnsworth entdeckt indes den Zweck der Kugel.

"Little Britain" zeigt, dass die Bewohner Britanniens einfach wunderbar sind. Zum Beispiel das leicht übergewichtige Schulmädchen Vicky Pollard. Sie hat zwar keine Manieren und kann sich nicht ausdrücken, trotzdem ist sie immer bemüht, ihrem Lehrer zu erklären, warum sie wieder etwas falsch gemacht hat. Dabei redet sie sich um Kopf und Kragen. Auch Lou und Andy sind ein Teil von "Little Britain". Lou betreut Andy, der im Rollstuhl sitzt. Jedenfalls glaubt das die ganze Welt.

Anne reist gemeinsam mit Dr. Lawrence nach Paris. Sie plant, im Louvre eine Kunsttherapie zu beginnen, und damit ihre geistige Zerstreuung zu mildern. Ghettogöre Vicky Pollard sitzt in Thailand in einem Gefängnis fest. Ihr wird versuchter Drogenschmuggel vorgehalten. Rollstuhlfahrer Andy und sein Begleiter Lou wollen ins Disneyland in Florida reisen. Während des Flugs werden sie ins Cockpit eingeladen. Das hat verheerende Auswirkungen auf alle Passagiere.
Mariner verbündet sich mit einem labilen Fähnrich. Cerritos ist Gastgeber von Friedensgesprächen.
Die Crew nimmt an einer Spezialexpedition verdeckter Ermittlerinnen teil.

Ein soziopathischer Wissenschaftler steht 20 Jahre nach seinem Verschwinden vor der Haustür seiner Tochter. Er zieht bei ihrer Familie ein, richtet in der Garage ein Labor ein und nimmt seinen Enkel mit auf wilde Abenteuer durch das Universum.
Jerry hat Glück bei einer Dame und Beth erinnert sich an ihre Kindheit.

Tyrannis trifft sich mit der Göttin Demeter und erhält eine Chance auf Unsterblichkeit, aber Deliria macht sie zunichte. Stupendous und Hippocampus besuchen Hades, um Stupendous' Schild von einem gefallenen Feind zu holen.
Hippocampus geht zu einem Wissenschaftskongress, wo er für seine Intelligenz Anerkennung findet.
Rick und Morty brauchen unbedingt eine Pause, um sich von schlechten Zeiten zu erholen.
Rick und Morty machen sich auf die Suche nach der verlorenen Stadt Atlantis. Dabei stoßen sie auf eine Zitadelle, die eine eigene Gesellschaft beherbergt.
pr.sub: Atlantis ist nur einmal im Jahr

pr.d: Hoping to win a huge jackpot, the friends pool their money and buy dozens of lottery tickets, but they argue over how to spend the fortune if they win, and Monica irritates everyone else by buying tickets just for her and Chandler. Exasperated, Phoebe takes the bowl of everyone's tickets and threatens to throw it off the balcony. The others make up, but a pigeon startles Phoebe.

Events take a dramatic twist in the last-ever episode. Ray fears getting his adenoids removed, but Debra convinces him to go through with the surgery.

Ray Barone's life seems perfect: he's a successful sportswriter living with his wife Debra and three kids, but trouble comes in paradise in the shape of his interfering mother, grumpy father and resentful brother. In this opening episode of the series, Debra wants a peaceful birthday with Ray, so he tells his parents and brother that there's no party: a lie with embarrassing consequences.
Debra is upset that Ray has a problem showing affection for her. Her anger is nothing, however, compared with her reaction when he shares his problem with his interfering parents.
After Robert takes a second job selling home security systems, he reveals he has been asked to join the firm full-time and is mulling over retiring from the police force early.

A man being sentenced to prison leaps over the bench and attacks the 62-year-old judge; a defendant lands in hot water after accidentally uttering a foul-mouthed insult before disconnecting from his virtual hearing.

A grieving father is removed from the courtroom for cursing at his daughter's killer; a man accused of violating his parole by drinking alcohol claims he absorbed it from aftershave; a defendant breaks down crying when the judge denies her bond.

A convicted murderer has a violent reaction as courtroom deputies take him into custody; a judge refuses to give in to the pleas for mercy from a repeat drug offender; a woman found guilty of probation violation escapes the courtroom.
A wrestling move lands a teenager in court. A man due at a hearing, instead runs from the courthouse. A defendant's comment offends a judge.

A defendant claims the pants he was wearing, and the drug paraphernalia inside them, weren't his; a grieving wife describes the DUI accident that killed her husband; an accused murderer is not happy with his lawyer.

A man is sent to prison for probation violation after smashing into a car carrying his estranged wife and three young children; the judge doesn't hold back when sentencing a tearful, three-time OWI offender.

A look at some strange arrests from across the country: a woman urinates in the street during a traffic stop, a pantless man is arrested for allegedly robbing a doughnut shop, and two women drive to a bank with a deceased man in the car.

The peaceful town of Mountain City, TN, is rocked when a beloved young couple is found brutally murdered in their home. As police search for their killer, they uncover a family enmeshed in sinister secrets and lies.

While out deer hunting, a young father of two is murdered in the woods. Twenty-five years later, a revelation sparks a new investigation and leads police to uncover an unthinkable conspiracy between those closest to the victim.

Rebecca Keller and Keri Murphy murdered Murphy's mother after she did not approve of their high school relationship. In her first TV interview ever, Keller explains to David Scott her role in the killing and even tries to justify why she did it.

Henry and Fuzz head for Cumbria where Dave's mega-shed awaits. It holds a fleet of rare cars, bicycles, and more trinkets than the British Museum. Henry's lost for words.
Henry and Fuzz explore George's automobilia collection in Dorset, where Henry's in the mood for an SPQR (Small Profit Quick Return).
Henry and Fuzz head to Northamptonshire to look around Louis' palatial shed which is filled with motorbikes and some tempting automobilia.
Henry and Fuzz visit Graham's collection of Land Rovers, motorbikes, and tractors in Shropshire.
A video game company send Bruce on a mission to find items relating to the Blitz. He sets his eyes on some large pieces and tries to buy a 50-kilogram Luftwaffe bomb and an air raid siren.
Bruce is tasked with finding World War Two spy items that help tell the story of Ian Fleming and James Bond. First, he visits a debonair dealer in London to find some suitable espionage items.
Ex-paras Bruce Crompton and Freddie Kruyer explore the troops' vital role in defeating the Germans in WW2. They collect authentic gear and uniforms before they jump.

Henry and Sam are in the Midlands. Today's sheds are owned by bike builder extraordinaire Patrick Walker. It's no surprise that some rare bikes lurk under his dust sheets - but what does he keep in his freezer?

Henry and Sam are up in Lancashire. Today they are with Miles, a petrol head whose sheds contain an amazing collection of vintage bikes and rare British and American four-wheelers. But what will he part with?
Henry and Sam are exploring an Aladdin's cave of different sheds all on one property, and they are over the moon with their finds - a vintage bike and a stationary engine, all for under £50!

Henry and Sam are rummaging about in what can only be described as a tractor enthusiast's heaven. Sheds and fields full of tractors and machinery, some in mint condition and others buried under a mass of weeds, hedges and grass.

Henry and Sam find themselves down in the South West rummaging around another belting shed with all sorts of things on offer. So much so that it is virtually impossible to pick one thing - so they come back with a handful.

The deal-searching duo are at it again, this time in Cornwall. There's plenty more to look at, including some rare early-1900s steam-powered cars. Henry might even be lucky enough to have a go in one.
Automata artisans, Michael and Maria restore an acrobatic figurine from France. Meanwhile, sculptor, Nick manages to revive a pair of motorbikes previously used on fairground rides.
The force is strong with paper conservator, Ashleigh, as she takes on the challenge of restoring an original Star Wars poster. Upholsterer, Ray, updates a pair of designer chairs from the 1960s.
Painter, Gill brings the romance back to an old and faded Chinese marriage cabinet. Later, leather specialist, Martin finds and saves a rare suitcase that's one of the best he's seen.

The galaxy is full of stars ready to explode into supernovas, a stellar detonation powerful enough to destroy all life on Earth; it's an event that hasn't occurred in 400 years, and the search is on to locate which star may be next.

Neutrinos are the most mysterious particles in the universe, and they power some of the most explosive events in the cosmos; new discoveries reveal how these ghosts pass through objects undetected and why they could be the reason humans exist.

Matt Paxton und sein Team packen im US-Bundesstaat Pennsylvania tatkräftig an. Das unbewohnte Grundstück auf dem Land gehörte einem Mechaniker. Sie sollen dort schwere Maschinen, Drehbänke, Pressen und Metallschrott abtransportieren.
Million Dollar Baby. Patrick and Kirsty unearth a giant million-dollar Amethyst cluster, while Pete and Kyle struggle to extract extremely fragile and rare Crocoite crystals. S1, Ep1

Mike geht in Kalifornien auf Schatzsuche. Zwei Aufträge versprechen Einnahmen im fünfstelligen Bereich. In Santa Cruz hat die Truppe eine Hot Wheels-Sammlung, Skateboards und eine Honda CR250M Elsinore im Fokus. Erfüllt die Ausbeute die Erwartungen?
Hot As Hell. Patrick faces extreme temperatures to recover Australia's biggest-ever, million-dollar Amethyst cluster. In contrast, Pete and Kyle struggle in frigid conditions. S1, Ep2

Drew Pritchard besucht das Drenagh House in Nordirland und ist von dessen Innenausstattung sehr beeindruckt. Die Besitzer möchten das alte Herrenhaus aus dem Jahr 1835 zum Veranstaltungsort umbauen und bieten deshalb einige Möbel zum Verkauf an.
Diggers, Dingoes & Debt. Patrick and Kirsty search for rare Aquamarine crystals on their remote Queensland lease. Plus, Frankie & Ebriony face off against wild pigs and dingoes. S1, Ep3

Drew Pritchard ist zu Besuch in Castle Hill, dem Sitz einer englischen Adelsfamilie. Der Antiquitätenhändler interessiert sich unter anderem für einen alten Mörser aus Carrara-Marmor. Das Objekt ist äußerst selten und circa 300 Pfund wert.
The Victoria Diggers' desperately fight for survival, but they may have stumbled across a monster nugget. The Gold Gypsies fend off deadly snakes during their search.

Im Gepäck eines Passagiers aus Kairo befinden sich weder Kleidung noch Souvenirs. Der Koffer ist stattdessen vollgestopft mit Zigaretten. Der mutmaßliche Schmuggler muss in Barcelona mit strafrechtlichen Konsequenzen rechnen.

Die Guardia Civil hat in Madrid Funkkontakt mit einem Flugzeug aus Cali, das soeben gelandet ist. An Bord ist ein Passagier verstorben. Die Beamten sollen den Mann anhand seiner Ausweispapiere identifizieren.
The Gold Gypsies hunt for nuggets in ancient mine shafts and Greg discovers a rare meteorite. The Mahoneys chase for more gold using Ted's granddad's treasure map.

Am Flughafen der Lagunenstadt Venedig landen viele Maschinen aus Casablanca, Istanbul und Dubai mit Passagieren aus dem Nahen Osten und aus Afrika. Diese Routen werden von der Guardia di Finanza besonders streng überwacht.
The Mahoneys look for gold in one of the world's most remote regions. Meanwhile, the Victorian Diggers may have stumbled across millions of dollars' worth of gold.

Egal, in welcher Währung, wer 10 000 Euro oder mehr in bar bei sich trägt und diese vor dem Grenzübertritt nicht angibt, macht sich strafbar. Deshalb ist in dieser Folge am Flughafen in Mailand ein gewaltiges Bußgeld fällig.
Unable to get over the death of her brother, 16-year-old Haley has become a compulsive hoarder. Can a fellow sufferer help her control her collecting?

Das Team der Rostocker Notaufnahme versorgt einen stark alkoholisierten Patienten und einen neurologischen Notfall. Parallel dazu wird eine Patientin mit einer Entzündung der Wirbelsäule per Rettungshubschrauber nach Magdeburg gebracht.
Donna is a former professional ventriloquist who has collected hundreds of puppets in her home. With the help of a clinical psychologist, Donna confronts her obsession.

Das Klinikpersonal in Rostock versorgt Notfälle wie Nierenstau, Darmverschluss und Krampfanfälle. In Saarbrücken zeigt sich derweil, dass viele Unfälle, wie eine schwere Schnittwunde beim Putzen, typischerweise im häuslichen Umfeld passieren.

pr.t: Extinct or Alive: Land of the Lost Sharks
pr.d: Wildlife biologist and conservationist Forrest Galante dives into some of the most treacherous, shark-infested waters in the Southern Hemisphere all in an attempt to rediscover three unique sharks lost to science for as long as 100 years.

Ein Lkw-Fahrer meldet sich von einem Rastplatz aus bei der Polizei. Diebe wollen an einer Fernverkehrsstraße offenbar seine Ladung stehlen. Dan Butler und Jon Lee sind unterdessen mit ihrem Zivilfahrzeug einem Verdächtigen auf den Fersen.

Josh Gates explores daring journeys, including the Kon-Tiki balsa raft crossing the Pacific, NASA's lunar rover making tracks on the moon and an aeroplane flying around the world without the use of fuel.

Vier Jugendliche in einem Sportwagen verwechseln die öffentlichen Straßen mit einer Rennstrecke. Mit ihrer rücksichtslosen Fahrweise gefährden sie andere Verkehrsteilnehmer. Eine örtliche Polizeistreife hat versucht, die Raser anzuhalten.
Ed Stafford tests his body's ultimate limits as he races against medic and ultra-marathon runner Sun Lingye across the arduous mountain terrains of Taiwan.

Delve into North America's southern coastal waters, where opalescent squid mate, sea turtles nest, and mobula rays soar in romantic displays. Join Lizzie as she pilots a specialised drone to collect breath samples from blue whales.

When the chipmunks are signed by big-shot producer Ian, will fame and fortune go to their heads?
Amy feels competitive when Glenn publicly congratulates Jonah on his superb test results. Cloud 9 employees are on their best behaviour in anticipation of a secret shopper.

The game is afoot when Glenn declares that all employees will receive a $200 bonus if the store reaches a certain sales goal by the end of the day. As the associates scramble to upsell their customers, Jonah struggles with his morality until he gives in and convinces a customer to purchase many expensive items.

When Cheyenne and Bo intend to make lavish purchases during the store's annual wedding-themed sale, Amy tries to talk to them about the cost of having a child. Glenn tries to show his support for gay marriage.
The staff are waiting for a truck to deliver new Cloud 9 signs, until Glenn announces that the truck is delayed, and they're locked in the store for the night.

Ein Forensiker untersucht die Leiche einer Frau, die mutmaßlich von ihrem Mann getötet wurde. Seine Funde sprechen jedoch eine andere Sprache. Ein Ehepaar wird des Mordes an der eigenen Tochter angeklagt und zu lebenslanger Haft verurteilt.

Eine 20-jährige Frau steigt auf ihr Fahrrad und wird wenig später nur wenige Kilometer entfernt von ihrem Haus ermordet aufgefunden, mit einer Schusswunde im Kopf. Jahrelang kommt die Polizei mit den Ermittlungen nicht voran.

Ein älteres Paar wird brutal ermordet, doch obwohl es mehrere Verdächtige gibt, bleibt der Fall aufgrund fehlender Beweise ungelöst. Erst zehn Jahre später werden die Ermittlungen mit modernsten Untersuchungsmethoden wieder aufgenommen.

Die neunjährige Cyndi verschwindet am Unabhängigkeitstag und ihre Mutter Rhonda wird verdächtigt, nachdem ihr Verhör Unstimmigkeiten aufweist. Innerhalb von fünf Monaten geschehen zwei Morde, die sich ähneln - die Polizei geht vom selben Täter aus.

Die Ehefrau eines pensionierten Polizisten steht unter Verdacht, ihren Mann erschossen zu haben, nachdem sie sich in widersprüchliche Aussagen verstrickt. Bei einem Besuch der britischen Queen in den USA sterben drei Agenten des Secret Service.

Ein Mietwagen wird abseits der Straße in einer Schlucht gefunden, total ausgebrannt. Offenbar ist der Wagen explodiert, nachdem er von der Straße abgekommen ist. Vom Fahrer findet man lediglich noch die Zähne.

Gilbert Nowotny ist ein waschechter Fan der Boston ⚾ [MLB] Red Sox und stirbt plötzlich nach einem Spiel. Er bricht tot am Steuer seines Autos zusammen. Wenig später wird die junge Sportagentin Margot Trent von einem Lastwagen erwischt und überfahren. Die Ermittlungen ergeben, dass die beiden Fälle miteinander in Verbindung stehen. Mac und sein Team finden in Gilberts Wagen einen Baseball, an dem ein Haar von Margot klebt.

Josh und Beatrice sind aufgeregt, denn die stadtbekannte Gastronomie-Kritikerin Sally Moore stattet ihrem Lokal einen Besuch ab. Als diese jedoch tot aufgefunden wird und Josh spurlos verschwunden ist, beginnt für die Ermittler ein schwieriger Fall.

Nach zehn Jahren erhält William Hendry ein Lebenszeichen von seiner vor zehn Jahren entführten Frau Jenny. Hendry wird kurze Zeit später überfallen und mit Handschellen an einen Zaun gehängt. Goren und Eames spüren den Entführer auf.

Joseph Long wird Opfer eines Mafia-Mordes. Die Detektive finden heraus, dass es sich um eine Verwechslung handelt, denn es gibt einen weiteren Joseph Long, der auch am selben Tag geboren ist. Dieser ist ein bekannter Bombenbastler. Vor kurzem wurde ein Bombenanschlag auf den Mafia-Boss Peter Taglioti verübt, der sich nun dafür rächen will. Logan geht derweil noch einer anderen Spur nach. Als es weitere Tote gibt, steht das Team vor einem Rätsel.

Als Schwester Dorothy, die junge Prostituierte von ihren Zuhältern freikauft, ermordet wird, ermitteln Goren und Eames zunächst im Rotlichtmilieu. Der Arzt Eddie hat dem Opfer kurz vor seinem Tod Fragen zu einer seltenen Blutkrankheit gestellt.

Bethany verschwindet auf einem Schulausflug nach New York spurlos. Eames und Barek erfahren, dass Bethany in der Nacht vor ihrem Verschwinden mit Ethan getanzt hatte, der daraufhin verhaftet wird. Dessen Vater verhindert ein weiteres Festhalten.

Logan gelingt es, den Mordverdächtigen Ethan Garrett zu einem Angriff zu provozieren, sodass man ihn verhaften kann. In der Zelle erzählt er einem V-Mann von einem Sumpf, in dem die Ermittler die Leiche der jungen Bethany finden.
